Numerous studies have demonstrated that XRF-derived elemental proxies differ substantially in signal-to-noise characteristics, sensitivity to matrix effects, and susceptibility to analytical and depositional noise, necessitating element-specific evaluation frameworks (e.g. Weltje & Tjallingii, 2008; Lu00f6wemark et al., 2011).\n\n> In particular, uncertainty propagation from calibration into prediction intervals can dominate reconstructed variability, leading to apparent high-frequency fluctuations that are not environmentally meaningful (Trachsel & Telford, 2016).        RMSE_ppm_mean = NA, RMSE_ppm_sd = NA\n            )\n          )\n        }\n        \n        boot_df %>%\n          dplyr::summarise(\n            R2_mean       = mean(R2, na.rm = TRUE),\n            R2_sd         = sd(R2, na.rm = TRUE),\n            R2_q05        = as.numeric(stats::quantile(R2, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)),\n            R2_q25        = as.numeric(stats::quantile(R2, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),\n            R2_q75        = as.numeric(stats::quantile(R2, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),\n            R2_q95        = as.numeric(stats::quantile(R2, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)),\n            RMSE_mean     = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),\n            RMSE_sd       = sd(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),\n            RMSE_ppm_mean = mean(RMSE_ppm, na.rm = TRUE),\n            RMSE_ppm_sd   = sd(RMSE_ppm, na.rm = TRUE)\n          )\n        }\n  \n  # 8.1 Fit models - fit_models_for_element(el, data) ---------------------\n    \n    # ELEMENT LOOP     \n        for (el in elements) {\n          \n          p_po_list <- list()\n          p_po_list_noerr <- list()\n          \n          stopifnot(is.list(p_po_list), is.list(p_po_list_noerr))\n          \n          pb_elements$tick()\n          \n          y_col   <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n          x_col   <- el\n          var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n          sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n          \n          # NEW LOCATION (requested change):\n          element_dir <- file.path(calib_base, el)\n          dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n          \n          errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n          if (length(errors) > 0)\n            warning(paste(\"Issues in\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n          \n          # Formulas\n          fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n          fmla_multi  <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \")))\n          \n          y <- data[[y_col]]\n      \n      # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n      # MODELS (never skip; failures -> NULL)\n      # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n        model_list <- list(\n          OLS = tryCatch(lm(fmla_single, data = data), error = function(e) NULL),\n          \n          WLS = tryCatch({\n            ols <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n            rm  <- lm(abs(ols$residuals) ~ ols$fitted.values)\n            w   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n            lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w)\n          }, error = function(e) NULL),\n          \n          OLS_weighted = tryCatch({\n            if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n              lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n            else NULL\n          }, error = function(e) NULL),\n          \n          WLS_weighted = tryCatch({\n            if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n              init <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n              rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n              w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n              lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2)\n            } else NULL\n          }, error = function(e) NULL),\n          \n          Bayes = tryCatch(bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data), error = function(e) NULL),\n          \n          RF = tryCatch(\n            randomForest(fmla_multi, data = data, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          ),\n          \n          PLS_LOO = tryCatch({\n            pls <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n            best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n            attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n            pls\n          }, error = function(e) NULL),\n          \n          PLS_kfold = tryCatch({\n            pls <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE,\n                        validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n            best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n            attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n            pls\n          }, error = function(e) NULL)\n      )\n  \n  \n  # 8.2 Model loop & Evaluate model performance ----------------------------------\n  \n      # PER-ELEMENT TABLES & PRED DF SET UP\n        ranking_df <- tibble(\n          Model = character(),\n          R2    = numeric(),\n          RMSE  = numeric(),\n          RMSEP = numeric(),\n          RMSE_ppm  = numeric(),\n          RMSEP_ppm = numeric(),\n          AIC   = numeric(),\n          BIC   = numeric()\n        )\n        \n        diag_df <- tibble(\n          Model             = character(),\n          Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n          Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n          Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n          BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n          BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n          BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n          CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n          CV10_expl         = character(),\n          AIC               = numeric(),\n          AIC_expl          = character(),\n          BIC               = numeric(),\n          BIC_expl          = character()\n        )\n        \n        do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n        preds_df <- if (do_predictions) XRF_new else NULL\n        \n        pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n          format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n          total  = length(model_list),\n          clear  = FALSE,\n          width  = 70\n        )\n      \n      # MODEL LOOP\n        \n      for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n        \n        pb_models$tick()\n        m <- model_list[[mname]]\n        \n        # Predictions on calibration data\n        pred <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n          else if (!is.null(m))\n            as.numeric(predict(m))\n          else\n            rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))\n        }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n        \n        resid_vals <- y - pred\n        \n        # Metrics\n        R2 <- tryCatch({\n          SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n          SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n          1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n        }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n        \n        RMSE <- tryCatch(\n          sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),\n          error = function(e) NA_real_\n        )\n        \n        cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n          fmla_single else fmla_multi\n        \n        RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n          cv_rmse_for_model(\n            mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n            var_col, sd_col,\n            best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n          ),\n          error = function(e) NA_real_\n        )\n        \n        # Compute RMSE in PPM scale (for comparability with ACE)\n        \n          # Convert observed + predicted back to ppm scale\n          obs_ppm  <- exp(y)\n          pred_ppm <- exp(pred)\n          \n          # Absolute RMSE in ppm\n          RMSE_ppm <- tryCatch(\n            sqrt(mean((obs_ppm - pred_ppm)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),\n            error = function(e) NA_real_\n          )\n          \n          # % RMSE relative to mean observed ppm\n          mean_obs_ppm <- mean(obs_ppm, na.rm = TRUE)\n          \n          RMSE_ppm_pc <- ifelse(\n            is.na(mean_obs_ppm) || mean_obs_ppm == 0,\n            NA_real_,\n            100 * RMSE_ppm / mean_obs_ppm\n          )\n        \n        # RMSEP in ppm scale (convert CV log predictions into ppm)\n        \n        RMSEP_ppm <- tryCatch(\n          {\n            # Use same CV predictions used for RMSEP_val, but convert them:\n            cv_log <- cv_predictions_for_model(      # You already have RMSEP_val fn\n              mname,\n              cv_formula,\n              data,\n              y_col,\n              var_col,\n              sd_col,\n              best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n            )\n            \n            if (is.null(cv_log)) {\n              NA_real_\n            } else {\n              cv_ppm <- exp(cv_log$pred)\n              obs_cv_ppm <- exp(cv_log$obs)\n              sqrt(mean((obs_cv_ppm - cv_ppm)^2, na.rm = TRUE))\n            }\n          },\n          error = function(e) NA_real_\n        )\n        \n        AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n          tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n        \n        BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n          tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n        \n        ranking_df <- dplyr::add_row(\n          ranking_df,\n          Model       = mname,\n          R2          = R2,\n          RMSE        = RMSE,\n          RMSEP       = RMSEP_val,\n          RMSE_ppm    = RMSE_ppm,\n          RMSEP_ppm   = RMSEP_ppm,\n          AIC         = AIC_val,\n          BIC         = BIC_val\n        )\n        \n        global_summary <- dplyr::add_row(\n          global_summary,\n          Element = el,\n          Model   = mname,\n          R2      = R2,\n          RMSE    = RMSE,\n          RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n          RMSE_ppm    = RMSE_ppm,\n          RMSEP_ppm   = RMSEP_ppm,\n          AIC     = AIC_val,\n          BIC     = BIC_val\n        )\n        \n  \n  # 8.3 Bootstrap diagnostics -----------------------------------------------\n        \n        boot_stats <- train_frac = 0.8,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        )\n        \n        # STORE BOOTSTRAP vs NON-BOOTSTRAP COMPARISON (PER MODEL)\n  \n        boot_compare_row <- tibble::tibble(\n          Element = el,\n          Model   = mname,\n          \n          # Non-bootstrap\n          R2_single       = R2,\n          RMSE_single     = RMSE,\n          RMSE_ppm_single = RMSE_ppm,\n          \n          # Bootstrap\n          R2_mean         = boot_stats$R2_mean,\n          R2_sd           = boot_stats$R2_sd,\n          R2_q05          = boot_stats$R2_q05,\n          R2_q25          = boot_stats$R2_q25,\n          R2_q75          = boot_stats$R2_q75,\n          R2_q95          = boot_stats$R2_q95,\n          RMSE_mean       = boot_stats$RMSE_mean,\n          RMSE_sd         = boot_stats$RMSE_sd,\n          RMSE_ppm_mean   = boot_stats$RMSE_ppm_mean,\n          RMSE_ppm_sd     = boot_stats$RMSE_ppm_sd\n        )\n        \n        bootstrap_compare_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(\n          bootstrap_compare_df,\n          boot_compare_row\n        )\n        \n        # Store per-model bootstrap summary (for Section 11)\n        \n        bootstrap_store[[paste(el, mname, sep = \"__\")]] <-\n          tibble::tibble(\n            Element = el,\n            Model   = mname,\n            \n            R2_mean = boot_stats$R2_mean,\n            R2_sd   = boot_stats$R2_sd,\n            R2_q05  = boot_stats$R2_q05,\n            R2_q25  = boot_stats$R2_q25,\n            R2_q75  = boot_stats$R2_q75,\n            R2_q95  = boot_stats$R2_q95,\n            \n            RMSE_mean     = boot_stats$RMSE_mean,\n            RMSE_sd       = boot_stats$RMSE_sd,\n            RMSE_ppm_mean = boot_stats$RMSE_ppm_mean,\n            RMSE_ppm_sd   = boot_stats$RMSE_ppm_sd\n          )\n        \n        bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n        if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n          bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error = function(e) NULL)\n          if (!is.null(bp)) {\n            bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n            bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n          }\n        }\n        \n        # SW Diagnostics\n        sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n        if (length(resid_vals) >= 3) {\n          sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error = function(e) NULL)\n          if (!is.null(sh)) {\n            sh_W <- unname(sh$statistic)\n            sh_p <- sh$p.value\n          }\n        }\n        \n        diag_df <- dplyr::add_row(\n          diag_df,\n          Model             = mname,\n          Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n          Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n          Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n          BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n          BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n          BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n          CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n          CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n          AIC               = AIC_val,\n          AIC_expl          = \"Not used for     if (do_predictions) {\n          pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n            if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n              as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = XRF_new))\n            else if (!is.null(m))\n              as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = XRF_new))\n            else\n              rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new))\n          }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_,      error = function(e) NULL\n            )\n            if (!is.null(pi_obj)) {\n              lower_log <- pi_obj[, \"lwr\"]\n              upper_log <- pi_obj[, \"upr\"]\n            }\n U95_pc_ppm <- pred_ppm + (pred_ppm * (U95_log_pc / 100))\n          \n          preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_pc_ppm\")]] <- L95_pc_ppm\n          preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_pc_ppm\")]] <- bounds into centred asymmetric errors\n        \n        df_pred$Pred_err_low  <- df_pred$Predicted - df_pred$Pred_low\n        df_pred$Pred_err_high <- df_pred$Pred_high - df_pred$Predicted\n        \n  \n      # PLOT 1. Pred vs Obs plots WITH error bars (per element & model)\n  \n        # Axis limits must include full error bar extents\n        x_min <- min(df_pred$Obs_low,  na.rm = TRUE)\n        x_max <- max(df_pred$Obs_high, na.rm = TRUE)\n        \n        y_min <- min(df_pred$Predicted - axis_min)\n        axis_min_pad <- axis_min - pad\n        axis_max_pad <- axis_max + pad\n        \n        # --- annotation coordinates: top-left INSIDE the padded limits ---\n        ann_x <- axis_min_pad + 0.02 * (axis_max_pad - Force shared range so plots are square\n        axis_min <- min(x_min, y_min)\n        axis_max <- max(x_max, y_max)\n        \n        # Add small padding so points / error bars don't touch edges\n        pad <- 0.03 * (axis_max - axis_min)\n        axis_min_pad <- axis_min - pad\n        axis_max_pad <- axis_max + pad\n        \n        # Robustness score (scaled SNR + Ru00b2)\n  \n  global_summary <- global_summary %>%\n    dplyr::group_by(Element) %>%\n    dplyr::mutate(\n      SNR_CI_s      = scale01(SNR_CI),\n      SNR_smooth_s = scale01(SNR_smooth),\n      R2_s         = scale01(R2),\n      \n      Robustness_Score =\n        0.4 * SNR_CI_s +\n        0.3 * SNR_smooth_s +\n        0.3 * R2_s\n    ) %>%\n    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Robustness_Score), .by_group = TRUE) %>%\n    dplyr::mutate(\n      Robust_Rank = dplyr::row_number()\n    ) %>%\n    dplyr::ungroup()\n  \n  \n  # ADD BOOTSTRAP STABILITY FLAG\n  \n  global_summary <- global_summary %>%\n    dplyr::left_join(\n      bootstrap_summary,\n      by = c(\"Element\", \"Model\")\n    )\n  \n  global_summary <- global_summary %>%\n    dplyr::mutate(\n      Bootstrap_Unstable = ifelse(\n        !is.na(R2_q05) & !is.na(R2_q95) &\n          R2_q05 <= 0 & R2_q95 >= 0,\n        TRUE, FALSE\n      )\n    )\n  \n  # ROBUSTNESS UNCERTAINTY BANDS FROM BOOTSTRAP\n  global_summary <- global_summary %>%\n    dplyr::group_by(Element) %>%\n    dplyr::mutate(\n      # Scale bootstrap Ru00b2 bounds using same element-wise normalisation\n      R2_q05_s = scale01(R2_q05),\n      R2_q95_s = scale01(R2_q95),\n      \n      # Robustness uncertainty bands (diagnostic only)\n      Robustness_low =\n        0.4 * SNR_CI_s +\n        0.3 * SNR_smooth_s +\n        0.3 * R2_q05_s,\n      \n      Robustness_high =\n        0.4 * SNR_CI_s +\n        0.3 * SNR_smooth_s +\n        0.3 * R2_q95_s\n    ) %>%\n    dplyr::ungroup()\n  \n  # PATCH 3.1: GLOBAL_RANK using same priority as Section 11\n  global_summary <- global_summary %>%\n    dplyr::group_by(Element) %>%\n    dplyr::arrange(\n      dplyr::desc(Robustness_Score),\n      dplyr::desc(R2),\n      RMSE_ppm,\n      RMSEP,\n      .by_group = TRUE\n    ) %>%\n    dplyr::mutate(\n      Global_Rank = dplyr::row_number()\n    ) %>%\n    dplyr::ungroup()\n  \n  # 4. return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))\n    (x - r[1]) / diff(r)\n  }\n  \n  calc_snr_ci <- function(pred, lwr, upr) {\n    signal <- sd(pred, na.rm = TRUE)\n    noise  <- mean(upr - lwr, na.rm = TRUE)\n    ifelse(is.na(signal) | is.na(noise) | noise == 0,\n           NA_real_, signal / noise)\n  }\n  \n  calc_snr_smooth <- function(pred, depth = NULL) {\n    if (length(pred) < 6) return(NA_real_)\n    if (!is.null(depth)) pred <- pred[order(depth)]\n    d <- diff(pred)\n    if (all(is.na(d))) return(NA_real_)\n    1 / sd(d, na.rm = TRUE)\n  }\n  \n# for building heatmaps\n  class_to_numeric <- function(x) {\n    if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)\n    f <- factor(x)\n    as.numeric(f) / max(as.numeric(f), na.rm = TRUE)\n  }\n  \n  # Build robustness table\n\n  rows <- list()\n  \n  for (el in               "Yeah u2014 what youu2019re seeing is a *normal* consequence of doing intervals in log space and then exponentiating: the result is **lognormal** uncertainty, which is **multiplicative and asymmetric** in ppm. That often looks u201ctoo bigu201d at high values because the absolute width grows with the prediction.\n\nThe key point: you **can** express uncertainty as **percent (multiplicative) bands**, and you **can** apply those to new prediction-only datasets u2014 but only if those percent bands come from the *modelu2019s predictive uncertainty*, not from obsu2013pred pairs in the new dataset.\n\n## What to do instead (recommended)\n\n### 1) Keep doing intervals in log space, but report them as percent factors\nIf your model produces log-space intervals:\n- \\(\\hat\\mu\\) = predicted mean in log space  \n- \\(L\\) = log-space lower bound  \n- \\(U\\) = log-space upper bound  \n\nConvert to ppm:\n- \\(\\hat y = \\exp(\\hat\\mu)\\)\n- \\(L_{ppm} = \\exp(L)\\)\n- \\(U_{ppm} = \\exp(U)\\)\n\nNow compute *multiplicative* (percent) bands:\n- **Lower factor**: \\(f_L = \\hat y / L_{ppm} = \\exp(\\hat\\mu - L)\\)\n- **Upper factor**: \\(f_U = U_{ppm} / \\hat y = \\exp(U - \\hat\\mu)\\)\n\nPercent form:\n- \\(L\\% = 100 \\times (1 - 1/f_L)\\)\n- \\(U\\% = 100 \\times (f_U - 1)\\)\n\nThen for any new predicted ppm value \\(\\hat y\\), you can express the interval as:\n- \\( [\\hat y / f_L,\\; \\hat y \\cdot f_U] \\)\n\nThis is exactly what the exp-transform implies anyway u2014 it just makes the interpretation clearer (u201cu00b1X%u201d) rather than looking like crazy absolute ppm swings.\n\n## u201cBut my new dataset has no obsu2013pred pairsu201d\nThatu2019s fine. Prediction intervals **do not require observed y** in the new dataset u2014 they require:\n- the fitted model\n- the new X values\n- an uncertainty model (residual variance + parameter uncertainty, or an empirical method)\n\nSo the real question is: **how are you currently computing L95/U95?**\n\n### If itu2019s a regression model on log(y) (OLS/WLS/PLS with a parametric PI)\nYou can compute a proper prediction interval for each new row using:\n- the rowu2019s leverage / predictive standard error (depends on X)\n- residual variance in log space\n- t-quantile\n\nThis yields **row-specific log-space PI**, which you then exponentiate. No observed y needed.\n\n### If itu2019s RF/Bayes/etc.\nThen you need a model-appropriate uncertainty method, e.g.:\n- **quantile regression forests** (gives Q0.05/Q0.95 directly)\n- **bootstrap refit + predict** (gives per-row quantiles from the bootstrap prediction distribution)\n- **conformal prediction** (uses calibration residuals from training/validation to give valid intervals on new data)\n\n## A warning about u201cpercent of the valueu201d\nIf you mean: *compute a single global percent error from training and apply it everywhere*, thatu2019s usually **wrong** unless your residuals are truly homoscedastic in log space and youu2019re happy with a constant multiplicative error. bootstrap_model_performance <- function(\n          model_name,\n          formula,\n          data,\n          y_col,\n          n_boot     = 2000,\n          train_frac = 0.7,\n          best_ncomp = NA\n        ) {\n          \n          set.seed(123) # for reproducilbe bootstraps independent across elements/models\n        \n          if (model_name == \"RF\") {\n            if (n_boot > 500) {\n              message(\n                sprintf(\n                  \"  u21b3 RF bootstrap capped at %d resamples for computational stability\",\n                  500\n                )\n              )\n            }\n            n_boot <- min(n_boot, 500)\n          }\n  \n          \n          if (model_name %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\", \"PLS_kfold\")) {\n            if (n_boot > 2000) {\n              message(\n                sprintf(\n                  \"  u21b3 PLS bootstrap capped at %d resamples for computational stability\",\n                  2000\n                )\n              )\n            }\n            n_boot <- min(n_boot, 2000)\n          }\n      \n        n <- nrow(data)\n        n_train <- floor(train_frac * n)\n        \n        boot_rows <- vector(\"list\", n_boot)\n        \n        for (b in seq_len(n_boot)) {\n          \n          # ---- default row (ensures n_test always exists) ----\n          boot_rows[[b]] <- tibble::tibble(\n            n_test   = NA_integer_,\n            R2       = NA_real_,\n            RMSE     = NA_real_,\n            RMSE_ppm = NA_real_,\n            Failed   = TRUE\n          )\n          \n          idx_train <- sample(seq_len(n), size = n_train, replace = TRUE)\n          idx_test  <- setdiff(seq_len(n), unique(idx_train))\n          \n        if (length(idx_test) < 3) next\n        \n        train_dat <- data[idx_train, , drop = FALSE]\n        test_dat  <- data[idx_test,  , drop = FALSE]\n        \n          # ---- fit model ----\n          m <- tryCatch({\n            if (model_name %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\", \"PLS_kfold\")) {\n              pls <- plsr(formula, data = train_dat, scale = TRUE)\n              ncomp <- if (is.na(best_ncomp)) selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\") else best_ncomp\n              list(model = pls, ncomp = ncomp)\n            } else if (model_name == \"RF\") {\n              randomForest(formula, data = train_dat)\n            } else {\n              lm(formula, data = train_dat)\n            }\n          }, error = function(e) NULL)\n          \n          if (is.null(m)) next\n          \n          # ---- predict ----\n          pred <- tryCatch({\n            if (is.list(m) && inherits(m$model, \"mvr\")) {\n              as.numeric(predict(m$model, ncomp = m$ncomp, newdata = test_dat))\n            } else {\n              as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = test_dat))\n            }\n          }, error = function(e) NULL)\n          \n          obs <- test_dat[[y_col]]\n          if (is.null(pred) || length(pred) != length(obs)) next\n          \n          # ---- metrics ----\n          R2 <- tryCatch({\n            1 - sum((obs - pred)^2) / sum((obs - mean(obs))^2)\n          }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n          \n          RMSE <- sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))\n          \n          obs_ppm  <- exp(obs)\n          pred_ppm <- exp(pred)\n          \n          RMSE_ppm <- sqrt(mean((obs_ppm - pred_ppm)^2, na.rm = TRUE))\n          \n          boot_rows[[b]] <- tibble::tibble(\n            R2       = R2,\n            RMSE     = RMSE,\n            RMSE_ppm = RMSE_ppm,\n            n_test = length(obs),\n            Failed   = is.na(R2) | is.na(RMSE)\n          )\n        }\n        \n        boot_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(boot_rows)\n        \n        if (!\"n_test\" %in% names(boot_df)) {\n          boot_df$n_test <- NA_integer_\n        }\n        \n        if (nrow(boot_df) == 0) {\n          return(\n            tibble::tibble(\n              n_test_median  = NA_integer_,\n              n_success      = NA_integer_,\n              R2_mean        = NA_real_,\n              R2_sd          = NA_real_,\n              R2_q05         = NA_real_,\n              R2_q25         = NA_real_,\n              R2_q75         = NA_real_,\n              R2_q95         = NA_real_,\n              RMSE_mean      = NA_real_,\n              RMSE_sd        = NA_real_,\n              RMSE_ppm_mean  = NA_real_,\n              RMSE_ppm_sd    = NA_real_,\n              Failure_rate_pct = NA_real_\n            )\n          )\n        }\n        \n        boot_df %>%\n          dplyr::summarise(\n            n_test_median = median(n_test, na.rm = TRUE),\n            n_success = sum(!is.na(R2)),\n            R2_mean       = mean(R2, na.rm = TRUE),\n            R2_sd         = sd(R2, na.rm = TRUE),\n            R2_q05        = as.numeric(stats::quantile(R2, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)),\n            R2_q25        = as.numeric(stats::quantile(R2, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),\n            R2_q75        = as.numeric(stats::quantile(R2, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),\n            R2_q95        = as.numeric(stats::quantile(R2, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)),\n            RMSE_mean     = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),\n            RMSE_sd       = sd(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),\n            RMSE_ppm_mean = mean(RMSE_ppm, na.rm = TRUE),\n            RMSE_ppm_sd   = sd(RMSE_ppm, na.rm = TRUE),\n            \n            Failure_rate_pct = mean(Failed, na.rm = TRUE) * 100\n          )\n        }\n  \n  # 8.1-8.5 Fit models, Evaluate models, Boostrapping, Plotting, Save outputs ------------------\n    \n    # ELEMENT LOOP     \n        for (el in elements) {\n          \n          p_po_list <- list()\n          p_po_list_noerr <- list()\n          \n          stopifnot(is.list(p_po_list), is.list(p_po_list_noerr))\n          \n          pb_elements$tick()\n          \n          y_col   <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n          x_col   <- el\n          var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n          sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n          \n          # NEW LOCATION (requested change):\n          element_dir <- file.path(calib_base, el)\n          dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n          \n          errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n          if (length(errors) > 0)\n            warning(paste(\"Issues in\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n          \n          # Formulas\n          fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n          fmla_multi  <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \")))\n          \n          y <- data[[y_col]]\n      \n      # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n      # MODELS (never skip; failures -> NULL)\n      # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n        model_list <- list(\n          OLS = tryCatch(lm(fmla_single, data = data), error = function(e) NULL),\n          \n          WLS = tryCatch({\n            ols <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n            rm  <- lm(abs(ols$residuals) ~ ols$fitted.values)\n            w   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n            lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w)\n          }, error = function(e) NULL),\n          \n          OLS_weighted = tryCatch({\n            if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n              lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n            else NULL\n          }, error = function(e) NULL),\n          \n          WLS_weighted = tryCatch({\n            if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n              init <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n              rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n              w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n              lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2)\n            } else NULL\n          }, error = function(e) NULL),\n          \n          Bayes = tryCatch(bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data), error = function(e) NULL),\n          \n          RF = tryCatch(\n            randomForest(fmla_multi, data = data, ntree = 300, importance = TRUE),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          ),\n          \n          # Robustness uses relative ranking within element\n          # u2022\tRF variance stabilises early\n          # u2022\t300 OK instead of 500 trees - reduces computation time by 40-50%\n          \n          PLS_LOO = tryCatch({\n            pls <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n            best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n            attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n            pls\n          }, error = function(e) NULL),\n          \n          PLS_kfold = tryCatch({\n            pls <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE,\n                        validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n            best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n            attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n            pls\n          }, error = function(e) NULL)\n      )\n  \n  \n  # 8.2 Model loop & Evaluate model performance ----------------------------------\n  \n      # PER-ELEMENT TABLES & PRED DF SET UP\n        ranking_df <- tibble(\n          Model = character(),\n          R2    = numeric(),\n          RMSE  = numeric(),\n          RMSEP = numeric(),\n          RMSE_ppm  = numeric(),\n          RMSEP_ppm = numeric(),\n          AIC   = numeric(),\n          BIC   = numeric()\n        )\n        \n        diag_df <- tibble(\n          Model             = character(),\n          Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n          Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n          Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n          BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n          BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n          BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n          CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n          CV10_expl         = character(),\n          AIC               = numeric(),\n          AIC_expl          = character(),\n          BIC               = numeric(),\n          BIC_expl          = character()\n        )\n        \n        do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n        preds_df <- if (do_predictions) XRF_new else NULL\n        \n        pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n          format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n          total  = length(model_list),\n          clear  = FALSE,\n          width  = 70\n        )\n      \n      # MODEL LOOP\n        \n      for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n        \n        pb_models$tick()\n        m <- model_list[[mname]]\n        \n        model_t0 <- Sys.time()\n        \n        # Predictions on calibration data\n        pred <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n          else if (!is.null(m))\n            as.numeric(predict(m))\n          else\n            rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))\n        }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n        \n        resid_vals <- y - pred\n        \n        # Metrics\n        R2 <- tryCatch({\n          SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n          SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n          1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n        }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n        \n        RMSE <- tryCatch(\n          sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),\n          error = function(e) NA_real_\n        )\n        \n        cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n          fmla_single else fmla_multi\n        \n        RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n          cv_rmse_for_model(\n            mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n            var_col, sd_col,\n            best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n          ),\n          error = function(e) NA_real_\n        )\n        \n        # Compute RMSE in PPM scale (for comparability with ACE)\n        \n          # Convert observed + predicted back to ppm scale\n          obs_ppm  <- exp(y)\n          pred_ppm <- exp(pred)\n          \n          # Absolute RMSE in ppm\n          RMSE_ppm <- tryCatch(\n            sqrt(mean((obs_ppm - pred_ppm)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),\n            error = function(e) NA_real_\n          )\n          \n          # % RMSE relative to mean observed ppm\n          mean_obs_ppm <- mean(obs_ppm, na.rm = TRUE)\n          \n          RMSE_ppm_pc <- ifelse(\n            is.na(mean_obs_ppm) || mean_obs_ppm == 0,\n            NA_real_,\n            100 * RMSE_ppm / mean_obs_ppm\n          )\n        \n        # RMSEP in ppm scale (convert CV log predictions into ppm)\n        \n        RMSEP_ppm <- tryCatch(\n          {\n            # Use same CV predictions used for RMSEP_val, but convert them:\n            cv_log <- cv_predictions_for_model(      # You already have RMSEP_val fn\n              mname,\n              cv_formula,\n              data,\n              y_col,\n              var_col,\n              sd_col,\n              best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n            )\n            \n            if (is.null(cv_log)) {\n              NA_real_\n            } else {\n              cv_ppm <- exp(cv_log$pred)\n              obs_cv_ppm <- exp(cv_log$obs)\n              sqrt(mean((obs_cv_ppm - cv_ppm)^2, na.rm = TRUE))\n            }\n          },\n          error = function(e) NA_real_\n        )\n        \n        AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n          tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n        \n        BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n          tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n        \n        ranking_df <- dplyr::add_row(\n          ranking_df,\n          Model       = mname,\n          R2          = R2,\n          RMSE        = RMSE,\n          RMSEP       = RMSEP_val,\n          RMSE_ppm    = RMSE_ppm,\n          RMSEP_ppm   = RMSEP_ppm,\n          AIC         = AIC_val,\n          BIC         = BIC_val\n        )\n        \n        global_summary <- dplyr::add_row(\n          global_summary,\n          Element = el,\n          Model   = mname,\n          R2      = R2,\n          RMSE    = RMSE,\n          RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n          RMSE_ppm    = RMSE_ppm,\n          RMSEP_ppm   = RMSEP_ppm,\n          AIC     = AIC_val,\n          BIC     = BIC_val\n        )\n        \n  \n  # 8.3 Bootstrap diagnostics -----------------------------------------------\n        \n        boot_stats <- bootstrap_model_performance(\n          model_name = mname,\n          formula    = cv_formula,\n          data       = data,\n          y_col      = y_col,\n          n_boot     = 2000,\n          train_frac = 0.8,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        )\n        \n        # RF instability warning\n        if (mname == \"RF\" &&\n            !is.na(boot_stats$Failure_rate_pct) &&\n            boot_stats$Failure_rate_pct > 30) {\n          \n          warning(\n            sprintf(\n              \"RF unstable for %s: %.1f%% bootstrap failures\",\n              el,\n              boot_stats$Failure_rate_pct\n            )\n          )\n        }\n        \n        # STORE BOOTSTRAP vs NON-BOOTSTRAP COMPARISON (PER MODEL)\n  \n        boot_compare_row <- tibble::tibble(\n          Element = el,\n          Model   = mname,\n          \n          # Bootstrap diagnostics (from function output)\n          n_test_median    = boot_stats$n_test_median,\n          n_success        = boot_stats$RMSE_mean,\n          RMSE_sd          = boot_stats$RMSE_sd,\n          RMSE_ppm_mean    = boot_stats$RMSE_ppm_mean,\n          RMSE_ppm_sd      = boot_stats$RMSE_ppm_sd\n        )\n        \n        bootstrap_compare_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(\n          bootstrap_compare_df,\n          boot_compare_row\n        )\n        \n        # Store per-model bootstrap summary (for Section 11)\n        \n        bootstrap_store[[paste(el, mname, sep = \"__\")]] <-\n          tibble::tibble(\n            Element = el,\n            Model   = mname,\n            \n            n_test_median    = boot_stats$n_test_median,\n            n_success        = boot_stats$n_success,\n            Failure_rate_pct = boot_stats$Failure_rate_pct,\n            \n            R2_mean          = boot_stats$R2_mean,\n            R2_sd            = boot_stats$R2_sd,\n            R2_q05           = boot_stats$R2_q05,\n            R2_q25           = boot_stats$R2_q25,\n            R2_q75           = boot_stats$R2_q75,\n            R2_q95           = boot_stats$R2_q95,\n            \n            RMSE_mean        = boot_stats$RMSE_mean,\n            RMSE_sd          = boot_stats$RMSE_sd,\n            RMSE_ppm_mean    = boot_stats$RMSE_ppm_mean,\n            RMSE_ppm_sd      = boot_stats$RMSE_ppm_sd\n          )\n        \n        bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n        if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n          bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error = function(e) NULL)\n          if (!is.null(bp)) {\n            bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n            bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n          }\n        }\n        \n        # SW Diagnostics\n        sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n        if (length(resid_vals) >= 3) {\n          sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error = function(e) diag_df,\n          Model             = mname,\n          Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n          Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n          Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n          BreuschPagan_stat =       L95_log_pc <- (safe_pred_log - lower_log) / safe_pred_log * 100\n          U95_log_pc <- (upper_log - safe_pred_log) / safe_pred_log * 100\n          \n          preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_pc_ppm\")]] <- U95_pc_ppm\n        }\n        \n  # 8.4 Plotting ------------------------------------------------------------\n  \n        # Pred vs Obs, Residuals,  dplyr::filter(\n              Element == el,\n              Model   == mname\n            )\n          \n          if (nrow(boot_row) == 1 && \"RMSE_ppm_sd\" %in% names(boot_row)) {\n df_pred <- data.frame(\n          Observed  = y,\n          Predicted = pred,\n          Site      = data$Site\n        )\n        \n        # Add u00b1SD error bars (Observed: ICP-MS SD)\n        \n        # ICP-MS SD u2192 horizontal bars (Observed / x-axis)\n        icp_sd_col <- paste0(el, \"_ICP_sd\")   # e.g. \"Ti_ICP_sd\"\n        \n        df_pred$Obs_low   <- df_pred$Observed\n if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\", \"glm\")) && !inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n          \n          pi_obj <- tryCatch(\n            predict(\n              m,\n              newdata  = data,\n              interval = \"prediction\",\n              level    = 0.95\n            ),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          \n          # Use only if prediction intervals are actually BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n      CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n      CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n      AIC               = AIC_val,\n      AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\n      BIC               = BIC_val,\n      BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\n    )\n\n    # Predictions for XRF_new  (log-space and ppm)\n\n    if (do_predictions) {\n      pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = XRF_new))\n        else if (!is.null(m))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = XRF_new))\n        else\n          rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new))\n      }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new)))\n\n      lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n      upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n\n      if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\") && !is.null(m)) {\n        pi_obj <- tryCatch(\n          predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, interval = \"prediction\", level = 0.95),\n          error = function(e) NULL\n        )\n        if (!is.null(pi_obj)) {\n          lower_log <- pi_obj[, \"lwr\"]\n          upper_log <- pi_obj[, \"upr\"]\n        }\n      }\n\n      base_nm <- paste0(mname, \"_\", el)\n\n      # ppm-scale values (original PI)\n\n      preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_Pred_ppm\")]] <- exp(pred_new_log)\n      preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_ppm\")]]  <- exp(lower_log)\n      preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_ppm\")]]  <- exp(upper_log)\n\n      # log-space % error AND ppm-scale % error intervals\n      safe_pred_log <- ifelse(is.na(pred_new_log) | pred_new_log == 0, NA, pred_new_log)\n\n      L95_log_pc <- (safe_pred_log - lower_log) / safe_pred_log * 100\n      U95_log_pc <- (upper_log - safe_pred_log) / safe_pred_log * 100\n\n      preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_log_pc\")]] <- L95_log_pc\n      preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_log_pc\")]] <- U95_log_pc\n\n      pred_ppm <- exp(pred_new_log)\n      L95_pc_ppm <- pred_ppm - (pred_ppm * (L95_log_pc / 100))\n      U95_pc_ppm <- pred_ppm + (pred_ppm * (U95_log_pc / 100))\n\n      preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_pc_ppm\")]] <- L95_pc_ppm\n      preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_pc_ppm\")]] <- U95_pc_ppm\n\n      # -------------------------------------------------------------------\n      # NEW METHOD A: LOG-NORMAL % CI (multiplicative) using RMSE in log-space\n      # Adds: *_L95_lognorm_ppm, *_U95_lognorm_ppm, *_L95_lognorm_pc, *_U95_lognorm_pc\n      # -------------------------------------------------------------------\n      factor_lognorm <- ifelse(is.na(RMSE), NA_real_, exp(1.96 * RMSE))\n\n      preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_lognorm_ppm\")]] <- pred_ppm / factor_lognorm\n      preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_lognorm_ppm\")]] <- pred_ppm * factor_lognorm\n\n      # Percent below/above (constant per model, repeated per row)\n      preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_lognorm_pc\")]] <- (1 - (1 / factor_lognorm)) * 100\n      preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_lognorm_pc\")]] <- (factor_lognorm - 1) * 100\n\n      # -------------------------------------------------------------------\n      # NEW METHOD B: BOOTSTRAP PREDICTIVE CI (ppm) on XRF_new (row-wise)\n      # Adds: *_L95_boot_ppm, *_U95_boot_ppm, *_boot_nsuccess\n      # -------------------------------------------------------------------\n      boot_ci <- tryCatch(\n        bootstrap_predictive_ci(\n          model_name = mname,\n          formula    = cv_formula,\n          data       = data,\n          newdata    = XRF_new,\n          n_boot     = 2000,\n          train_frac = 0.8,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NULL\n      )\n\n      if (!is.null(boot_ci)) {\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_boot_ppm\")]] <- boot_ci$L95_boot_ppm\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_boot_ppm\")]] <- boot_ci$U95_boot_ppm\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_boot_nsuccess\")]] <- boot_ci$n_success\n      } else {\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_boot_ppm\")]] <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new))\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_boot_ppm\")]] <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new))\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_boot_nsuccess\")]] <- NA_integer_\n      }\n    }\n\n    # 8.4 Plotting ------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    # Pred vs Obs, Residuals, Influence, PLS RMSEP\n\n    # Number of datapoints actually plotted\n    n_points <- sum(!is.na(y) & !is.na(pred))\n    #\"\\nRu00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\n\n    # ---- Bootstrap RMSE_ppm SD lookup (SAFE) ----\n    RMSE_ppm_sd <- NA_real_\n\n    if (length(bootstrap_store) > 0) {\n      boot_row <- dplyr::bind_rows(bootstrap_store) %>%\n        dplyr::filter(\n          Element == el,\n          Model   == mname\n        )\n\n      if (nrow(boot_row) == 1 && \"RMSE_ppm_sd\" %in% names(boot_row)) {\n        RMSE_ppm_sd <- boot_row$RMSE_ppm_sd\n      }\n    }\n\n    stats_label <- paste0(\n      \"\\nRu00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\n      \"\\nRMSE = \", signif(RMSE, 4),\n      \"\\nRMSEP = \",\n      signif(RMSE_ppm, 4),\n      if (!is.na(RMSE_ppm_sd))\n        paste0(\" \\u00B1 \", signif(RMSE_ppm_sd, 3))\n      else \"\"\n    )\n\n    df_pred <- data.frame(\n      Observed  = y,\n      Predicted = pred,\n      Site      = data$Site\n    )\n\n    # Add u00b1SD error bars (Observed: ICP-MS SD)\n\n    # ICP-MS SD u2192 horizontal bars (Observed / x-axis)\n    icp_sd_col <- paste0(el, \"_ICP_sd\")   # e.g. \"Ti_ICP_sd\"\n\n    df_pred$Obs_low   <- df_pred$Observed\n    df_pred$Obs_high  <- df_pred$Observed\n\n    if (icp_sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      sd_icp <- data[[icp_sd_col]]\n      df_pred$Obs_low  <- df_pred$Observed - sd_icp\n      df_pred$Obs_high <- {\n\n      pi_obj <- tryCatch(\n        predict(\n          m,\n          newdata  = data,\n          interval = \"prediction\",\n          level    = 0.95\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NULL\n      )\n\n      # Use only if prediction intervals are actually returned\n      if (!is.null(pi_obj) &&\n          is.matrix(pi_obj) &&\n          ncol(pi_obj) >= 3) {\n\n        # Columns are positionally: fit | lwr | upr\n        df_pred$Pred_low  <- pi_obj[, 2]\n        df_pred$Pred_high <- pi_obj[, 3]\n      }\n\n    } else {\n      # bayesglm, RF, PLS u2192 RMSE-based fallback\n      df_pred$Pred_low  <- df_pred$Predicted - 1.96 * RMSE\n      df_pred$Pred_high <- df_pred$Predicted + 1.96 * RMSE\n    }\n\n    # Convert CI bounds into centred asymmetric errors\n\n    df_pred$Pred_err_low  <- df_pred$Predicted - df_pred$Pred_low\n    df_pred$Pred_err_high <- df_pred$Pred_high - df_pred$Predicted\n\n\n    # PLOT 1. Pred vs Obs plots WITH error bars (per element & model)\n\n    # Axis limits must include full error bar extents\n    x_min <- min(df_pred$Obs_low,  na.rm = TRUE)\n    x_max <- max(df_pred$Obs_high, na.rm = TRUE)\n\n    y_min <- min(df_pred$Predicted -               "Below are the four deliverables you asked for, with **reviewer-proof wording**, **explicit mapping of each equation to the literature**, and **copy-paste Word Equation Editor (linear) equations**.\n\nIu2019ve also anchored the palaeo parts to **verifiable, peer-reviewed sources** that explicitly treat (i) SNR in proxy records, (ii) uncertainty in reconstructions/calibration, and (iii) prediction intervals/ensemble uncertainty. ue200citeue202turn1search0ue202turn0search12ue202turn0search9ue202turn1search6ue202turn0search2ue202turn1search3ue202turn0search3ue201\n\n---\n\n# A) Reviewer-proof Methods text (ready to paste)\n\n### Methods: robustness, uncertainty dominance, and stability screening  \nWe quantified model robustness using a transparent set of metrics describing (i) **uncertainty dominance** and (ii) **downcore stability** of predicted geochemical series, then combined these into a **composite robustness index** used for model ranking. Proxy- and reconstruction-focused studies commonly frame reconstruction skill as a balance between **signal and noise/uncertainty**, including explicit estimation of proxy signal content via signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) and formal accounting of reconstruction uncertainty. ue200citeue202turn1search0ue202turn0search9ue202turn1search6ue201  \n\nFor each element and model, we considered the predicted ppm series \\(\\{\\hat{y}_i\\}_{i=1}^{n}\\) along depth (or age), and its associated 95% uncertainty bounds \\(\\{(L_i,U_i)\\}_{i=1}^{n}\\). Mean predictive uncertainty width was defined as \\(\\bar{w}=(1/n)\\sum_i(U_i-L_i)\\). We defined a **CI-based SNR** as \\(SNR_{CI}=sd(\\hat{y})/\\bar{w}\\), representing the extent to which downcore variability exceeds uncertainty width (i.e., signal dominance relative to model uncertainty). This formulation is consistent with the general SNR framework used to characterise proxy signal content, while explicitly using prediction-interval width as the u201cnoise/uncertaintyu201d term. ue200citeue202turn1search0ue202turn1search6ue201  \n\nTo quantify downcore stability, we computed first differences \\(\\Delta\\hat{y}_i=\\hat{y}_i-\\hat{y}_{i-1}\\) and defined **roughness** as \\(R=sd(\\Delta\\hat{y})\\); we additionally defined a smoothness SNR as \\(SNR_{smooth}=sd(\\hat{y})/sd(\\Delta\\hat{y})\\), so that high values indicate coherent low-frequency structure rather than high-frequency jaggedness. First-difference variability (e.g., standard deviation of the first derivative) is a well-established time-series stability descriptor in the broader signal-processing literature, and is directly applicable to stratigraphic sequences. ue200citeue202turn2view0ue201  \n\nMetrics were converted to **0u20131 indices** via minu2013max scaling \\(X_s=(X-\\min(X))/(\\max(X)-\\min(X))\\) within each element (and within each site for site-specific analysis). We then defined a global composite robustness score as  \n\\(Robustness = 0.4\\cdot SNR_{CI,s} + 0.3\\cdot SNR_{smooth,s} + 0.3\\cdot R^2_s\\),  \nand a site-specific score as  \n\\(Robustness_{site} = 0.6\\cdot SNR_{CI,s} + 0.4\\cdot SNR_{smooth,s}\\).  \nUsing a weighted composite index is a standard and transparent approach for combining multiple performance dimensions, provided that components and weights are reported and sensitivity acknowledged; this aligns with best-practice discussions of composite indicators. ue200citeue202turn1search3ue202turn1search11ue201  \n\nFinally, we screened for unstable downcore behaviour using a normalised roughness index \\(R_{norm}\\) (minu2013max scaled within element) and flagged instability when \\(R_{norm} > 0.7\\). Uncertainty intervals for nonlinear/ensemble models were additionally supported by distributional/quantile-based ensemble methods (e.g., quantile regression forests) that provide a principled basis for predictive quantiles. ue200citeue202turn0search3ue202turn0search11ue201  \n\n*(If you want, I can add one sentence explicitly stating that the 0.7 threshold is a pragmatic screening criterion and that conclusions are robust to moderate changesu2014this often pre-empts reviewer pushback.)*\n\n---\n\n# B) Word-equation panel (copy-paste into Word Equation Editor)\n\n**Paste each line into Word via Insert u2192 Equation (linear input).**  \n(If you want a u201cboxed panelu201d: put these equations inside a 1u00d71 table cell.)\n\n### Definitions\n```\nwu0304 = (1/n) u2211u1d62 (Uu1d62 u2212 Lu1d62)\n```\n\n```\nSNR_CI = sd(u0177u2081, u2026 , u0177u2099) / wu0304\n```\n\n```\nu0394u0177u1d62 = u0177u1d62 u2212 u0177u1d62u208bu2081\n```\n\n```\nR = sd(u0394u0177)\n```\n\n```\nSNR_smooth = sd(u0177u2081, u2026 , u0177u2099) / sd(u0394u0177)\n```\n\n### Scaling to indices\n```\nX_s = (X u2212 min(X)) / (max(X) u2212 min(X))\n```\n\n```\nSNR_CI_s = (SNR_CI u2212 min(SNR_CI)) / (max(SNR_CI) u2212 min(SNR_CI))\n```\n\n```\nSNR_smooth_s = (SNR_smooth u2212 min(SNR_smooth)) / (max(SNR_smooth) u2212 min(SNR_smooth))\n```\n\n```\nRu00b2_s = (Ru00b2 u2212 min(Ru00b2)) / (max(Ru00b2) u2212 min(Ru00b2))\n```\n\n```\nR_norm = (R u2212 min(R)) / (max(R) u2212 min(R))\n```\n\n### Composite robustness\n```\nRobustness = 0.4u00b7SNR_CI_s + 0.3u00b7SNR_smooth_s + 0.3u00b7Ru00b2_s\n```\n\n```\nRobustness_site = 0.6u00b7SNR_CI_s + 0.4u00b7SNR_smooth_s\n```\n\n### Instability flag\n```\nUnstable = { 1,  if  R_norm > 0.7 ;               "Hereu2019s a **clear, reviewer-proof explanation** you can use both for yourself *and* verbatim (or lightly edited) in a paper or methods response.\n\n---\n\n## 1) What **Ru00b2** measures\n\n\\[\nR^2 = 1 - \\frac{\\sum_{i=1}^{n}(y_i - \\hat{y}_i)^2}{\\sum_{i=1}^{n}(y_i - \\bar{y})^2}\n\\]\n\n**Interpretation**\n\n- Fraction of variance in the observed data explained by the model  \n- Ranges from \\(-\\infty\\) to 1 (though usually reported as 0u20131)\n- **Always increases or stays the same when predictors are added**, even if they are useless\n\n**Key limitation**\n\n> Ru00b2 rewards model complexity u2014 adding noise predictors can artificially inflate it.\n\n---\n\n## 2) What **Adjusted Ru00b2** measures\n\n\\[\nR^2_{\\text{adj}} =\n1 - (1 - R^2)\\,\\frac{n - 1}{n - p - 1}\n\\]\n\nwhere:\n- \\(n\\) = number of observations  \n- \\(p\\) = number of predictors (excluding intercept)\n\n**Interpretation**\n\n- Penalised version of Ru00b2 that accounts for model complexity  \n- Can **decrease** when a predictor does not improve the model enough  \n- Enables fair comparison between models with different numbers of predictors\n\n---\n\n## 3) Practical difference (intuition)\n\n| Scenario | Ru00b2 | Adjusted Ru00b2 |\n|--------|----|-------------|\n| Add meaningful predictor | u2191 | u2191 |\n| Add weak/noisy predictor | u2191 | u2193 |\n| Compare simple vs complex model | Biased | Fair |\n\n**Rule of thumb**\n\n> If Ru00b2 increases but adjusted Ru00b2 decreases, the new predictor is not justified.\n\n---\n\n## 4) Why this matters for your workflow\n\nIn your calibration framework:\n\n- **Ru00b2** answers  \n  u2192 *u201cHow much variance can this model explain?u201d*\n\n- **Adjusted Ru00b2** answers  \n  u2192 *u201cIs the added complexity of this model actually justified?u201d*\n\nThis is particularly important because you are comparing:\n- Univariate vs multivariate models\n- Linear vs PLS vs RF\n- Models with very different effective dimensionality\n\n---\n\n## 5) Why reviewers care about adjusted Ru00b2\n\nReviewers often object to model comparisons that rely only on Ru00b2 because:\n\n- Multivariate models almost always u201cwinu201d on raw Ru00b2\n- Adjusted Ru00b2 exposes overfitting\n- It demonstrates that model selection was **principled**, not opportunistic\n\nIncluding both shows:\n> u201cWe evaluated both explanatory power and parsimony.u201d\n\n---\n\n## 6) When NOT to over-interpret adjusted Ru00b2\n\nAdjusted Ru00b2:\n- Is **not** a prediction metric  \n- Does **not** replace RMSEP, CV error, or bootstrap performance\n- Is less meaningful for non-parametric models (RF), but still useful as a heuristic\n\nThatu2019s why your pipeline correctly uses:\n- Ru00b2 / Adj Ru00b2 u2192 fit quality  \n- RMSEP / bootstrap RMSE u2192 predictive skill  \n- SNR / smoothness u2192 downcore stability  \n\n---\n\n## 7) One-sentence methods wording (you can paste this)\n\n> *Model fit was 8.3 Bootstrap diagnostics -----------------------------------------------\n      \n      boot_stats <- bootstrap_model_performance(\n        model_name = mname,\n        formula    = cv_formula,\n        data       = data,\n        y_col      = y_col,\n        n_boot     = 2000,\n        train_frac = 0.8,\n        best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n      )\n      \n      # numeric(),\n      Adj_R2 = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      RMSE_ppm  = numeric(),\n      # ---- NEW: RMSEP ppm comparison + provenance\n      RMSEP_ppm_cv      = numeric(), # cv used if available - boot if not\n      RMSEP_ppm_boot    = numeric(),\n      RMSEP_ppm_boot_sd = numeric(),\n      RMSEP_ppm         = numeric(),   # keep as \"used\" value for downstream code\n      RMSEP_source      = character(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n    \n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n    \n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    preds_df <- if (do_predictions) XRF_new else NULL\n    \n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n    \n    # MODEL LOOP\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n      \n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n      \n      model_t0 <- Sys.time()\n      \n      # defaults so add_row doesn't fails (boot values filled later) \n      RMSEP_ppm_cv      <- NA_real_\n      RMSEP_ppm_boot    <- NA_real_\n      RMSEP_ppm_boot_sd <- NA_real_\n      RMSEP_ppm         <- NA_real_\n      RMSEP_source      <- NA_character_\n      \n      # Predictions on calibration data\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        else if (!is.null(m))\n          as.numeric(predict(m))\n        else\n          rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))\n      }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n      \n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n      \n      # Metrics\n      \n      # Sum-of-Squares Ru00b2 (log-space)\n      R2 <- tryCatch({\n        SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      \n      # Adjusted Ru00b2 (use built-in adj.r.squared for lm only)\n      Adj_R2 <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, \"lm\") && !inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n        Adj_R2 <- tryCatch(summary(m)$adj.r.squared, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      }\n      \n      # RMSE (log-space)\n      RMSE <- tryCatch(\n        sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n        fmla_single else fmla_multi\n      \n      # RMSEP (mg kg-1)\n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      # Compute RMSE in PPM scale (for comparability with ACE)\n      \n      # Convert observed + predicted back to ppm scale\n      obs_ppm  <- exp(y)\n      pred_ppm <- exp(pred)\n      \n      # Absolute RMSE in ppm\n      RMSE_ppm <- tryCatch(\n        sqrt(mean((obs_ppm - pred_ppm)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      # % RMSE relative to mean observed ppm\n      mean_obs_ppm <- mean(obs_ppm, na.rm = TRUE)\n      \n      RMSE_ppm_pc <- ifelse(\n        is.na(mean_obs_ppm) || mean_obs_ppm == 0,\n        NA_real_,\n        100 * RMSE_ppm / mean_obs_ppm\n      )\n      \n      # RMSEP in ppm scale (CV-based, if available)\n      RMSEP_ppm_cv <- tryCatch(\n        {\n          cv_log <- \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n          )\n          \n          if (is.null(cv_log)) {\n            NA_real_\n          } else {\n            cv_ppm     <- exp(cv_log$pred)\n            obs_cv_ppm <- exp(cv_log$obs)\n            sqrt(mean((obs_cv_ppm - cv_ppm)^2, na.rm = TRUE))\n          }\n        },\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      ranking_df <- dplyr::add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model       = mname,\n        R2          = R2,\n        Adj_R2      = Adj_R2,\n        RMSE        = RMSE,\n        RMSEP       = RMSEP_val,\n        RMSE_ppm    = RMSE_ppm,\n        \n        RMSEP_ppm_cv      = RMSEP_ppm_cv,\n        RMSEP_ppm_boot    = RMSEP_ppm_boot,\n        RMSEP_ppm_boot_sd = RMSEP_ppm_boot_sd,\n        RMSEP_ppm         = RMSEP_ppm,\n        RMSEP_source      = RMSEP_source,\n        \n        AIC         = AIC_val,\n        BIC         = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      # Add Adj_R2 to global_summary if the column exists\n      # (prevents add_row \"can't find column Adj_R2\" error)\n\n      if (\"Adj_R2\" %in% names(global_summary)) {\n        \n        global_summary <- dplyr::add_row(\n          global_summary,\n          Element   = el,\n          Model     = mname,\n          R2        = R2,\n          Adj_R2    = Adj_R2,\n          RMSE      = RMSE,\n          RMSEP     = RMSEP_val,\n          RMSE_ppm  = RMSE_ppm,\n          RMSEP_ppm_cv      = RMSEP_ppm_cv,\n          RMSEP_ppm_boot    = RMSEP_ppm_boot,\n          RMSEP_ppm_boot_sd = RMSEP_ppm_boot_sd,\n          RMSEP_ppm         = RMSEP_ppm,\n          RMSEP_source      = RMSEP_source,\n          AIC       = AIC_val,\n          BIC       = BIC_val\n        )\n        \n      } else {\n        \n        global_summary <- dplyr::add_row(\n          global_summary,\n          Element   = el,\n          Model     = mname,\n          R2        = R2,\n          RMSE      = RMSE,\n          RMSEP     = RMSEP_val,\n          RMSE_ppm  = RMSE_ppm,\n          RMSEP_ppm_cv      = RMSEP_ppm_cv,\n          RMSEP_ppm_boot    = RMSEP_ppm_boot,\n          RMSEP_ppm_boot_sd = RMSEP_ppm_boot_sd,\n          RMSEP_ppm         = RMSEP_ppm,\n          RMSEP_source      = RMSEP_source,\n          AIC       = AIC_val,\n          BIC       = BIC_val\n        )\n      }\n      \n      # 8.3 Bootstrap diagnostics -----------------------------------------------\n      \n      boot_stats <- bootstrap_model_performance(\n        model_name = mname,\n        formula    = cv_formula,\n        data       = data,\n        y_col      = y_col,\n        n_boot     = 2000,\n        train_frac = 0.7,\n        best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n      )\n      \n      # Bootstrap RMSEP in ppm (mean u00b1 sd)\n      RMSEP_ppm_boot    <- boot_stats$RMSE_ppm_mean\n      RMSEP_ppm_boot_sd <- boot_stats$RMSE_ppm_sd\n      \n      if (is.null(RMSEP_ppm_boot) || length(RMSEP_ppm_boot) == 0) RMSEP_ppm_boot <- NA_real_\n      if (is.null(RMSEP_ppm_boot_sd) || length(RMSEP_ppm_boot_sd) == 0) RMSEP_ppm_boot_sd <- NA_real_\n      \n      # Choose RMSEP_ppm used + provenance flag - Prefer CV if available, else bootstrap\n      RMSEP_ppm <- if (!is.na(RMSEP_ppm_cv)) RMSEP_ppm_cv else RMSEP_ppm_boot\n      RMSEP_source <- if (!is.na(RMSEP_ppm_cv)) \"cv\" else \"bootstrap\"\n      \n      # RF instability warning\n      if (mname == \"RF\" &&\n          !is.na(boot_stats$Failure_rate_pct) &&\n          boot_stats$Failure_rate_pct > 30) {\n        \n        warning(\n          sprintf(\n            \"RF unstable for %s: %.1f%% bootstrap failures\",\n            el,\n            boot_stats$Failure_rate_pct\n          )\n        )\n      }\n      \n      # STORE BOOTSTRAP vs NON-BOOTSTRAP COMPARISON (PER MODEL)\n      \n      boot_compare_row <- tibble::tibble(\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        \n        # Bootstrap diagnostics (from function output)\n        n_test_median    = boot_stats$n_test_median,\n        n_success        = boot_stats$n_success,\n        Failure_rate_pct = boot_stats$Failure_rate_pct,\n        \n        # Non-bootstrap\n        R2_single        = R2,\n        RMSE_single      = RMSE,\n        RMSE_ppm_single  = RMSE_ppm,\n        \n        # Bootstrap summary\n        R2_mean          = boot_stats$R2_mean,\n        R2_sd            = boot_stats$R2_sd,\n        R2_q05           = boot_stats$RMSE_mean,\n        RMSE_sd          = boot_stats$RMSE_sd,\n        RMSE_ppm_mean    = boot_stats$RMSE_ppm_mean,\n        RMSE_ppm_sd      = boot_stats$RMSE_ppm_sd\n      )\n      \n      bootstrap_compare_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(\n        bootstrap_compare_df,\n        boot_compare_row\n      )\n      \n      # Store per-model bootstrap summary (for Section 11)\n      \n      bootstrap_store[[paste(el, mname, sep = \"__\")]] <-\n        tibble::tibble(\n          Element = el,\n          Model   = mname,\n          \n          n_test_median    = boot_stats$n_test_median,\n RMSE_ppm_sd      = boot_stats$RMSE_ppm_sd\n        )\n      \n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n      \n      # SW Diagnostics\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if      Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n used for ranking.\"\n      )\n      \n      # Predictions for XRF_new  (log-space and ppm)\n      \n      if (do_predictions) {\n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = XRF_new))\n          else if (!is.null(m))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = XRF_new))\n          else\n            rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new))\n        }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new)))\n        \n        lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n        upper_log <- XRF_new, interval = \"prediction\", level = 0.95),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(pi_obj)) {\n            lower_log <- pi_obj[, \"lwr\"]\n            upper_log <- pi_obj[, \"upr\"]\n          }\n        }\n        \n        base_nm <- paste0(mname, \"_\", el)\n        \n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_Pred_ppm\")]] <- exp(pred_new_log)\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_ppm\")]]  <- exp(lower_log)\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_ppm\")]]  <- exp(upper_log)\n        \n        safe_pred_log <- ifelse(is.na(pred_new_log) | pred_new_log == 0, NA, pred_new_log)\n        \n        L95_log_pc <- (safe_pred_log - lower_log) / safe_pred_log * 100\n        U95_log_pc <- (upper_log - safe_pred_log) / safe_pred_log * 100\n        \n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_log_pc\")]] <- L95_log_pc\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_log_pc\")]] <- U95_log_pc\n        \n        pred_ppm <- exp(pred_new_log)\n        L95_pc_ppm <- pred_ppm - (pred_ppm * (L95_log_pc / 100))\n        U95_pc_ppm <- pred_ppm + (pred_ppm * (U95_log_pc / 100))\n        \n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_pc_ppm\")]] <- L95_pc_ppm\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_pc_ppm\")]] <- U95_pc_ppm\n        \n        factor_lognorm <- ifelse(is.na(RMSE), NA_real_, exp(1.96 * RMSE))\n        \n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_lognorm_ppm\")]] <- pred_ppm / factor_lognorm\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_lognorm_ppm\")]] <- pred_ppm * factor_lognorm\n        \n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_lognorm_pc\")]] <- (1 - (1 / factor_lognorm)) * 100\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_lognorm_pc\")]] <- (factor_lognorm - 1) * 100\n        \n        boot_ci <- tryCatch(\n          bootstrap_predictive_ci(\n            model_name = mname,\n            formula    = cv_formula,\n            data       = data,\n            newdata    = XRF_new,\n            n_boot     = 2000,\n            train_frac = 0.7,\n            best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n          ),\n          error = function(e) NULL\n        )\n        \n        if (!is.null(boot_ci)) {\n          preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_boot_ppm\")]] <- boot_ci$L95_boot_ppm\n          preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_boot_ppm\")]] <- boot_ci$U95_boot_ppm\n          preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_boot_nsuccess\")]] <- boot_ci$n_success\n        } else {\n          preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_L95_boot_ppm\")]] <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new))\n          preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_U95_boot_ppm\")]] <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new))\n          preds_df[[paste0(base_nm, \"_boot_nsuccess\")]] <- NA_integer_\n        }\n      }\n      \n      # 8.4 Plotting ------------------------------------------------------------\n      \n      # Pred vs Obs, Residuals, Influence, PLS RMSEP\n      \n      n_points <- sum(!is.na(y) & !is.na(pred))\n      \n      RMSE_ppm_sd   <- NA_real_\n      RMSE_ppm_mean <- NA_real_\n      \n      if (length(bootstrap_store) > 0) {\n        boot_row <- dplyr::bind_rows(bootstrap_store) %>%\n          dplyr::filter(Element == el, Model == mname)\n        \n        if (nrow(boot_row) == 1) {\n          if (\"RMSE_ppm_sd\" %in% names(boot_row)) {\n            RMSE_ppm_sd <- boot_row$RMSE_ppm_sd\n          }\n          if (\"RMSE_ppm_mean\" %in% names(boot_row)) {\n            RMSE_ppm_mean <- boot_row$RMSE_ppm_mean\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      \n      # Use bootstrapped mean if available, otherwise fall back to single-run RMSE_ppm\n      RMSEP_label_val <- ifelse(\n        !is.na(RMSE_ppm_mean),\n        RMSE_ppm_mean,\n        RMSE_ppm\n      )\n\n      # Add summary outut labels to claibration plots\n      \n      stats_label <- paste0(\n        \"\\nRu00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\n        if (!is.na(Adj_R2)) paste0(\"\\nAdj Ru00b2 = \", signif(Adj_R2, Observed  = y,\n        Predicted = pred,\n        Site      = data$Site\n      )\n      \n      # Add u00b1SD error bars (Observed: ICP-MS SD)\n      \n      # ICP-MS SD u2192 horizontal bars (Observed / x-axis)\n      icp_sd_col <- paste0(el, \"_ICP_sd\")   # e.g. \"Ti_ICP_sd\"\n      \n      df_pred$Obs_low   <- df_pred$Observed\n      df_pred$Obs_high  <- df_pred$Observed\n      \n      if (icp_sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n        sd_icp <- data[[icp_sd_col]]\n        df_pred$Obs_low  <- df_pred$Observed - sd_icp\n        df_pred$Obs_high <- df_pred$Observed + sd_icp\n      }\n      \n      # Add model CI (95%) for vertical prediction error bars\n      # FULL CORRECTED CI DECISION LOGIC\n      \n      # Default: no CI\n      df_pred$Pred_low  <- df_pred$Predicted\n      df_pred$Pred_high <- df_pred$Predicted\n      \n      # Use prediction intervals ONLY for lm / glm (not bayesglm)\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\", \"glm\")) && !inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n        \n        pi_obj <- tryCatch(\n          predict(\n            m,\n            newdata  = data,\n            interval = \"prediction\",\n            level    = 0.95\n          ),\n          error = function(e) NULL\n        )\n        \n        # Use only if prediction intervals are actually returned\n        if (!is.null(pi_obj) &&\n            is.matrix(pi_obj) &&\n            ncol(pi_obj) >= 3) {\n          \n          # Columns are positionally: fit | lwr | upr\n          df_pred$Pred_low  <- pi_obj[, 2]\n          df_pred$Pred_high <- pi_obj[, 3]\n        }\n        \n      } else {\n        # bayesglm, RF, PLS u2192 RMSE-based fallback\n        df_pred$Pred_low  <- df_pred$Predicted - 1.96 * RMSE\n        df_pred$Pred_high <- df_pred$Predicted + 1.96 * RMSE\n      }\n      \n      # Convert CI bounds into centred asymmetric errors\n      \n      df_pred$Pred_err_low  <- df_pred$Predicted - df_pred$Pred_low\n      df_pred$Pred_err_high <- df_pred$Pred_high - df_pred$Predicted\n      \n      \n      # PLOT 1. Pred vs Obs plots WITH error bars (per element & model)\n      \n      # Axis limits must include full error bar extents\n      x_min <- min(df_pred$Obs_low,  na.rm = TRUE)\n      x_max <- max(df_pred$Obs_high, na.rm = TRUE)\n      \n      y_min <- min(df_pred$Predicted - df_pred$Pred_err_low,  na.rm = TRUE)\n      y_max <- max(df_pred$Predicted + df_pred$Pred_err_high, na.rm = TRUE)\n      \n      # Force shared range so plots are square\n      axis_min <- min(x_min, y_min)\n      axis_max <- max(x_max, y_max)\n      \n      # Add small padding so points / error bars don't touch edges\n      pad <- 0.01 * (axis_max - axis_min)\n      axis_min_pad <- axis_min - pad\n      axis_max_pad <- axis_max + pad\n      \n      # --- annotation coordinates: top-left INSIDE the padded limits ---\n      # Put annotation very close to top-left, but scale-invariant\n      pad_frac <- 0.005  # 0.5% of axis range (tighter than 1%)\n      \n      ann_x <- axis_min_pad + pad_frac * (axis_max_pad -               "**SNR\\(_\\text{CI}\\)** (signal-to-noise ratio based on confidence intervals) quantifies how strong the variability in a predicted signal is relative to its average predictive uncertainty.\n\n### Definition\n\\[\n\\mathrm{SNR}_{\\mathrm{CI}}\n=\n\\frac{\\operatorname{sd}\\!\\left(\\hat{y}\\right)}\n{\\overline{\\left(U_{95}-L_{95}\\right)}}\n\\]\n\n### Terms\n- \\(\\hat{y}\\): vector of predicted values (e.g., ppm concentrations along a core).\n- \\(\\operatorname{sd}(\\hat{y})\\): standard deviation of the predictions (the **signal**).\n- \\(U_{95}, L_{95}\\): upper and lower 95% confidence (or prediction) limits for each prediction.\n- \\(\\overline{(U_{95}-L_{95})}\\): mean width of the 95% CI across all predictions (the **noise**).\n\n### Interpretation\n- **High SNR\\(_\\text{CI}\\)** u2192 predictions vary more than their uncertainty bands u2192 **signal-dominated** reconstruction.\n- **Low SNR\\(_\\text{CI}\\)** u2192 uncertainty bands are large relative to variability u2192 **uncertainty-dominated** reconstruction.\n\n### Notes\n- Dimensionless.\n- Computed on the **same scale** as the predictions (e.g., ppm).\n- Used as one component of composite robustness metrics alongside smoothness and calibration performance."

              "Youu2019re right that youu2019re getting a **u201cblanket NAu201d effect**, but itu2019s not because **RMSEP\\_val is NA** (thatu2019s log-space RMSEP). Your `RMSEP_ppm_cv` is NA because of a more specific failure mode:\n\n### Whatu2019s actually happening\nYour current `RMSEP_ppm_cv` depends on this call:\n\n```r\ncv_log <- cv_predictions_for_model(...)\n```\n\nIn most codebases, that helper tends to return **NULL** (or error) if **any fold fit fails** (e.g., WLS/weighted models, some Bayes/PLS folds, etc.). If it returns NULL even once, your outer block returns `NA_real_`.\n\nSo yes: **models that fail in one fold can force RMSEP_ppm_cv to NA**, even if most folds succeed.\n\nu2705 The fix is: **compute RMSEP\\_ppm\\_cv fold-by-fold, and ignore failed folds**, instead of demanding a perfect CV run.\n\nBelow is the minimal patch approach.\n\n---\n\n# Patch A (Section 8): add a robust CV RMSEP\\_ppm helper that tolerates failed folds\n\n## 1) Where to paste this helper\nPaste this **once** in Section 8 **above the element loop** (same place you define `bootstrap_model_performance()`), or in your Section 4 u201chelpersu201d area.\n\n### u2705 Helper function: `cv_rmsep_ppm_safe()`\n\n```r\ncv_rmsep_ppm_safe <- function(\n  model_name,\n  formula,\n  data,\n  y_col,\n  sd_col = NULL,\n  best_ncomp = NA_integer_,\n  k = 10,\n  seed = 123\n) {\n  set.seed(seed)\n  n <- nrow(data)\n  if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n  # Fold assignment\n  folds <- sample(rep(seq_len(k), length.out = n))\n\n  se_all <- numeric(0)  # squared errors in ppm, pooled across folds\n  n_ok_total <- 0L\n\n  for (fold in seq_len(k)) {\n    test_idx  <- which(folds == fold)\n    train_idx <- which(folds != fold)\n    if (length(test_idx) < 3 || length(train_idx) < 3) next\n\n    d_train <- data[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]\n    d_test  <- data[test_idx,  , drop = FALSE]\n\n    # Fit model safely (mirror your Section 8 model_list logic)\n    m_fit <- tryCatch({\n      if (model_name == \"OLS\") {\n        lm(formula, data = d_train)\n\n      } else if (model_name == \"WLS\") {\n        ols <- lm(formula, data = d_train)\n        rm  <- lm(abs(ols$residuals) ~ ols$fitted.values)\n        w   <- 1 / (rm$fitted.values^2)\n        lm(formula, data = d_train, weights = w)\n\n      } else if (model_name == \"OLS_weighted\") {\n        if (!is.null(sd_col) && sd_col %in% names(d_train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = d_train, weights = 1 / (d_train[[sd_col]]^2))\n        } else {\n          stop(\"sd_col missing for OLS_weighted\")\n        }\n\n      } else if (model_name == \"WLS_weighted\") {\n        if (!is.null(sd_col) && sd_col %in% names(d_train)) {\n          init <- lm(formula, data = d_train, weights = 1 / (d_train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n          w2   <- 1 / (rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = d_train, weights = w2)\n        } else {\n          stop(\"sd_col missing for WLS_weighted\")\n        }\n\n      } else if (model_name == \"Bayes\") {\n        bayesglm(formula, data = d_train)\n\n      } else if (model_name == \"RF\") {\n        randomForest(formula, data = d_train, ntree = 300)\n\n      } else if (model_name %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\", \"PLS_kfold\")) {\n        pls <- plsr(formula, data = d_train, scale = TRUE)\n        # best_ncomp must be provided; if NA, choose onesigma here\n        ncomp <- best_ncomp\n        if (is.na(ncomp)) {\n          ncomp <- tryCatch(selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE),\n                            error = function(e) NA_integer_)\n        }\n        list(model = pls, ncomp = ncomp)\n\n      } else {\n        stop(\"Unknown model_name\")\n      }\n    }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n    if (is.null(m_fit)) next\n\n    # Predict in log-space, then convert to ppm\n    pred_log <- tryCatch({\n      if (is.list(m_fit) && inherits(m_fit$model, \"mvr\")) {\n        if (is.na(m_fit$ncomp)) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(d_test)))\n        as.numeric(predict(m_fit$model, ncomp = m_fit$ncomp, newdata = d_test))\n      } else {\n        as.numeric(predict(m_fit, newdata = d_test))\n      }\n    }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(d_test)))\n\n    obs_log <- d_test[[y_col]]\n\n    ok <- is.finite(pred_log) & is.finite(obs_log)\n    if (!any(ok)) next\n\n    pred_ppm <- exp(pred_log[ok])\n    obs_ppm  <- exp(obs_log[ok])\n\n    se_all <- c(se_all, (obs_ppm - pred_ppm)^2)\n    n_ok_total <- n_ok_total + sum(ok)\n  }\n\n  if (length(se_all) < 3 || n_ok_total < 10) return(NA_real_)\n  sqrt(mean(se_all, na.rm = TRUE))\n}\n```\n\nThis function:\n- runs k-fold CV\n- **skips failed folds**\n- pools squared errors only from successful predictions\n- returns RMSEP in **ppm** robustly\n\n---\n\n## 2) Where to use it (replace your RMSEP_ppm_cv block in Section 8)\n\nFind your current:\n\n```r\nRMSEP_ppm_cv <- tryCatch({ cv_log <- cv_predictions_for_model(...); ... }, ...)\n```\n\nReplace the whole thing with:\n\n```r\nRMSEP_ppm_cv <- cv_rmsep_ppm_safe(\n  model_name = mname,\n  formula    = cv_formula,\n  data       = data,\n  y_col      = y_col,\n  sd_col     = if (mname %in% c(\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\")) sd_col else NULL,\n  best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA_integer_,\n  k          = 10,\n  seed       = 123\n)\n```\n\nu2705 Thatu2019s the key fix that prevents one fold failure turning the entire RMSEP\\_ppm\\_cv into NA.\n\n---\n\n# Patch B (Section 11): ensure audits donu2019t drop the new CV columns (no logic change)\n\nIn Section 11 (audit outputs), youu2019re already using `safe_select()`.
