OUTPUT FOLDERS (ALWAYS UNDER \"Regression_Multivariate\")\n  # ===============================================================\n  out_dir <- file.path(save_dir, \"Regression_Multivariate\")\n  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n  \n  all_base  <- file.path(out_dir, \"All_models_ppm\")\n  best_base <- file.path(out_dir, \"Best_models_ppm\")\n  dir.create(all_base,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n  dir.create(best_base, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n  \n  # ===============================================================\n  # 3. SITE FACTOR\n  # ===============================================================\n  if (!\"Site\" %in% names(data))\n    stop(\"Calibration dataset must contain a 'Site' column.\")\n  \n  data$Site <- factor(\n    data$Site,\n    levels = c(\"BI10\",\"HER42PB\",\"KER1\",\"KER3\",\"PB1\")\n  )\n  \n  # ===============================================================\n  # 4. THEME & MODEL LABELS\n  # ===============================================================\n  theme_small <- theme(\n    text       = element_text(size = 8),\n    axis.text  = element_text(size = 8),\n    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),\n    legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),\n    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),\n    plot.title   = element_text(size = 8, face = \"bold\")\n  )\n  \n  model_levels <- c(\n    \"OLS\",\"WLS\",\n    \"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\",\n    \"Bayes\",\"RF\",\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\"\n  )\n  \n  model_labels <- c(\n    \"OLS\",\"WLS\",\n    \"OLS(wt)\",\"WLS(wt)\",\n    \"Bayes\",\"RF\",\"PLS(LOO)\",\"PLS(k)\"\n  )\n  \n  cols_models <- ggsci::pal_npg(\"nrc\")(length(model_labels))\n  names(cols_models) <- model_labels\n  \n  # Force specific colours\n  cols_models[\"PLS(k)\"] <- \"salmon3\"\n  cols_models[\"Bayes\"]     <- \"gold2\"\n  \n  cols_all <- c(cols_models, \"ICP-MS (Observed)\" = \"blue\")\n  \n  # ===============================================================\n  # 5. DATA CHECK\n  # ===============================================================\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n    errs <- c()\n    \n    req <- c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (v in req)\n      if (!v %in% names(data))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(\"Missing:\", v))\n    \n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\n    \n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(y_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    \n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\n    \n    if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n    \n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n    \n    errs\n  }\n  \n  # ===============================================================\n  # 6. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER\n  # ===============================================================\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n    \n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n    \n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      \n      fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n          w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2)\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          rm  <- lm(abs(ols$residuals) ~ ols$fitted.values)\n          w   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w)\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n        } else NULL\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n      \n      if (is.null(fit)) next\n      \n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n      \n      if (is.null(pred)) next\n      \n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n      \n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n    \n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n  \n  # ===============================================================\n  # 7. EXPLANATION TEXT & GLOBAL STORAGE\n  # ===============================================================\n  expl_rank   <- \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\"\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk: p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan: p < 0.05 indicates heteroscedasticity.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE (log-space).\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold CV error (log-space).\"\n  \n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n  \n  preds_store <- list()\n  \n  # ===============================================================\n  # 8. ELEMENT LOOP\n  # ===============================================================\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n  \n  for (el in elements) {\n    \n    pb_elements$tick()\n    \n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n    \n    element_dir <- file.path(all_base, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n    \n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0)\n      warning(paste(\"Issues in\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n    \n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    fmla_multi  <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \")))\n    \n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n    \n    # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 8.1 FIT MODELS (never skip; failures -> NULL)\n    # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n    model_list <- list(\n      OLS = tryCatch(lm(fmla_single, data = data), error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      WLS = tryCatch({\n        ols <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n        rm  <- lm(abs(ols$residuals) ~ ols$fitted.values)\n        w   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n        lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      OLS_weighted = tryCatch({\n        if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n          lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n        else NULL\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      WLS_weighted = tryCatch({\n        if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n          init <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n          w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2)\n        } else NULL\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      Bayes = tryCatch(bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data), error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      RF = tryCatch(\n        randomForest(fmla_multi, data = data, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE),\n        error = function(e) NULL\n      ),\n      \n      PLS_LOO = tryCatch({\n        pls <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n        best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n        attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n        pls\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      PLS_kfold = tryCatch({\n        pls <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE,\n                    validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n        best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n        attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n        pls\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n    )\n    \n    # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 8.2 PER-ELEMENT TABLES & PRED DF\n    # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n    \n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n    \n    \n    # ===============================================================\n    # 8.3 MODEL LOOP\n    # ===============================================================\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n      \n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n      \n      # Predictions on calibration data\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        else if (!is.null(m))\n          as.numeric(predict(m))\n        else\n          rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))\n      }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n      \n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n      \n      # Metrics\n      R2 <- tryCatch({\n        SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      \n      RMSE <- tryCatch(\n        sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n        fmla_single else fmla_multi\n      \n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      ranking_df <- \n      global_summary <- dplyr::add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2,\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n   mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n    \n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, Back-transform to ppm\n      # -------------------------------\n      df[[pred_col]] <- exp(pred_log)\n      df[[l95_col]]  <- exp(lower_log)\n      df[[u95_col]]  <- exp(upper_log)\n    }\n    \n    # Save updated CSV\n    write.csv(df, basefile, row.names = FALSE)\n    message(paste(\"Updated predictions saved to:\", basefile))\n  }\n```\n\n---\n\n# ud83cudf89 **SECTION 14 is complete.**  \nYou now have:\n\n### u2714 Calibration_pred/<el>/ICP_pred_<el>.csv  \ncontaining:\n\n- ICP_MS ppm data  \n- ACE_dataset XRF predictors  \n- Full prediction + CI set for all 8 models for that element  \n\n---\n\n# ud83dudc49 NEXT STEP?  \nI can now generate:\n\n### **SECTION 15: Full diagnostic plots (Pred vs Obs, residuals, influence, PLS RMSEP)**  \n### **SECTION 16: ACE depth & age profile plots (matching Section 9)**  \n### **SECTION 17: ACE global summary CSVs (matching Section 11)**\n\nJust say:\n\nu27a1ufe0f **u201cContinue with Section 15u201d**"

predict calibration fits\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        else if (!is.null(m))\n          as.numeric(predict(m))\n        else\n          rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))\n      }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n      \n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n      \n      R2 <- tryCatch({\n        SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      \n      RMSE <- tryCatch(\n        sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n        fmla_single else fmla_multi\n      \n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      ranking_df <- dplyr::add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      global_summary <- dplyr::add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2,\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\n        BIC     = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      #               "Understood u2014 **coord_fixed() alone does NOT guarantee that the *panel boxes* are square**.  \nIt only fixes the *data aspect ratio*, not the **physical shape** of each subplot.\n\nTo guarantee **physically square panels of equal size**, we must control the **panel size**, not just the aspect ratio.\n\nud83dudccc The correct solution is to use:\n\n### **`patchwork::wrap_plots()` + `theme(aspect.ratio = 1)`**\n\nThis forces each subplotu2019s *panel region* (the square where data is drawn) to be perfectly square and identical across all models.\n\nBelow is the **corrected drop-in replacement** that guarantees uniform square dimensions.\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **FINAL FIX u2014 ALL PANELS ARE TRUE SQUARES**\n\n```r\n# ===============================================================\n# 8.X  SUMMARY PANEL u2014 PORTRAIT 2u00d74 (ALL 8 MODELS, TRUE SQUARE PANELS)\n# ===============================================================\n\nall_models_order <- c(\n  \"OLS\",\n  \"OLS_weighted\",\n  \"WLS\",\n  \"WLS_weighted\",\n  \"Bayes\",\n  \"RF\",\n  \"PLS_kfold\",\n  \"PLS_LOO\"\n)\n\n# Force TRUE square panel shape by applying theme(aspect.ratio = 1)\nmake_square <- function(p) {\n  p + theme(\n    aspect.ratio = 1,        # <-- TRUE SQUARE PANEL\n    plot.title.position = \"panel\"\n  )\n}\n\nget_plot_or_blank <- function(model_name) {\n  if (!is.null(p_po_list[[model_name]])) {\n    make_square(p_po_list[[model_name]])\n  } else {\n    make_square(ggplot() + theme_void())\n  }\n}\n\nall_plots <- lapply(all_models_order, get_plot_or_blank)\n\nsummary_panel_all <- wrap_plots(\n  all_plots,\n  ncol = 2,\n  nrow = 4,\n  guides = \"collect\"\n) &\n  theme(\n    legend.position  = \"bottom\",\n    legend.direction = \"horizontal\",\n    legend.box       = \"horizontal\"\n  ) &\n  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1))\n\n# Save as A4 portrait\nggsave(\n  filename = paste0(el, \"_PredObs_Model_Summary.pdf\"),\n  path     = element_dir,\n  plot     = summary_panel_all,\n  width    = 21,      # =============================================================\n  pred <- tryCatch({\n    if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n      as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n    else if (!is.null(m))\n      as.numeric(predict(m))\n    else\n      rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))\n  }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n\n  resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n  # =============================================================\n  # Diagnostics\n  # =============================================================\n  sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n  if (length(resid_vals) >= 3) {\n    sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error = function(e) NULL)\n    if (!is.null(sh)) {\n      sh_W <- unname(sh$statistic)\n      sh_p <- sh$p.value\n    }\n  }\n\n  bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n  if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n    bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error = function(e) NULL)\n    if (!is.null(bp)) {\n      bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n      bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n    }\n  }\n\n  diag_df <- dplyr::add_row(\n    diag_df,\n    Model             = mname,\n    Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n    Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n    Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n    BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n    BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n    BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n    CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n    CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n    AIC               = AIC_val,\n    AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\n    BIC               = BIC_val,\n    BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\n  )\n\n  # =============================================================\n  # Plot: Predicted vs Observed (WITH u00b1SD ERROR BARS)\n  # =============================================================\n  df_pred <- data.frame(\n    Observed  = y,\n    Predicted = pred,\n    Site      = data$Site\n  )\n\n  # u00b1SD horizontal calibration error bars\n  if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n    df_pred$Obs_lower <- y - data[[sd_col]]\n    df_pred$Obs_upper <- y + data[[sd_col]]\n  } else {\n    df_pred$Obs_lower <- NA\n    df_pred$Obs_upper <- NA\n  }\n\n  # u00b1SD vertical prediction error bars (based on RMSE)\n  df_pred$Pred_lower <- pred - RMSE\n  df_pred$Pred_upper <- pred + RMSE\n\n  # offsets for annotation\n  x_offset <- 0.02 * diff(range(df_pred$Observed,  na.rm = TRUE))\n  y_offset <- 0.02 * diff(range(df_pred$Predicted, na.rm = TRUE))\n\n  stats_label <- paste0(\n    \"Ru00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\n    \"\\nRMSEP = \", signif(RMSEP_val, 3),\n    \"\\nRMSE = \", signif(RMSE, 3)\n  )\n\n  p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, colour = Site)) +\n    geom_errorbarh(\n      aes(xmin = Obs_lower, xmax = Obs_upper),\n      height = 0,\n      colour = \"grey60\",\n      linewidth = 0.35,\n      na.rm = TRUE\n    ) +\n    geom_errorbar(\n      aes(ymin = Pred_lower, ymax = Pred_upper),\n      width = 0,\n      colour = \"grey60\",\n      linewidth = 0.35,\n      na.rm = TRUE\n    ) +\n    geom_point(size = 1.2) +\n    ggsci::scale_color_jco(name = \"Site\") +\n    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\n    annotate(\n      \"text\",\n      x = min(df_pred$Observed,  na.rm = TRUE) + x_offset,\n      y = max(df_pred$Predicted, na.rm = TRUE) - y_offset,\n      label = stats_label,\n      hjust = 0, vjust = 1,\n      size = 2.7\n    ) +\n    labs(\n      x = expression(\"Observed ICP-MS (mg kg\"^{-1}*\")\"),\n      y = expression(\"Predicted (mg kg\"^{-1}*\")\"),\n      title = paste(el, mname, \"- Predicted vs Observed\")\n    ) +\n    theme_bw() + theme_small\n\n  # ELEMENT LOOP\n# ===============================================================\npb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n  format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n  total  = length(elements),\n  clear  = FALSE,\n  width  = 80\n)\n\n# GLOBAL STORAGE\nmodel_store      <- list()\ncalibration_rmse <- list()\npreds_store      <- list()\n\nfor (el in elements) {\n\n  pb_elements$tick()\n\n  y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n  x_col  <- el\n  var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n  sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n  # (NEW) Calibration outputs folder\n  element_dir <- file.path(calib_base, el)\n  dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n  errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n  if (length(errors) > 0)\n    warning(paste(\"Issues in\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n\n  fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n  fmla_multi  <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \")))\n\n  y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n  # ===============================================================\n  # 8.1 FIT MODELS\n  # ===============================================================\n  model_list <- list(\n    OLS = tryCatch(lm(fmla_single, data = data), error = function(e) NULL),\n\n    WLS = tryCatch({\n      ols <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n      rm  <- lm(abs(ols$residuals) ~ ols$fitted.values)\n      w   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n      lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w)\n    }, error = function(e) NULL),\n\n    OLS_weighted = tryCatch({\n      if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n        lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n      else NULL\n    }, error = function(e) NULL),\n\n    WLS_weighted = tryCatch({\n      if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n        init <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n        rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n        w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n        lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2)\n      } else NULL\n    }, error = function(e) NULL),\n\n    Bayes = tryCatch(bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data), error = function(e) NULL),\n\n    RF = tryCatch(\n      randomForest(fmla_multi, data = data, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE),\n      error = function(e) NULL\n    ),\n\n    PLS_LOO = tryCatch({\n      pls <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n      best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n      attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n      pls\n    }, error = function(e) NULL),\n\n    PLS_kfold = tryCatch({\n      pls <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE,\n                  validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n      best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n      attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n      pls\n    }, error = function(e) NULL)\n  )\n\n  # ===============================================================\n  # 8.2 METRIC TABLES INITIALISATION\n  # ===============================================================\n  ranking_df <- tibble(\n    Model = character(),\n    R2    = numeric(),\n    RMSE  = numeric(),\n    RMSEP = numeric(),\n    AIC   = numeric(),\n    BIC   = numeric()\n  )\n\n  diag_df <- tibble(\n    Model             = character(),\n    Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n    Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n    Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n    BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n    BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n    BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n    CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n    CV10_expl         = character(),\n    AIC               = numeric(),\n    AIC_expl          = character(),\n    BIC               = numeric(),\n    BIC_expl          = character()\n  )\n\n  do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n  preds_df <- if (do_predictions) XRF_new else NULL\n\n  pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n    total  = length(model_list),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 70\n  )\n\n  # ===============================================================\n  # 8.3 MODEL LOOP\n  # ===============================================================\n  p_po_list <- list()   # for summary pages\n\n  for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n    pb_models$tick()\n    m <- model_list[[mname]]\n\n    # prediction on calibration data\n    pred <- tryCatch({\n      if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n        as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n      else if (!is.null(m))\n        as.numeric(predict(m))\n      else\n        rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))\n    }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n\n    resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n    # metrics\n    R2 <- tryCatch({\n      SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n      SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n      1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n\n    RMSE <- tryCatch(\n      sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),\n      error = function(e) NA_real_\n    )\n\n    cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n      fmla_single else fmla_multi\n\n    RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n      cv_rmse_for_model(\n        mname, cv_formula, data, y_col, var_col, sd_col,\n        best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n      ),\n      error = function(e) NA_real_\n    )\n\n    AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n      tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n\n    BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n      tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n\n    ranking_df <- dplyr::add_row(\n      ranking_df,\n      Model = mname,\n      R2    = R2,\n      RMSE  = RMSE,\n      RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n      AIC   = AIC_val,\n      BIC   = BIC_val\n    )\n\n    global_summary <- dplyr::add_row(\n      global_summary,\n      Element = el,\n      Model   = mname,\n      R2      = R2,\n      RMSE    = RMSE,\n      RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n      AIC     = AIC_val,\n      BIC     = BIC_val\n    )\n\n    # ===============================================================\n    # Diagnostics\n    # ===============================================================\n    sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n    if (length(resid_vals) >= 3) {\n      sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error = function(e) NULL)\n      if (!is.null(sh)) {\n        sh_W <- unname(sh$statistic)\n        sh_p <- sh$p.value\n      }\n    }\n\n    bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n    if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n      bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error = function(e) NULL)\n      if (!is.null(bp)) {\n        bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n        bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n      }\n    }\n\n    diag_df <- dplyr::add_row(\n      diag_df,\n      Model             = mname,\n      Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n      Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n      Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n      BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n      BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n      BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n      CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n      CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n      AIC               = AIC_val,\n      AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\n      BIC               = BIC_val,\n      BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\n    )\n\n    # ===============================================================\n    # PRED VS OBS + SD ERROR BARS (LN scale)\n    # ===============================================================\n\n    stats_label <- paste0(\n      \"Ru00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\n      \"\\nRMSEP = \", signif(RMSEP_val, 3),\n      \"\\nRMSE = \", signif(RMSE, 3)\n    )\n\n    # Influence plots\n    if (inherits(m, \"lm\") && !inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n      cooks <- cooks.distance(m)\n      lev   <- hatvalues(m)\n      rstd  <- rstandard(m)\n\n      inf_df <- tibble(\n        obs      = seq_along(cooks),\n        Cook     = cooks,\n        Leverage = lev,\n        StdResid = rstd\n      )\n\n      pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Influence.pdf\")),\n          width = 13/2.54, height = 9/2.54)\n\n      print(\n        ggplot(inf_df, aes(obs, Cook)) +\n          geom_col() +\n          theme_bw() + theme_small +\n          ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Cook's Distance\"))\n      )\n      print(\n        ggplot(inf_df, aes(Leverage, StdResid)) +\n          geom_point(size = 1.25) +\n          theme_bw() + theme_small +\n          ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Leverage\"))\n      )\n      dev.off()\n    }\n\n    # PLS RMSEP\n    if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n      pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PLS_RMSEP.pdf\")),\n          width = 13/2.54, height = 9/2.54)\n      validationplot(\n        m,\n        val.type = \"RMSEP\",\n        main = paste(el, mname, \"- RMSEP vs Components\")\n      )\n      dev.off()\n    }\n\n    # page 3: ALL MODELS (2u00d74)\n  page3 <- wrap_plots(\n    p_po_list$OLS,\n    p_po_list$OLS_weighted,\n    p_po_list$WLS,\n    p_po_list$WLS_weighted,\n    p_po_list$Bayes,\n    p_po_list$RF,\n    p_po_list$PLS_LOO,\n    p_po_list$PLS_kfold,\n    ncol = 2\n  ) & theme(legend.position = \"bottom\")\n\n  ggsave(\n    file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_AllModels_Summary.pdf\")),\n    page3, width = 21, height = 29.7, units = \"cm\"\n  )\n\n  # req <- c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (v in req)\n      if (!v %in% names(data))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(\"Missing:\", v))\n    \n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    \n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\n    \n    if if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n    \n    errs\n  }\n  \n  ############################################################\n  # 6. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER FUNCTION (log-space)\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n    \n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n    \n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n    \n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n      \n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      \n      fit <- tryCatch({\n        \n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n          \n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          \n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\n          \n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols_fit <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n          rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n          w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_ols)\n          \n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n          \n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n          \n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n          \n        } else NULL\n        \n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n      \n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n      \n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n      \n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n      \n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n      \n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n    \n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n  \n  ############################################################\n  # 7. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  ############################################################\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\",\n    \"AIC/BIC reported but not used for ranking.\"\n  )\n  \n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 indicates non-constant variance.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE (log-space); lower indicates better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error in log-space.\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold cross-validated error in log-space.\"\n  \n  ############################################################\n  # 8. LOAD PACKAGES\n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  suppressPackageStartupMessages({\n    library(ggplot2)\n    library(dplyr)\n    library(randomForest)\n    library(pls)\n    library(arm)\n    library(ggsci)\n    library(progress)\n    library(lmtest)\n    library(tidyr)\n    library(patchwork)\n    library(rlang)   # for .data pronoun\n  })\n  \n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  # 2. BASE DIRECTORIES\n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n  \n  all_base  <- file.path(save_dir, \"All_models_ppm\")\n  best_base <- file.path(save_dir, \"Best_models_ppm\")\n  dir.create(all_base,  recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n  dir.create(best_base, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n  \n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  # 3. BASIC SANITY + THEME\n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  if (!\"Site\" %in% names(data))\n    stop(\"Calibration dataset must contain 'Site' column.\")\n  \n  data$Site <- factor(\n    data$Site,\n    levels = c(\"BI10\",\"HER42PB\",\"KER1\",\"KER3\",\"PB1\")\n  )\n  \n  theme_small <- theme(\n    text       = element_text(size = 8),\n    axis.text  = element_text(size = 8),\n    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),\n    legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),\n    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),\n    plot.title   = element_text(size = 8, face = \"bold\")\n  )\n  \n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  # 4. MODEL LABELS / COLOURS\n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  model_levels <- c(\n    \"OLS\",\"WLS\",\n    \"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\",\n    \"Bayes\",\"RF\",\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\"\n  )\n  \n  model_labels <- c(\n    \"OLS\",\"WLS\",\n    \"OLS(wt)\",\"WLS(wt)\",\n    \"Bayes\",\"RF\",\"PLS(LOO)\",\"PLS(k)\"\n  )\n  \n  cols_models <- ggsci::pal_npg(\"nrc\")(length(model_labels))\n  names(cols_models) <- model_labels\n  cols_models[\"PLS(k)\"] <- \"salmon3\"\n  \n  cols_all <- c(cols_models, \"ICP-MS (Observed)\" = \"blue\")\n  \n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  # 5. DATA INTEGRITY CHECK (single predictor)\n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n    errs <- c()\n    \n    req <- c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (v in req) {\n      if (!v %in% names(data))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(\"Missing:\", v))\n    }\n    \n    if (y_col %in% names(data) && !is.numeric(data[[y_col]]))\n      errs <- c(errs, paste(y_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    if (x_col %in% names(data) && !is.numeric(data[[x_col]]))\n      errs <- c(errs, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    \n    if (y_col %in% names(data) && any(is.na(data[[y_col]])))\n      errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", y_col))\n    if (x_col %in% names(data) && any(is.na(data[[x_col]])))\n      errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\n    \n    if (x_col %in% names(data) && var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\n    \n    if (sd_col %in% names(data) && any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n      errs <- c(errs, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n    \n    if (var_col %in% names(data) && any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n      errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n    \n    errs\n  }\n  \n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  # 6. 10-FOLD CV RMSE (log-space) u2014 NEVER DROPS MODEL\n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n    \n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n    \n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      \n      fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm   <- lm(abs(init$resid) ~ init$fitted)\n          w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2)\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          rm  <- lm(abs(ols$resid) ~ ols$fitted)\n          w   <- 1/(rm$fitted^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w)\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n        } else {\n          NULL\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n      \n      if (is.null(fit)) next\n      \n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = test))\n      }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(test)))\n      \n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(pred) & !is.na(y_test)\n      if (any(ok)) {\n        cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n        cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n      }\n    }\n    \n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n  \n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  # 7. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  expl_rank  <- \"Ranking: highest Ru00b2 u2192 lowest RMSEP u2192 lowest RMSE.\"\n  expl_shap  <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp    <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 u2192 non-constant variance.\"\n  expl_cv10  <- \"10-fold CV RMSE (log-space).\"\n  expl_r2    <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmse  <- \"RMSE = calibration error (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmsep <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold cross-validated error (log-space).\"\n  \n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  # 8. GLOBAL SUMMARY STORAGE\n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n  \n  preds_store <- list()\n  \n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  # 9. ELEMENT LOOP PROGRESS BAR\n  # --------------------------------------------------------------\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83eudde9 CHUNK 2 of 6\n\n```r\n  # ================================================================\n  # 10. MAIN LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\n  # ================================================================\n  for (el in elements) {\n    \n    pb_elements$tick()\n    \n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n    \n    # Folder for this element (all models)\n    element_dir <- file.path(all_base, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n    \n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    # Data integrity u2014 warn but DO NOT skip element\n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      warning(paste(\"Data integrity issues for\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n    }\n    \n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    fmla_multi  <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \")))\n    \n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n    \n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 10.1 FIT ALL MODELS (NEVER DROPPED)\n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    model_list <- list()\n    \n    # OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- tryCatch(\n      lm(fmla_single, data = data),\n      error = function(e) NULL\n    )\n    \n    # WLS (residual-based)\n    model_list$WLS <- tryCatch({\n      ols <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n      rm  <- lm(abs(ols$resid) ~ ols$fitted)\n      w   <- 1/(rm$fitted^2)\n      lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w)\n    }, error = function(e) NULL)\n    \n    # OLS_weighted\n    model_list$OLS_weighted <- tryCatch({\n      if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n        lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n      } else NULL\n    }, error = function(e) NULL)\n    \n    # WLS_weighted\n    model_list$WLS_weighted <- tryCatch({\n      if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n        init <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n        rm   <- lm(abs(init$resid) ~ init$fitted)\n        w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted^2)\n        lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2)\n      } else NULL\n    }, error = function(e) NULL)\n    \n    # Bayes\n    model_list$Bayes <- tryCatch(\n      bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data),\n      error = function(e) NULL\n    )\n    \n    # Random Forest\n    model_list$RF <- tryCatch(\n      randomForest(fmla_multi, data = data, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE),\n      error = function(e) NULL\n    )\n    \n    # PLS LOO\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- tryCatch({\n      pls <- plsr(\n        fmla_multi,\n        data = data,\n        scale = TRUE,\n        validation = \"LOO\"\n      )\n      best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n      attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n      pls\n    }, error = function(e) NULL)\n    \n    # PLS k-fold\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- tryCatch({\n      pls <- plsr(\n        fmla_multi,\n        data = data,\n        scale = TRUE,\n        validation = \"CV\",\n        segments = 10\n      )\n      best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n      attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n      pls\n    }, error = function(e) NULL)\n    \n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 10.2 RESULT / DIAGNOSTIC TABLES\n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n    \n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n    \n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 10.3 Prediction DF (starts as XRF_new)\n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    preds_df <- if (do_predictions) XRF_new else NULL\n    \n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 10.4 MODEL ANALYSIS LOOP (NO MODELS DROPPED)\n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n    \n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n      pb_models$tick()\n      \n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n      \n      # Predictions on calibration data\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        } else if (!is.null(m)) {\n          as.numeric(predict(m))\n        } else {\n          rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n      \n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n      \n      # Ru00b2\n      R2 <- tryCatch({\n        SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      \n      # RMSE\n      RMSE <- tryCatch({\n        sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      \n      # RMSEP (10-fold CV)\n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n        fmla_single else fmla_multi\n      \n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      # AIC / BIC\n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      # Update ranking + global summary\n      ranking_df <- add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      global_summary <- add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2,\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\n        BIC     = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      # Diagnostics\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh_res <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh_res)) {\n          sh_W <- unname(sh_res$statistic)\n          sh_p <- sh_res$p.value\n        }\n      }\n      \n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- as.numeric(bp$statistic)\n          bp_p    <- as.numeric(bp$p.value)\n        }\n      }\n      \n      diag_df <- add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shap,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\n        AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\n        BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\n      )\n      \n      # ----------------------------------------------------------\n      # Predictions for XRF_new (log u2192 ppm) u2014 NEVER SKIP MODEL\n      # ----------------------------------------------------------\n      if (do_predictions) {\n        \n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = XRF_new))\n          else if (!is.null(m))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = XRF_new))\n          else\n            rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new))\n        }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new)))\n        \n        lower_log <- upper_log <- pred_new_log\n        \n        if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\") && !is.null(m)) {\n          pi_obj <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, interval = \"prediction\", level = 0.95),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(pi_obj)) {\n            lower_log <- as.numeric(pi_obj[, \"lwr\"])\n            upper_log <- as.numeric(pi_obj[, \"upr\"])\n          } else {\n            lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n            upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n          }\n        } else {\n          lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n          upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n        }\n        \n        pred_ppm  <- exp(pred_new_log)\n        lower_ppm <- exp(lower_log)\n        upper_ppm <- exp(upper_log)\n        \n        base_name <- paste(mname, el, sep = \"_\")\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_name,\"_Pred_ppm\")]] <- pred_ppm\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_name,\"_L95_ppm\")]]  <- lower_ppm\n        preds_df[[paste0(base_name,\"_U95_ppm\")]]  <- upper_ppm\n      }\n    } # end model loop\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83eudde9 CHUNK 3 of 6\n\n```r\n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 10.5 RANK MODELS & SAVE ELEMENT-LEVEL CSVs\n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    if (nrow(ranking_df) > 0) {\n      ranking_df <- ranking_df %>%\n        arrange(desc(R2), RMSEP, RMSE) %>%\n        mutate(Rank = dplyr::row_number())\n      \n      ranking_expl_df <- ranking_df %>%\n        mutate(\n          Rank_explanation  = expl_rank,\n          R2_explanation    = expl_r2,\n          RMSE_explanation  = expl_rmse,\n          RMSEP_explanation = expl_rmsep\n        )\n      \n      write.csv(\n        ranking_expl_df,\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_Model_Ranking.csv\")),\n        row.names = FALSE\n      )\n    }\n    \n    write.csv(\n      diag_df,\n      file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_Diagnostics_Summary.csv\")),\n      row.names = FALSE\n    )\n    \n    # Prediction CSV + store for site/element plots\n    if (!is.null(preds_df)) {\n      preds_path <- file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_preds.csv\"))\n      write.csv(preds_df, preds_path, row.names = FALSE)\n      preds_store[[el]] <- preds_df\n    }\n    \n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 10.6 README PER ELEMENT\n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    readme_txt <- c(\n      paste(\"Element:\", el),\n      \"\",\n      \"DATA NOTE:\",\n      paste0(\"  - Calibration responses (e.g., \", el, \"_ICP) are ln(mg kg^-1).\"),\n      \"  - All model fitting and errors (RMSE, RMSEP) are computed in log-space.\",\n      \"  - Predictions on XRF_new are back-transformed with exp() to mg kg^-1.\",\n      \"\",\n      \"PREDICTION COLUMNS IN *_preds.csv:\",\n      \"  - For each model, columns follow the pattern:\",\n      \"      Model_Element_Pred_ppm : predicted concentration in mg kg^-1\",\n      \"      Model_Element_L95_ppm  : lower 95% prediction bound in mg kg^-1\",\n      \"      Model_Element_U95_ppm  : upper 95% prediction bound in mg kg^-1\",\n      \"    e.g. PLS_LOO_Ti_Pred_ppm, PLS_LOO_Ti_L95_ppm, PLS_LOO_Ti_U95_ppm.\",\n      \"\",\n      \"MODELS FITTED:\",\n      \"  - OLS, WLS, OLS(wt), WLS(wt), Bayes, RF, PLS(LOO), PLS(k).\",\n      \"\",\n      \"RANKING RULES:\",\n      \"  1) Highest Ru00b2 ranked best.\",\n      \"  2) For similar Ru00b2, lower RMSEP ranked higher.\",\n      \"  3) For similar Ru00b2 and RMSEP, lower RMSE ranked higher.\"\n    )\n    \n    writeLines(readme_txt, file.path(element_dir, \"README.txt\"))\n    \n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 10.7 PER-MODEL DIAGNOSTIC PLOTS\n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n      \n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n      if (is.null(m)) next\n      \n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        else\n          as.numeric(predict(m))\n      }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n      \n      if (all(is.na(pred))) next\n      \n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n      \n      R2_plot <- tryCatch({\n        SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      \n      RMSE_plot <- tryCatch({\n        sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      \n      RMSEP_plot <- tryCatch({\n        row <- ranking_df %>% dplyr::filter(Model == mname)\n        if (nrow(row) == 1) row$RMSEP else NA_real_\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      \n      stats_label <- paste0(\n        \"Ru00b2 = \", signif(R2_plot, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSEP = \", signif(RMSEP_plot, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSE = \", signif(RMSE_plot, 3)\n      )\n      \n      # Pred vs Obs\n      df_pred <- data.frame(\n        Observed  = y,\n        Predicted = pred,\n        Site      = data$Site\n      )\n      \n      x_min_po <- min(df_pred$Observed,  na.rm = TRUE)\n      y_max_po <- max(df_pred$Predicted, na.rm = TRUE)\n      \n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, colour = Site)) +\n        geom_point(size = 1.25, alpha = 0.85) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_npg(name = \"Site\") +\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\n        annotate(\n          \"text\",\n          x = x_min_po,\n          y = y_max_po,\n          hjust = 0,\n          vjust = 1,\n          label = stats_label,\n          size = 2.7\n        ) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Predicted vs Observed (log-space)\"))\n      \n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n        p_po, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\n      )\n      \n      # PLS RMSEP vs components\n      if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PLS_RMSEP.pdf\")),\n            width = 13/2.54, height = 9/2.54)\n        \n        validationplot(\n          m,\n          val.type = \"RMSEP\",\n          main = paste(el, mname, \"- RMSEP vs Components\")\n        )\n        \n        dev.off()\n      }\n    } # end per-model plot loop\n    \n  } # end element loop\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83eudde9 CHUNK 4 of 6  \n(site-level depth & age plots with dynamic layout, under `All_models_ppm/Sites` and `Best_models_ppm/Sites`)\n\n```r\n  # RMSE\n      RMSE <- tryCatch({\n        sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      \n      # RMSEP\n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n        fmla_single else fmla_multi\n      \n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      # AIC / BIC\n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      # Store in ranking table\n      ranking_df <- add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      # Store in global summary\n      global_summary <- add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2,\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\n        BIC     = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      # ----------------------------------------------------------\n      # Diagnostics\n      # ----------------------------------------------------------\n      \n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- sh$statistic\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n      \n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n      \n      diag_df <- add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\n        AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\n        BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\n      )\n      \n      # ----------------------------------------------------------\n      # Predictions for XRF_new\n      # ----------------------------------------------------------\n      \n      if (do_predictions) {\n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = XRF_new))\n          else if (!is.null(m))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = XRF_new))\n          else\n            rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new))\n        }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new)))\n        \n        lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n        upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n        \n        # lm models can have real prediction intervals\n        if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\") && !is.null(m)) {\n          pi_obj <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, interval = \"prediction\", level = 0.95),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(pi_obj)) {\n            lower_log <- pi_obj[, \"lwr\"]\n            upper_log <- pi_obj[, \"upr\"]\n          }\n        }\n        \n        pred_ppm  <- exp(pred_new_log)\n        lower_ppm <- exp(lower_log)\n        upper_ppm <- exp(upper_log)\n        \n        preds_df[[paste0(mname, \"_\", el, \"_Pred_ppm\")]] <- pred_ppm\n        preds_df[[paste0(mname, \"_\", el, \"_L95_ppm\")]]  <- lower_ppm\n        preds_df[[paste0(mname, \"_\", el, \"_U95_ppm\")]]  <- upper_ppm\n      }\n      \n      # CROSS-VALIDATION (10-fold RMSE)\n  # ===============================================================\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n    \n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n    \n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      \n      fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n        } else if init$fitted.values)\n          w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2)\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          rm  <- lm(abs(ols$residuals) ~ ols$fitted.values)\n          w   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w)\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n        } else NULL\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n      \n      if (is.null(fit)) next\n      \n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n      \n      if (is.null(pred)) next\n      \n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n      \n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n    \n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n  \n  # ===============================================================\n  # 7. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  # ===============================================================\n  expl_rank   <- \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\"\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk: p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan: p < 0.05 indicates heteroscedasticity.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE (log-space).\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold CV error (log-space).\"\n  \n  # ===============================================================\n  # 8. GLOBAL SUMMARY\n  # ===============================================================\n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n  \n  preds_store <- list()\n```\n\n---\n\n# u2b50 **CHUNK 2 of 6 u2014 ELEMENT LOOP & MODEL FITTING**\n\n```r\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n  \n  for (el in elements) {\n    pb_elements$tick()\n    \n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n    \n    element_dir <- file.path(all_base, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n    \n    # Warn only u2014 do not skip\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0)\n      warning(paste(\"Issues in\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n    \n    # Formulas\n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    fmla_multi  <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \")))\n    \n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n    \n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 10.1 FIT ALL MODELS (no skipping)\n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    \n    model_list <- list(\n      OLS = tryCatch(lm(fmla_single, data = data), error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      WLS = tryCatch({\n        ols <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n        rm  <- lm(abs(ols$residuals) ~ ols$fitted.values)\n        w   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n        lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      OLS_weighted = tryCatch({\n        if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n          lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n        else NULL\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      WLS_weighted = tryCatch({\n        if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n          init <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n          w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2)\n        } else NULL\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      Bayes = tryCatch(bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data), error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      RF = tryCatch(\n        randomForest(fmla_multi, data = data, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE),\n        error = function(e) NULL\n      ),\n      \n      PLS_LOO = tryCatch({\n        pls <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n        best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n        attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n        pls\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      PLS_kfold = tryCatch({\n        pls <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE,\n                    validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n        best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n        attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n        pls\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n    )\n    \n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 10.2 INITIALISE RESULT TABLES\n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    \n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n    \n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n    \n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 10.3 INITIALISE PREDICTION DF\n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    \n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    preds_df <- if (do_predictions) XRF_new else NULL\n    \n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 10.4 MODEL LOOP\n    # --------------------------------------------------------------\n    \n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n    \n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n      \n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n      \n      # Predictions on calibration data (safe)\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        else    \n      # R2, RMSE, RMSEP\n      R2 <- tryCatch({\n        SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      \n      RMSE <- tryCatch(\n        sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),\n        error=function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n        fmla_single else fmla_multi\n      \n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      # AIC/BIC\n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(AIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      # Save to global summary\n  bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n      \n      diag_df <- add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = ----------------------------------------------------------\n      \n      if (do_predictions) {\n        \n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n = XRF_new, interval = \"prediction\", level = 0.95),\n            error=function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(pi_obj)) {\n            lower_log <- pi_obj[, \"lwr\"]\n   mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n    \n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k,
