fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n          w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2)\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          rm  <- lm(abs(ols$residuals) ~ ols$fitted.values)\n          w   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w)\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n        } else NULL\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n      \n      if (is.null(fit)) next\n      \n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n      \n      if (is.null(pred)) next\n      \n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n      \n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n    \n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n  \n  # ===============================================================\n  # 7. EXPLANATION TEXT & GLOBAL STORAGE\n  # ===============================================================\n  expl_rank   <- \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\"\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk: p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan: p < 0.05 indicates heteroscedasticity.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE (log-space).\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold CV error (log-space).\"\n  \n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n  \n  preds_store <- list()\n  \n  # ===============================================================\n  # 8. ELEMENT LOOP\n  # ===============================================================\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n  \n  for (el in elements) {\n    \n    pb_elements$tick()\n    \n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n    \n    element_dir <- file.path(all_base, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n    \n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0)\n      warning(paste(\"Issues in\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n    \n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    fmla_multi  <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \")))\n    \n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n    \n    # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 8.1 FIT MODELS (never skip; failures -> NULL)\n    # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n    model_list <- list(\n      OLS = tryCatch(lm(fmla_single, data = data), error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      WLS = tryCatch({\n        ols <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n        rm  <- lm(abs(ols$residuals) ~ ols$fitted.values)\n        w   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n        lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      OLS_weighted = tryCatch({\n        if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n          lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n        else NULL\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      WLS_weighted = tryCatch({\n        if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n          init <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n          w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2)\n        } else NULL\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      Bayes = tryCatch(bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data), error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      RF = tryCatch(\n        randomForest(fmla_multi, data = data, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE),\n        error = function(e) NULL\n      ),\n      \n      PLS_LOO = tryCatch({\n        pls <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n        best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n        attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n        pls\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      PLS_kfold = tryCatch({\n        pls <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE,\n                    validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n        best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n        attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n        pls\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n    )\n    \n    # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 8.2 PER-ELEMENT TABLES & PRED DF\n    # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n    \n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n    \n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    preds_df <- if (do_predictions) XRF_new else NULL\n    \n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n```\n\n---\n\n## u2b50 CHUNK 2 of 6 u2014 model loop, metrics, plots, ranking, per-element output\n\n```r\n    # ===============================================================\n    # 8.3 MODEL LOOP\n    # ===============================================================\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n      \n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n      \n      # Predictions on calibration data\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        else if (!is.null(m))\n          as.numeric(predict(m))\n        else\n          rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))\n      }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n      \n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n      \n      # Metrics\n      R2 <- tryCatch({\n        SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      \n      RMSE <- tryCatch(\n        sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n        fmla_single else fmla_multi\n      \n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      ranking_df <- dplyr::add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      global_summary <- dplyr::add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2,\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\n        BIC     = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      # Diagnostics\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- unname(sh$statistic)\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n      \n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\n        AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\n        BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\n      )\n      \n      # Predictions for XRF_new\n      if (do_predictions) {\n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = XRF_new))\n          else if ===============================================================\n  # 6. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER\n  # ===============================================================\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n    \n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n    \n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      \n      fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n          w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2)\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          rm  <- lm(abs(ols$residuals) ~ ols$fitted.values)\n          w   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w)\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n        } else NULL\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n      \n      if (is.null(fit)) next\n      \n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n      \n      if (is.null(pred)) next\n      \n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n      \n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n    \n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n  \n  # ===============================================================\n  # 7. EXPLANATION TEXT & GLOBAL STORAGE\n  # ===============================================================\n  expl_rank   <- \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\"\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk: p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan: p < 0.05 indicates heteroscedasticity.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE (log-space).\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold CV error (log-space).\"\n  \n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n  \n  preds_store <- list()\n  \n  # ===============================================================\n  # 8. ELEMENT LOOP\n  # ===============================================================\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n  \n  for (el in elements) {\n    \n    pb_elements$tick()\n    \n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n    \n    element_dir <- file.path(all_base, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n    \n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0)\n      warning(paste(\"Issues in\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n    \n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    fmla_multi  <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \")))\n    \n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n    \n    # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 8.1 FIT MODELS (never skip; failures -> NULL)\n    # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n    model_list <- list(\n      OLS = tryCatch(lm(fmla_single, data = data), error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      WLS = tryCatch({\n        ols <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n        rm  <- lm(abs(ols$residuals) ~ ols$fitted.values)\n        w   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n        lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      OLS_weighted = tryCatch({\n        if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n          lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n        else NULL\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      WLS_weighted = tryCatch({\n        if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n          init <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n          w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2)\n        } else NULL\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      Bayes = tryCatch(bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data), error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      RF = tryCatch(\n        randomForest(fmla_multi, data = data, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE),\n        error = function(e) NULL\n      ),\n      \n      PLS_LOO = tryCatch({\n        pls <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n        best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n        attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n        pls\n      }, error = function(e) NULL),\n      \n      PLS_kfold = tryCatch({\n        pls <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE,\n                    validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n        best <- selectNcomp(pls, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n        attr(pls, \"best_ncomp\") <- best\n        pls\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n    )\n    \n    # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n    # 8.2 PER-ELEMENT TABLES & PRED DF\n    # ---------------------------------------------------------------\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n    \n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n    \n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    preds_df <- if (do_predictions) XRF_new else NULL\n    \n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n```\n\n---\n\n## u2b50 CHUNK 2 of 6 u2014 model loop, metrics, calibration plots (with jco), per-element outputs\n\n```r\n    # ===============================================================\n    # 8.3 MODEL LOOP\n    # ===============================================================\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n      \n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n      \n      # Predictions on calibration data\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        else if (!is.null(m))\n          as.numeric(predict(m))\n        else\n          rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))\n      }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n      \n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n      \n      # Metrics\n      R2 <- tryCatch({\n        SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      \n      RMSE <- tryCatch(\n        sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n        fmla_single else fmla_multi\n      \n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      ranking_df <- dplyr::add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      global_summary <- dplyr::add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2,\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\n        BIC     = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      # Diagnostics\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- unname(sh$statistic)\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n      \n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n      \n      diag_df <- dplyr::add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\n        AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\n        BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\n      )\n      \n      # Predictions for XRF_new\n      if (do_predictions) {\n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = XRF_new))\n          else if (!is.null(m))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = XRF_new))\n          else\n            rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new))\n        }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new)))\n        \n        lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n        upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n        \n        if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\") && !is.null(m)) {\n          pi_obj <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, interval = \"prediction\", level = 0.95),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(pi_obj)) {\n            lower_log <- pi_obj[, \"lwr\"]\n            upper_log <- pi_obj[, \"upr\"]\n          }\n        }\n        \n        preds_df[[paste0(mname, \"_\", el, \"_Pred_ppm\")]] <- exp(pred_new_log)\n        preds_df[[paste0(mname, \"_\", el, \"_L95_ppm\")]]  <- exp(lower_log)\n        preds_df[[paste0(mname, \"_\", el, \"_U95_ppm\")]]  <- exp(upper_log)\n      }\n      \n      # PLOTS: Pred vs Obs (jco, colour by Site), Residuals, Influence, PLS RMSEP\n      \n      stats_label <- paste0(\n        \"Ru00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSEP = \", signif(RMSEP_val, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSE = \", signif(RMSE, 3)\n      )\n      \n      df_pred <- data.frame(\n        Observed  = y,\n        Predicted = pred,\n        Site      = data$Site\n      )\n      \n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, colour = Site)) +\n        geom_point(size = 1.25, alpha = 0.85) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco(name = \"Site\") +\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = \"black\") +\n        annotate(\n          \"text\",\n          x = min(df_pred$Observed,  na.rm = TRUE),\n          y = max(df_pred$Predicted, na.rm = TRUE),\n          hjust = 0, vjust = 1,\n          label = stats_label, size = 2.7\n        ) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Predicted vs Observed\"))\n      \n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n        p_po, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\n      )\n      \n      res_df   <- data.frame(resid = resid_vals)\n      hist_obj <- hist(resid_vals, plot = FALSE)\n      \n      p_res <- ggplot(res_df, aes(resid)) +\n        geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = \"grey80\") +\n        geom_density(colour = \"red\") +\n        annotate(\n          \"text\",\n          x = min(resid_vals, na.rm = TRUE),\n          y = max(hist_obj$counts, na.rm = TRUE),\n          hjust = 0, vjust = 1,\n          label = stats_label, size = 2.7\n        ) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Residuals\"))\n      \n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Residuals.pdf\")),\n        p_res, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\n      )\n      \n      # Influence (lm only)\n      if (inherits(m, \"lm\") && !inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n        cooks <- cooks.distance(m)\n        lev   <- hatvalues(m)\n        rstd  <- rstandard(m)\n        \n        inf_df <- data.frame(\n          obs (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PLS_RMSEP.pdf\")),\n            width = 13/2.54, height = 9/2.54)\n        \n        validationplot(\n          m,\n          val.type = \"RMSEP\",\n          main = paste(el, mname, \"- RMSEP vs Components\")\n        )\n        \n        dev.off()\n      }\n      \n    } # end model loop\n    \n    # ===============================================================\n    # 8.4 MODEL RANKING & DIAG OUTPUT\n    # ===============================================================\n    if (nrow(ranking_df) > 0) {\n      ranking_df <- ranking_df %>%\n        dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(R2), RMSEP, RMSE) %>%\n        dplyr::mutate(Rank = dplyr::row_number())\n      \n      ranking_expl_df <- ranking_df %>%\n        dplyr::mutate(\n          Rank_explanation  = expl_rank,\n          R2_explanation    = expl_r2,\n          RMSE_explanation  = expl_rmse,\n          RMSEP_explanation = expl_rmsep\n     \"\",\n      \"Ranking: highest Ru00b2, then lowest RMSEP, then lowest RMSE.\"\n    )\n    \n    writeLines(readme_txt, file.path(element_dir, \"README.txt\"))\n    \n  } # end element loop\n```\n\n---\n\n## u2b50 CHUNK 3 of 6 u2014 site-level depth & age profiles (with ICP_ppm error bars, npg colours)\n\n```r\n  # ===============================================================\n  # 9.     geom_path(\n                  data = ace_overlay,\n                  aes(x = ICP_ppm, y = depth,\n                      colour = \"ICP-MS (Observed)\"),\n                  linewidth = 0.6,\n function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n        fmla_single else fmla_multi\n      \n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      ranking_df <- dplyr::add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      global_summary <- dplyr::add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2,\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\n        BIC     = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      # Diagnostics\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- unname(sh$statistic)\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n      \n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n     )\n      \n      # Predictions for XRF_new\n      if (do_predictions) {\n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = XRF_new))\n          else if (!is.null(m))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = XRF_new))\n          else\n            rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new))\n        }, error error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(pi_obj)) {\n            lower_log <- pi_obj[, \"lwr\"]\n            upper_log <- pi_obj[, \"upr\"]\n          }\n        }\n        \n \"_U95_ppm\")]]  <- exp(upper_log)\n      }\n      \n      # ------------------------------------------------------------\n      # Calibration plots: Pred vs Obs (Site-coloured, jco), Residuals\n list()\n    \n    # OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- tryCatch(\n      lm(fmla_single, data = data),\n      error = function(e) NULL\n    )\n    \n    # WLS (residual-based)\n    model_list$WLS <- tryCatch({\n      if (is.null(model_list$OLS)) stop(\"No OLS for WLS\")\n      ols_fit <- model_list$OLS\n      r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n      rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n      w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n      lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_ols)\n    }, error = function(e) NULL)\n    \n    # OLS_weighted & WLS_weighted (SD-based)\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- tryCatch({\n        w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n        lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n      \n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- tryCatch({\n        w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n        init_sd <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n        rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n        w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n        lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2_sd)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n    }\n    \n    # Bayes (multivariate)\n    model_list$Bayes <- tryCatch(\n      bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data),\n      error = function(e) NULL\n    )\n    \n    # Random Forest (multivariate)\n    model_list$RF <- tryCatch(\n      randomForest(fmla_multi, data = data, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE),\n      error = function(e) NULL\n    )\n    \n    # PLS LOOCV\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- tryCatch({\n      pls_loo <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n      best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n      attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n      pls_loo\n    }, error = function(e) NULL)\n    \n    # PLS k-fold\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- tryCatch({\n      pls_k <- plsr(fmla_multi, data = data, scale = TRUE,\n                    validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n      best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n      attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n      pls_k\n    }, error = function(e) NULL)\n    \n    ############################################################\n    # 10.2 PER-ELEMENT TABLES & PRED DF\n    ############################################################\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n    \n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC               = numeric()\n    )\n    \n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    preds_df <- if (do_predictions) XRF_new else NULL\n    \n    ############################################################\n    # 10.3 MODEL LOOP\n    ############################################################\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n    \n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n      \n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n      \n      # Calibration predictions\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (is.null(m)) {\n          rep(NA_real_, nrow(data))\n        } else if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n          nc <- attr(m, \"best_ncomp\")\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = nc, newdata = data))\n        } else {\n          as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = data))\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n      \n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n      \n      # Metrics\n      R2 <- tryCatch({\n        SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)\n        1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      \n      RMSE <- tryCatch(\n        sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n        fmla_single else fmla_multi\n      \n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      \n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")) && !is.null(m))\n        tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")) && !is.null(m))\n        tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      ranking_df <- add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      global_summary <- add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2,\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\n        BIC     = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      ############################################################\n      # Diagnostics\n      ############################################################\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- ############################################################\n      # PREDICTIONS ON XRF_new (log u2192 ppm)\n      ############################################################\n      if \"best_ncomp\")\n            as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = nc, newdata = XRF_new))\n          } else {\n            as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = XRF_new))\n          }\n        }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new)))\n        \n        lower_log <- upper_log <- pred_new_log\n        \n        if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\") && RMSE\n            upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n          }\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\" && !is.null(m)) {\n          p_bayes <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = CALIBRATION PLOTS (Pred vs Obs, Residuals)\n      ############################################################\n      stats_label <- paste0(\n        \"Ru00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSEP \n    write.csv(\n      diag_df,\n      file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_Diagnostics_Summary.csv\")),\n      row.names = FALSE\n    )\n    \n    ############################################################\n    # 10.5 SAVE PREDICTIONS, STORE, README\n    ############################################################\n    if (!is.null(preds_df)) Convert to ppm\n        pred_ppm  <- exp(pred_new_log)\n        lower_ppm <- exp(lower_log)\n        upper_ppm <- exp(upper_log)\n        \n        base <- paste(mname, el, sep=\"_\")\n        preds_df[[paste0(base,\"_Pred_ppm\")]] <- pred_ppm\n        preds_df[[paste0(base,\"_L95_ppm\")]]  <- lower_ppm\n        preds_df[[paste0(base,\"_U95_ppm\")]]  <- upper_ppm\n      }\n      \n      ############################################################\n      # 9.7 PLOTS: PREDICTED VS OBSERVED & RESIDUALS\n      ############################################################\n      \n      # Stats label\n      stats_label <- paste0(\n        \"Ru00b2 = \", signif(R2_val,3),\n        \"\\nRMSEP = \", signif(RMSEP_val,3),\n        \"\\nRMSE = \", signif(RMSE_val,3)\n      )\n      \n      df_pred <- data.frame(\n        Observed  = y,\n        Predicted = pred,\n        Site      = data$Site\n      )\n      \n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, color=Site)) +\n        geom_point(size=1.3, alpha=0.85) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco(name=\"Site\") +\n        geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, colour=\"black\") +\n        annotate(\"text\",\n                 x=min(df_pred$Observed,na.rm=TRUE),\n                 y=max(df_pred$Predicted,na.rm=TRUE),\n                 hjust=0, vjust=1,\n                 label=stats_label, size=2.7) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Predicted vs Observed (log-space)\"))\n      \n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el,\"_\",mname,\"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n        p_po, width=13, height=9, units=\"cm\"\n      )\n      \n      # end model loop\n```\n\n---\n\n# ud83dudd25 **CHUNK 3 of 6**  \n(Ranking, diagnostics saving, storing predictions, README)\n\n```r\n    ############################################################\n    # MODEL LABELS / COLOURS\n  ############################################################\n  model_levels <- c(\n    \"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\",\n    \"Bayes\",\"RF\",\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\"\n  )\n  \n  model_labels <- c(\n    \"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS(wt)\",\"WLS(wt)\",\n    \"Bayes\",\"RF\",\"PLS(LOO)\",\"PLS(k)\"\n  )\n  \n  cols_models <- ggsci::pal_npg(\"nrc\")(length(model_labels))\n  names(cols_models) <- model_labels\n  \n  # custom overrides\n  cols_models[\"Bayes\"]  <- \"gold2\"\n  cols_models[\"RF\"]     <- \"steelblue\"\n  cols_models[\"PLS(k)\"] <- \"salmon3\"\n  \n  # We draw ICP in blue manually (not via colour scale)\n  cols_all <- cols_models\n  \n  ############################################################\n  # 6. DATA INTEGRITY CHECK\n  ############################################################\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n    errs <- c()\n    \n    req <- c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (v in req)\n      if (!v %in% names(data))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(\"Missing:\", v))\n    \n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\n    \n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(y_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    \n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\n    \n    errs\n  }\n  \n  ############################################################\n  # 7. 10-FOLD CV RMSE\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n      mname, formula, data, y_col,\n      var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA, k = 10\n  ) {\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n    \n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n    \n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop=FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop=FALSE]\n      \n      fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          init <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          rr   <- abs(residuals(init))\n          rm_w <- lm(rr ~ fitted(init))\n          w2   <- 1/(rm_w$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2)\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 500)\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n        } else NULL\n      }, error=function(e) NULL)\n      \n      if (is.null(fit)) next\n      \n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit,\"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = test))\n      }, error=function(e) NULL)\n      \n      if (is.null(pred)) next\n      \n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(pred) & !is.na(y_test)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n      \n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok]-pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n    \n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n  \n  ############################################################\n  # 8. GLOBAL SUMMARY STRUCTURES\n  ############################################################\n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n  \n  preds_store <- list()\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 2 of 6 u2014 Model fitting, predictions, calibration plots\n\n```r\n  ############################################################\n  # 9. LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\n  ############################################################\n  \n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n  \n  for (el in elements) {\n    \n    pb_elements$tick()\n    \n    y_col   <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col   <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, \"_var\")\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP_sd\")\n    \n    element_dir <- file.path(all_base, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n    \n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      warning(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse=\"; \")))\n      next\n    }\n    \n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    fmla_multi  <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse=\" + \")))\n    \n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n    \n    ############################################################\n    # 9.1 FIT MODELS\n    ############################################################\n    model_list <- list()\n    \n    # OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n    \n    # WLS\n    {\n      init <- model_list$OLS\n      rr   <- abs(residuals(init))\n      rm_w <- lm(rr ~ fitted(init))\n      w2   <- 1/(rm_w$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2)\n    }\n    \n    # OLS_weighted / WLS_weighted\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      \n      init2 <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rr2   <- abs(residuals(init2))\n      rm2   <- lm(rr2 ~ fitted(init2))\n      w22   <- 1/(rm2$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w22)\n    }\n    \n    # Bayes\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data)\n    \n    # RF\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      ntree = 500,\n      importance = TRUE\n    )\n    \n    # PLS LOOCV\n    pls_loo <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"LOO\"\n    )\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method=\"onesigma\", plot=FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n    \n    # PLS k-fold\n    pls_k <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"CV\",\n      segments = 10\n    )\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method=\"onesigma\", plot=FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n    \n    ############################################################\n    # 9.2 RESULT TABLES & PRED DF\n    ############################################################\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n    \n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC               = numeric()\n    )\n    \n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    preds_df <- if (do_predictions) XRF_new else NULL\n    \n    ############################################################\n    # 9.3 MODEL LOOP\n    ############################################################\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n    \n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n      \n      pred <-     R2_val <- 1 - SS_res/SS_tot\n      \n      RMSE_val <- sqrt(mean((y[ok] - pred[ok])^2))\n      \n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n        fmla_single else fmla_multi\n      \n      RMSEP_val <- cv_rmse_for_model(\n        mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n        var_col, sd_col,\n        best_ncomp = if (inherits(m,\"mvr\")) attr(m,\"best_ncomp\") else NA\n      )\n      \n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m,c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(AIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m,c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(BIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      \n      ranking_df <- add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2_val,\n        RMSE  = RMSE_val,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      global_summary <- add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2_val,\n        RMSE    = RMSE_val,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\n        BIC     = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      ##########################################################\n      # Diagnostics\n      ##########################################################\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- unname(sh$statistic)\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n      \n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m,c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- unname(bp$statistic)\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n      \n      diag_df <- add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\n        BIC               = BIC_val\n      )\n      \n      ##########################################################\n      # Predictions on XRF_new u2192 ppm\n      ##########################################################\n      if (do_predictions) {\n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m,\"mvr\"))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m,\"best_ncomp\"), newdata = XRF_new))\n          else\n            as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = XRF_new))\n        },       pi_obj <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, interval=\"prediction\", level=0.95),\n            error=function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(pi_obj)) {\n            lower_log <- pi_obj[,\"lwr\"]\n            upper_log <- pi_obj[,\"upr\"]\n          } else {\n            lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96*RMSE_val\n            upper_log <- pred_new_log + error=function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(p_bayes)) {\n            fit <- as.numeric(p_bayes$fit)\n            se  <- as.numeric(p_bayes$se.fit)\n            pred_new_log <- fit\n            lower_log    <- fit - 1.96*se\n            upper_log    <- fit + 1.96*se\n          } else {\n            lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96*RMSEP_val\n            upper_log <- pred_new_log + paste0(el,\"_\",mname,\"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n        p_po, width=13, height=9, units=\"cm\"\n      )\n      \n      res_df <- data.frame(resid = resid_vals)\n      hist_obj <- hist(resid_vals, plot=FALSE)\n      p_res <- ggplot(res_df, aes(resid)) +\n        geom_histogram(bins=30, fill=\"grey80\") +\n        geom_density(colour=\"red\") +\n        annotate(\"text\",\n                 x=min(resid_vals,na.rm=TRUE),\n                 y=max(hist_obj$counts),\n                 hjust=0, vjust=1,\n                 label=stats_label, size=2.7) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Residuals (log-space)\"))\n      \n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el,\"_\",mname,\"_Residuals.pdf\")),\n        p_res, width=13, height=9,               "Below is an example of **R code that performs k-fold cross-validation** (default 10-fold) for your weighted linear model and computes **RMSEP** for each fold and overall.  \nIt uses **caret** for convenience, but I also include a **manual CV version** if you prefer not to rely on caret.\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **Option 1 u2014 Using `caret` (simplest, recommended)**\n\n```r\nlibrary(caret)\n\n# Original models\nACE_Ca_model_wt <- lm(Ca_ICP ~ Ca, data = ACE_dataset, weight = 1/Ca_ICP_sd^2)\n\nACE_Ca_wt_wt <- 1 / lm(abs(ACE_Ca_model_wt$residuals) ~ \n                       ACE_Ca_model_wt$fitted.values)$fitted.values^2\n\nACE_dataset$weights <- ACE_Ca_wt_wt\n\n# Define 10-fold cross-validation\ntrain_ctrl <- trainControl(method = \"cv\", number = 10)\n\n# Train weighted model under CV\ncv_model <- train(\n  Ca_ICP ~ Ca,\n  data = ACE_dataset,\n  method = \"lm\",\n  weights = weights,\n  trControl = train_ctrl,\n  metric = \"RMSE\"\n)\n\n# Print RMSE (this is RMSEP)\ncv_model\n```\n\n**caretu2019s RMSE output = RMSEP** (Root Mean Squared Error of Prediction).\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **Option 2 u2014 Manual k-fold cross-validation (no packages required)**\n\n```r\nset.seed(123)\n\nk <- 10\nn <- nrow(ACE_dataset)\nfolds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n\nRMSEP_values <- numeric(k)\n\nfor (i in 1:k) {\n  # Split\n  train_data <- ACE_dataset[folds != i, ]\n  test_data  <- ACE_dataset[folds == i, ]\n  \n  # First-stage model for weights\n  stage1 <- lm(Ca_ICP ~ Ca, data = train_data, weight = 1/train_data$Ca_ICP_sd^2)\n  \n  # Calculate weights\n  wt <- 1 / lm(abs(stage1$residuals) ~ stage1$fitted.values)$fitted.values^2\n  \n  # Run weighted regression\n  model <- lm(Ca_ICP ~ Ca, data = train_data, weights = wt)\n  \n  # Predict\n  preds <- predict(model, newdata = test_data)\n  \n  # Compute RMSEP for this fold\n  RMSEP_values[i] <- sqrt(mean((test_data$Ca_ICP - preds)^2))\n}\n\n# Overall RMSEP\noverall_RMSEP <- mean(RMSEP_values)\n\nRMSEP_values\noverall_RMSEP\n```\n\n---\n\n# u2714 **Output**\n- `RMSEP_values` u2192 RMSEP for each fold  \n- `overall_RMSEP` u2192 average RMSEP across folds  \n\n---\n\nIf you want:\nu2705 plot of predicted vs observed for each fold  \nu2705 repeated CV (e.g., 10u00d710)  \nu2705 bootstrap RMSEP  \nLet me know and I can add it."

              "Below is a clear workflow showing **how to evaluate cross-validated performance** *and* **prediction error on an independent test set** for your weighted two-stage WLS model (like your Ca and Ti models).  \n\nYou get **two performance metrics**:\n\n1. **Cross-validated RMSEP** u2013 internal estimate of predictive error  \n2. **Independent Test-Set RMSEP** u2013 external validation on held-out data  \n\n---\n\n# u2b50 **1. Split data into TRAIN and TEST sets**\n\nYou cannot evaluate test-set prediction error unless some data were **not used** in training.\n\n```r\nset.seed(123)\n\n# 80% train, 20% test split\ntrain_index <- sample(seq_len(nrow(ACE_dataset)), size = 0.8*nrow(ACE_dataset))\n\ntrain_data <- ACE_dataset[train_index, ]\ntest_data  <- ACE_dataset[-train_index, ]\n```\n\n---\n\n# u2b50 **2. Perform k-fold CV on the TRAIN set only**\n\nThis prevents leakage.\n\n```r\nk <- 10\nn <- nrow(train_data)\nfolds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n\nRMSEP_CV <- numeric(k)\n\nfor (i in 1:k) {\n\n  cv_train <- train_data[folds != i, ]\n  cv_test  <- train_data[folds == i, ]\n\n  # Stage 1: model for weights\n  stage1 <- lm(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = cv_train,\n               weight = 1/cv_train$Ti_ICP_sd^2)\n\n  # Compute second-stage weights\n  wt <- 1 / lm(abs(stage1$residuals) ~ stage1$fitted.values)$fitted.values^2\n\n  # Weighted least squares model\n  model <- lm(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = cv_train, weights = wt)\n\n  # Predict on validation fold\n  preds <- predict(model, newdata = cv_test)\n\n  # Cross-validated RMSEP for fold\n  RMSEP_CV[i] <- sqrt(mean((cv_test$Ti_ICP - preds)^2))\n}\n\nCV_RMSEP <- mean(RMSEP_CV)\nCV_RMSEP\n```\n\nu2714 This gives you **cross-validated predictive error** based only on training data.\n\n---\n\n# u2b50 **3. Fit the FINAL MODEL on all TRAIN data**\n\n```r\n# Stage 1 model on entire training set\nstage1_final <- lm(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = train_data,\n                   weight = 1/train_data$Ti_ICP_sd^2)\n\n# Final weights\nwt_final <- 1 / lm(abs(stage1_final$residuals) ~ \n                   stage1_final$fitted.values)$fitted.values^2\n\n# Final weighted model used for predictions\nfinal_model <- lm(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = train_data, weights = wt_final)\n```\n\n---\n\n# u2b50 **4. Evaluate performance on the INDEPENDENT TEST SET**\n\n```r\ntest_preds <- predict(final_model, newdata = test_data)\n\nTest_RMSEP <- sqrt(mean((test_data$Ti_ICP - test_preds)^2))\nTest_RMSEP\n```\n\nu2714 This gives **true external prediction error**, completely independent of training.\n\n---\n\n# ud83dudcca **Summary of outputs**\n\n| Metric | Meaning |\n|--------|---------|\n| **CV_RMSEP** | Cross-validated RMSEP (internal estimate of predictive performance) |\n| **Test_RMSEP** | RMSEP computed on fully independent test set (external validation) |\n\nBoth together provide a strong validation strategy similar to chemometric standards (e.g., IUPAC, ISO 8466-1).\n\n---\n\n# If you want, I can also provide:\nu2705 code for the Ca model version  \nu2705 repeated CV or leave-one-out CV  \nu2705 plots of predicted vs. observed for training CV and test set  \nJust tell me!"

              "Below is the **complete workflow** including **RMSEP + Ru00b2** for both:\n\n1. **Cross-validated (CV) training performance**  \n2. **Independent test-set performance**\n\nWritten for the **Ti model**, but you can duplicate it for Ca by changing variable names.\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **1. Train/Test Split**\n\n```r\nset.seed(123)\n\n# 80/20 split\ntrain_index <- sample(seq_len(nrow(ACE_dataset)), size = 0.8*nrow(ACE_dataset))\ntrain_data <- ACE_dataset[train_index, ]\ntest_data  <- ACE_dataset[-train_index, ]\n```\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **2. k-fold Cross-Validation on the TRAIN set (RMSEP + Ru00b2)**\n\n```r\nk <- 10\nn <- nrow(train_data)\nfolds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n\nRMSEP_CV <- numeric(k)\nR2_CV    <- numeric(k)\n\nfor (i in 1:k) {\n  \n  cv_train <- train_data[folds != i, ]\n  cv_test  <- train_data[folds == i, ]\n  \n  # Stage 1: model for variance weights\n  stage1 <- lm(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = cv_train,\n               weight = 1/cv_train$Ti_ICP_sd^2)\n  \n  # Stage 2 weights\n  wt <- 1 / lm(abs(stage1$residuals) ~ stage1$fitted.values)$fitted.values^2\n  \n  # Final WLS model for this fold\n  model <- lm(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = cv_train, weights = wt)\n  \n  # Predictions on CV fold\n  preds <- predict(model, newdata = cv_test)\n  obs   <- cv_test$Ti_ICP\n  \n  # RMSEP for fold\n  RMSEP_CV[i] <- sqrt(mean((obs - preds)^2))\n  \n  # Ru00b2 for fold: 1 - SSE/SST\n  SSE <- sum((obs - preds)^2)\n  SST <- sum((obs - mean(obs))^2)\n  R2_CV[i] <- 1 - SSE/SST\n}\n\n# Averages across folds\nCV_RMSEP <- mean(RMSEP_CV)\nCV_R2    <- mean(R2_CV)\n\nCV_RMSEP\nCV_R2\n```\n\nYou now have:  \n- **CV_RMSEP** = cross-validated RMSEP  \n- **CV_Ru00b2** = mean cross-validated Ru00b2  \n\n---\n\n# u2705 **3. Fit model to the full dataset**\n\n```r\n# Stage 1: variance-based weights\nstage1_full <- lm(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = ACE_dataset,\n                  weight = 1 / Ti_ICP_sd^2)\n\n# Stage 2: weights based on residual structure\nwt_full <- 1 / lm(abs(stage1_full$residuals) ~ \n                  stage1_full$fitted.values)$fitted.values^2\n\n# Final weighted least squares model on the full dataset\nfinal_full_model <- lm(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = ACE_dataset, weights = wt_full)\n```\n\n---\n\n# u2b50 **2. RMSEP (prediction RMSE using Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation)**\n\nRMSEP = u201croot mean squared error of predictionu201d  \nu2192 Must be computed using *data not used for fitting the model* for each predicted point.\n\nLOOCV avoids having to choose k and is standard in analytical calibration.\n\n```r\nn <- nrow(ACE_dataset)\npred_LOO <- numeric(n)\n\nfor (i in 1:n) {\n  \n  # Leave out sample i\n  train_LOO <- ACE_dataset[-i, ]\n  test_LOO  <- ACE_dataset[i, ]\n  \n  # Stage 1 model\n  stage1 <- lm(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = train_LOO,\n               weight = 1 / train_LOO$Ti_ICP_sd^2)\n  \n  # Stage 2 weights\n  wts <- 1 / lm(abs(stage1$residuals) ~ stage1$fitted.values)$fitted.values^2\n  \n  # Final WLS model on training LOO set\n  model <- lm(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = train_LOO, weights = wts)\n  \n  # Predict the left-out point\n  pred_LOO[i] <- predict(model, newdata = test_LOO)\n}\n\n# RMSEP = RMSE of cross-validated predictions\nRMSEP_full <- sqrt(mean( (ACE_dataset$Ti_ICP - pred_LOO)^2 ))\nRMSEP_full\n```\n\n---\n\n# u2b50 **Output Summary**\n\n| Metric | Meaning |\n|--------|---------|\n| **RMSE_full** | Fit error (model tested on same data) |\n| **RMSEP_full** | Predictive error (model tested on left-out samples) |\n\n---\n\n# If you want  \nI can produce:\n\nud83dudccc the same code for **Ca**  \nud83dudccc a function to compute RMSE + RMSEP for any analyte  \nud83dudccc plots of predicted vs. observed (training vs. CV)  \n\nJust let me know!"

              "Here is a **single, clean, reusable R function** that performs **ALL calculations** for your two-stage weighted linear model:\n\n### u2714 Fits Stage-1 weighted model  \n### u2714 Computes Stage-2 residual-based weights  \n### u2714 Fits final WLS model  \n### u2714 Computes  \n- **Ru00b2**  \n- **RMSE**  \n- **RMSEP (LOO-CV)**  \n- **Ru00b2cv (predictive Ru00b2)**  \n\nYou can apply it to **Ti**, **Ca**, or any analyte by changing the formula and weight column.\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **Complete Function**\n\n```r\nvalidate_two_stage_wls <- function(formula, data, var_sd_col) {\n  # formula: e.g., Ti_ICP ~ Ti\n  # data: your dataframe\n  # var_sd_col: name of sd column as string, e.g. \"Ti_ICP_sd\"\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # Stage 1 - initial weighted model\n  # -------------------------\n  w1 <- 1 / data[[var_sd_col]]^2\n  stage1 <- lm(formula, data = data, weights = w1)\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # Stage 2 - residual-based weights\n  # -------------------------\n  abs_resid <- abs(stage1$residuals)\n  fit_vals  <- stage1$fitted.values\n  \n  stage2_wt <- 1 / lm(abs_resid ~ fit_vals)$fitted.values^2\n  \n  # Final weighted least squares model\n  final_model <- lm(formula, data = data, weights = stage2_wt)\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # Training predictions\n  # -------------------------\n  obs  <- model.response(model.frame(formula, data))\n  pred <- predict(final_model)\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # Ru00b2 and RMSE (training)\n  # -------------------------\n  SSE <- sum((obs - pred)^2)\n  SST <- sum((obs - mean(obs))^2)\n  \n  R2   <- 1 - SSE / SST\n  RMSE <- sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2))\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # LOOCV RMSEP + Ru00b2cv\n  # -------------------------\n  n <- nrow(data)\n  pred_LOO <- numeric(n)\n  \n  for (i in 1:n) {\n    train <- data[-i, ]\n    test  <- data[i, , drop = FALSE]\n    \n    # Stage 1 for LOO\n    w1_loo <- 1 / train[[var_sd_col]]^2\n    stage1_loo <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = w1_loo)\n    \n    # Stage 2 weights for LOO\n    abs_resid_loo <- abs(stage1_loo$residuals)\n    fit_vals_loo  <- stage1_loo$fitted.values\n    stage2_wt_loo <- 1 / lm(abs_resid_loo ~ fit_vals_loo)$fitted.values^2\n    \n    # Final WLS LOO model\n    model_loo <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = stage2_wt_loo)\n    \n    # LOO prediction\n    pred_LOO[i] <- predict(model_loo, newdata = test)\n  }\n  \n  RMSEP <- sqrt(mean((obs - pred_LOO)^2))\n  \n  SSE_cv <- sum((obs - pred_LOO)^2)\n  SST_cv <- sum((obs - mean(obs))^2)\n  R2_cv  <- 1 - SSE_cv / SST_cv\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # Return results nicely\n  # -------------------------\n  return(list(\n    final_model = final_model,\n    R2 = R2,\n    RMSE = RMSE,\n    RMSEP = RMSEP,\n    R2_cv = R2_cv\n  ))\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **How to Use the Function**\n\n### **For Ti**\n\n```r\nresults_Ti <- validate_two_stage_wls(\n  Ti_ICP ~ Ti,\n  data = ACE_dataset,\n  var_sd_col = \"Ti_ICP_sd\"\n)\n\nresults_Ti\n```\n\n### **For Ca**\n\n```r\nresults_Ca <- validate_two_stage_wls(\n  Ca_ICP ~ Ca,\n  data = ACE_dataset,\n  var_sd_col = \"Ca_ICP_sd\"\n)\n\nresults_Ca\n```\n\n---\n\n# ud83cudfaf **What you get**\n\nEach call returns a list containing:\n\n- `final_model` u2013 the final two-stage WLS model  \n- `R2` u2013 training Ru00b2  \n- `RMSE` u2013 training RMSE  \n- `RMSEP` u2013 LOOCV RMSE (true prediction error)  \n- `R2_cv` u2013 LOOCV Ru00b2 (predictive Ru00b2)  \n\n---\n\nIf you want, I can also:  \nud83dudccc Add plots (obs vs pred, CV vs training)  \nud83dudccc Add k-fold CV instead of LOOCV  \nud83dudccc Add prediction intervals  \n\nJust tell me!"

              "Below is an **enhanced version of your validation function** that includes:\n\n### u2705 **Observed vs. Predicted plots (training & CV)**  \n### u2705 **k-fold cross-validation instead of LOOCV**  \n### u2705 **Prediction intervals for the final model**  \n### u2014 all in one function.\n\nThe function returns:  \n- Model object  \n- Training metrics (Ru00b2, RMSE)  \n- k-fold CV metrics (RMSEP, Ru00b2cv)  \n- Prediction intervals  \n- ggplot objects (training plot + CV plot)\n\nYou can plot them with `print(results$plot_train)` or `print(results$plot_cv)`.\n\n---\n\n# u2b50 **FULL FUNCTION WITH PLOTS + K-FOLD CV + PREDICTION INTERVALS**\n\n```r\nlibrary(ggplot2)\n\nvalidate_two_stage_wls_kfold <- function(\n    formula, \n    data, \n    var_sd_col, \n    k = 10, \n    alpha = 0.05\n) {\n  # Extract outcome\n  mf <- model.frame(formula, data)\n  obs <- model.response(mf)\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # Stage 1 u2014 initial weighted regression\n  # -------------------------\n  w1 <- 1 / data[[var_sd_col]]^2\n  stage1 <- lm(formula, data = data, weights = w1)\n  \n  # Stage 2 weights based on absolute residual fit\n  abs_resid <- abs(stage1$residuals)\n  fit_vals  <- stage1$fitted.values\n  stage2_wt <- 1 / lm(abs_resid ~ fit_vals)$fitted.values^2\n  \n  # Final weighted LS model\n  final_model <- lm(formula, data = data, weights = stage2_wt)\n  pred_train  <- predict(final_model)\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # Training-fit statistics\n  # -------------------------\n  SSE  <- sum((obs - pred_train)^2)\n  SST  <- sum((obs - mean(obs))^2)\n  R2   <- 1 - SSE/SST\n  RMSE <- sqrt(mean((obs - pred_train)^2))\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # Prediction intervals\n  # -------------------------\n  pred_intervals <- predict(final_model, interval = \"prediction\", level = 1 - alpha)\n  intervals_df <- as.data.frame(pred_intervals)\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # K-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION\n  # -------------------------\n  n <- nrow(data)\n  set.seed(123)\n  folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n  pred_cv <- numeric(n)\n  \n  for (i in 1:k) {\n    train_idx <- which(folds != i)\n    test_idx  <- which(folds == i)\n    \n    train_set <- data[train_idx, ]\n    test_set  <- data[test_idx, ]\n    \n    # Stage 1 inside CV\n    w1_cv <- 1 / train_set[[var_sd_col]]^2\n    stage1_cv <- lm(formula, data = train_set, weights = w1_cv)\n    \n    # Stage 2 weights\n    abs_res_cv <- abs(stage1_cv$residuals)\n    fit_cv     <- stage1_cv$fitted.values\n    w2_cv <- 1 / lm(abs_res_cv ~ fit_cv)$fitted.values^2\n    \n    # Final CV model\n    model_cv <- lm(formula, data = train_set, weights = w2_cv)\n    \n    # Predict\n    pred_cv[test_idx] <- predict(model_cv, newdata = test_set)\n  }\n  \n  RMSEP <- sqrt(mean((obs - pred_cv)^2))\n  SSEcv <- sum((obs - pred_cv)^2)\n  SSTcv <- sum((obs - mean(obs))^2)\n  R2_cv <- 1 - SSEcv / SSTcv\n  \n  #               "Perfect! Iu2019ve rewritten the full **k-fold two-stage WLS validation function** with the fixes for both `w1` and `stage2_wt`, plus all the features you requested:  \n\n- k-fold CV (default 10-fold)  \n- Training Ru00b2 & RMSE  \n- CV RMSEP & Ru00b2cv  \n- Prediction intervals  \n- Observed vs Predicted plots (training & CV)  \n\nAll weights are now stored as columns in the dataset or training subsets to avoid `object not found` errors.  \n\n---\n\n# u2705 **Fixed Full Function**\n\n```r\nlibrary(ggplot2)\n\nvalidate_two_stage_wls_kfold <- function(\n    formula, \n    data, \n    var_sd_col, \n    k = 10, \n    alpha = 0.05\n) {\n  # Extract observed values\n  mf <- model.frame(formula, data)\n  obs <- model.response(mf)\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # Stage 1 u2014 initial weighted regression\n  # -------------------------\n  data$w1 <- 1 / data[[var_sd_col]]^2      # <- Stage 1 weights column\n  stage1 <- lm(formula, data = data, weights = w1)\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # Stage 2 u2014 residual-based weights\n  # -------------------------\n  abs_resid <- abs(stage1$residuals)\n  fit_vals  <- stage1$fitted.values\n  data$stage2_wt <- 1 / lm(abs_resid ~ fit_vals)$fitted.values^2  # <- Stage 2 weights column\n  \n  # Final weighted LS model\n  final_model <- lm(formula, data = data, weights = stage2_wt)\n  pred_train  <- predict(final_model)\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # Training-fit statistics\n  # -------------------------\n  SSE  <- sum((obs - alpha)\n  intervals_df <- as.data.frame(pred_intervals)\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # K-FOLD CROSS-VALIDATION\n  # -------------------------\n  n <- nrow(data)\n  if(k > n) k <- n  # prevent empty folds\n  set.seed(123)\n  folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n  pred_cv <- numeric(n)\n  \n  for (i in 1:k) {\n    train_idx <- which(folds != i)\n    test_idx  <- which(folds == i)\n    \n    train_set <- data[train_idx, ]\n    test_set  <- data[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]\n    \n    # Stage 1 inside CV\n    train_set$w1 <- 1 / train_set[[var_sd_col]]^2\n    stage1_cv <- lm(formula, data = train_set, weights = w1)\n    \n    # Stage 2 inside CV\n    abs_res_cv <- abs(stage1_cv$residuals)\n    fit_cv     <- stage1_cv$fitted.values\n    train_set$stage2_wt <- 1 / lm(abs_res_cv ~ fit_cv)$fitted.values^2\n    \n    # Final WLS model for this fold\n    model_cv <- lm(formula, data = train_set, weights = stage2_wt)\n    \n    # Predict for test fold\n    pred_cv[test_idx] <- predict(model_cv, newdata = test_set)\n  }\n  \n  # CV statistics\n  RMSEP <- sqrt(mean((obs -               "Got it! We can turn your entire workflow u2014 **train/test split, k-fold CV on training, independent test evaluation, and LOOCV on full dataset** u2014 into a **single reusable function** that works for any element/variable in your dataset.  \n\nHereu2019s a clean, fully functional R function:\n\n---\n\n```r\nvalidate_element <- function(formula, data, sd_col, train_frac = 0.6, k = 10) {\n  # formula: e.g., Ti_ICP ~ Ti\n  # data: dataset\n  # sd_col: string, column name for measurement SD (e.g., \"Ti_ICP_sd\")\n  # train_frac: fraction of data for training\n  # k: number of folds for CV on training\n  \n  set.seed(123)\n  \n  n <- nrow(data)\n  train_index <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(train_frac * n))\n  train_data <- data[train_index, ]\n  test_data  <- data[-train_index, ]\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # K-fold CV on training set\n  # -------------------------\n  n_train <- nrow(train_data)\n  if(k > n_train) k <- n_train\n  folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n_train))\n  \n  RMSEP_CV <- numeric(k)\n  R2_CV    <- numeric(k)\n  \n  for (i in 1:k) {\n    cv_train <- train_data[folds != i, ]\n    cv_test  <- train_data[folds == i, ]\n    \n    # Stage 1\n    cv_train$w1 <- 1 / cv_train[[sd_col]]^2\n    stage1 <- lm(formula, data = cv_train, weights = w1)\n    \n    # Stage 2\n    abs_res <- abs(stage1$residuals)\n    fit_vals <- stage1$fitted.values\n    cv_train$stage2_wt <- 1 / lm(abs_res ~ fit_vals)$fitted.values^2\n    \n    # Final WLS\n    model <- lm(formula, data = cv_train, weights = stage2_wt)\n    \n    # Predictions\n    preds <- predict(model, newdata = cv_test)\n    obs   <- model.response(model.frame(formula, cv_test))\n    \n    RMSEP_CV[i] <- sqrt(mean((obs - preds)^2))\n    SSE <- sum((obs - preds)^2)\n    SST <- sum((obs - mean(obs))^2)\n    R2_CV[i] <- 1 - SSE/SST\n  }\n  \n  CV_RMSEP <- mean(RMSEP_CV)\n  CV_R2    <- mean(R2_CV)\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # Final model on full training set\n  # -------------------------\n  train_data$w1 <- 1 / train_data[[sd_col]]^2\n  stage1_final <- lm(formula, data = train_data, weights = w1)\n  abs_res_final <- abs(stage1_final$residuals)\n  fit_vals_final <- stage1_final$fitted.values\n  train_data$stage2_wt <- 1 / lm(abs_res_final ~ fit_vals_final)$fitted.values^2\n  \n  final_model <- lm(formula, data = train_data, weights = stage2_wt)\n  \n  # Independent test-set performance\n  test_preds <- predict(final_model, newdata = test_data)\n  test_obs   <- model.response(model.frame(formula, test_data))\n  \n  Test_RMSEP <- sqrt(mean((test_obs - test_preds)^2))\n  SSE_test <- sum((test_obs - test_preds)^2)\n  SST_test <- sum((test_obs - mean(test_obs))^2)\n  Test_R2 <- 1 - SSE_test / SST_test\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # LOOCV on full dataset\n  # -------------------------\n  n_total <- nrow(data)\n  pred_LOO <- numeric(n_total)\n  \n  for (i in 1:n_total) {\n    train_LOO <- data[-i, ]\n    test_LOO  <- data[i, , drop = FALSE]\n    \n    # Stage 1\n    train_LOO$w1 <- 1 / train_LOO[[sd_col]]^2\n    stage1 <- lm(formula, data = train_LOO, weights = w1)\n    \n    # Stage 2\n    abs_res <- abs(stage1$residuals)\n    fit_vals <- stage1$fitted.values\n    train_LOO$stage2_wt <- 1 / lm(abs_res ~ fit_vals)$fitted.values^2\n    \n    # Final WLS\n    model <- lm(formula, data = train_LOO, weights = stage2_wt)\n    \n    # Predict left-out sample\n    pred_LOO[i] <- predict(model, newdata = test_LOO)\n  }\n  \n  RMSEP_full <- sqrt(mean((model.response(model.frame(formula, data)) - pred_LOO)^2))\n  SSE_cv <- sum((model.response(model.frame(formula, data)) - pred_LOO)^2)\n  SST_cv <- sum((model.response(model.frame(formula, data)) - mean(model.response(model.frame(formula, data))))^2)\n  R2_cv  <- 1 - SSE_cv / SST_cv\n  \n  # -------------------------\n  # Return results\n  # -------------------------\n  return(list(\n    final_model = final_model,\n    CV_RMSEP = CV_RMSEP,\n    CV_R2 = CV_R2,\n    Test_RMSEP = Test_RMSEP,\n    Test_R2 = Test_R2,\n    RMSEP_LOOCV = RMSEP_full,\n    R2_LOOCV = R2_cv\n  ))\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n### u2705 **Usage Example**\n\n```r\n# Ti example\nresults_Ti <- validate_element(\n  Ti_ICP ~ Ti,\n  data = ACE_dataset,\n  sd_col = \"Ti_ICP_sd\",\n  train_frac = 0.6,\n  k = 10\n)\n\nresults_Ti$CV_RMSEP\nresults_Ti$CV_R2\nresults_Ti$Test_RMSEP\nresults_Ti$Test_R2\nresults_Ti$RMSEP_LOOCV\nresults_Ti$R2_LOOCV\n\n# Ca example\nresults_Ca <- validate_element(\n  Ca_ICP ~ Ca,\n  data = ACE_dataset,\n  sd_col = \"Ca_ICP_sd\",\n  train_frac = 0.6,\n  k = 10\n)\n```\n\n---\n\nThis function now allows you to:  \n\n- Easily switch **elements** (Ti, Ca, etc.)  \n- Perform **train/test split**  \n- Compute **k-fold CV RMSEP & Ru00b2**  \n- Compute **independent test-set RMSEP & Ru00b2**  \n- Compute **LOOCV RMSEP & Ru00b2**  \n\n---\n\nIf you want, I can also **add optional plots for training, CV, and test predictions** inside this function, similar to the previous plotting version.  \n\nDo you want me to do that?"

TRAIN TEST SPLIT\n  # ================================================================\n  n <- nrow(data)\n  train_index <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(train_frac*n))\n  \n  train_data <- data[train_index, ]\n  test_data  <- data[-train_index, ]\n  \n  # ================================================================\n  # 2. PLOTS\n  # ================================================================\n  \n  # Training plot\n  plot_train <- ggplot(data.frame(obs=train_obs, pred=train_pred),\n                       aes(x=obs, y=pred)) +\n    geom_point(color=\"blue\") +\n    geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype=\"dashed\") +\n    ggtitle(\"Training: Observed vs Predicted\") +\n    xlab(\"Observed\") + ylab(\"Predicted\") + theme_bw()\n  \n  #               "Great question u2014 this happens **a lot** with weighted regression, cross-validation, and external test sets.  \nThere are **four common reasons why `performance::r2()` gives a much higher value** (0.89) than your manually computed test-set Ru00b2 (0.76).\n\nBelow is the explanation **in plain language**, then the math.\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **1. `performance::r2()` does *not* compute external test-set Ru00b2**\nThe `performance` package computes an **in-sample Ru00b2**, i.e., based on:\n\n```\nRu00b2 = 1 u2212 SSE_model / SST_model   (using TRAINING data)\n```\n\nIt **never** uses your external test set unless you explicitly pass predictions to it u2014 which the function does not accept.\n\nSo `performance::r2()` is telling you:\n\n### u2714 u201cHow well the model fits the training datau201d  \nu2014notu2014  \n### u2718 u201cHow well the model predicts new unseen datau201d.\n\nYour 0.89 is an **in-sample goodness-of-fit**, not a predictive performance metric.\n\nExternal prediction Ru00b2 is *always* lower.\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **2. Your test-set Ru00b2 uses a different definition**\nYou used:\n\n```r\nSSE_test <- sum((test_obs - test_pred)^2)\nSST_test <- sum((test_obs - mean(test_obs))^2)\nR2_test  <- 1 - SSE_test/SST_test\n```\n\nThis is the correct **predictive Ru00b2** (also called *Qu00b2*, or *Ru00b2pred*).  \nIt is always **much harsher** than in-sample Ru00b2.\n\nThus:\n\n- **0.89** = in-sample Ru00b2 u2192 optimistic  \n- **0.76** = predictive Ru00b2 u2192 realistic  \n\nThis difference is normal and expected.\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **3. Weighted regression increases the difference**\nYour model uses two levels of weights:\n\n1. **Stage 1** weights = 1 / SDu00b2  \n2. **Stage 2** weights = 1 / fitted varianceu00b2  \n\nWhen weights vary strongly:\n\n- The *training* model explains weighted variation very well u2192 high Ru00b2  \n- The *test* model predictions are unweighted, so performance drops u2192 lower predictive Ru00b2\n\nThe `performance` package uses the weighted SSE and SST, which inflates the apparent model fit.\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **4. `performance::r2()` sometimes uses correlation-based Ru00b2**\nDepending on the model and settings, it may use:\n\n```\nRu00b2_corr = cor(pred, obs)^2\n```\n\nThis is again different from the predictive Ru00b2 based on sum of squares.\n\nCorrelation Ru00b2 is always **higher** because it does not penalize bias.\n\n---\n\n# ud83dudccc **Summary u2014 why your test Ru00b2 = 0.76 but performance::r2() = 0.89**\n\n| Ru00b2 Type | What it measures | Expected size |\n|--------|------------------|---------------|\n| **`performance::r2()`** | In-sample fit, weighted | u2b50 Higher (0.89) |\n| **Your Test Ru00b2** | Predictive ability on unseen data | u2b50 Lower (0.76) |\n| **Difference explained by** | weights, bias, overfitting | Normal |\n\n**Your number (0.76) is the correct value for prediction performance.**  \n\n---\n\n# If you want them to match  \nI can make the function compute **the same Ru00b2 that the performance package uses**, e.g.:\n\n- Weighted Ru00b2  \n- Marginal Ru00b2  \n- Nakagawa Ru00b2  \n- Correlation-based Ru00b2  \n- Adjusted Ru00b2  \n\nJust tell me **which Ru00b2 definition you want**, and Iu2019ll add the option to the function."
