For JCO colour palette\n\n  if (!dir.exists(save_dir)) dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)\n\n  # Ensure Site factor ordering ----\n  if (\"Site\" %in% colnames(data)) {\n    data$Site <- factor(\n      data$Site,\n      levels = c(\"BI10\", \"HER42PB\", \"KER1\", \"KER3\", \"PB1\")\n    )\n  } else {\n    stop(\"Dataset must contain a column 'Site'.\")\n  }\n\n  model_summary <- tibble()\n  all_pdf_pages <- list()\n\n  extract_stats <- function(model, model_name, el) {\n    stats <- tryCatch(model_performance(model), error = function(e) NULL)\n    if (!is.null(stats)) {\n      r2 <- stats$r2\n      rmse <- stats$rmse\n    } else {\n      r2 <- NA\n      rmse <- sqrt(mean(residuals(model)^2))\n    }\n    rmsep <- tryCatch(rmsep(model), error = function(e) NA)\n\n    tibble(\n      Element   = el,\n      Model     = model_name,\n      Intercept = tryCatch(unname(coef(model)[1]), error=function(e) NA),\n      Slope     = tryCatch(unname(coef(model)[2]), error=function(e) NA),\n      R2        = r2,\n      RMSE      = rmse,\n      RMSEP     = rmsep,\n      AIC       = tryCatch(AIC(model), error=function(e) NA),\n      BIC       = tryCatch(BIC(model), error=function(e) NA)\n    )\n  }\n\n  boot_fn <- function(data, idx, formula) {\n    coef(lm(formula, data=data[idx,,drop=FALSE]))\n  }\n\n  # LOOP THROUGH ELEMENTS ----\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    message(\"\\n===== PROCESSING ELEMENT: \", el, \" =====\\n\")\n\n    y_col <- paste0(el,\"_ICP\")\n    x_col <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el,var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el,sd_suffix)\n\n    if (!all(c(y_col,x_col) %in% colnames(data))) {\n      warning(\"Skipping \", el, \": missing variables\")\n      next\n    }\n\n    formula <- as.formula(paste0(y_col,\" ~ \",x_col))\n\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)\n\n    # ==== Create models ====\n    model_types <- list()\n    pls_meta <- list()\n\n    model_types$OLS <- lm(formula, data=data)\n\n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\n      model_types$WLS_var <- lm(formula, data=data, weights=1/data[[var_col]])\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      wts_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_types$OLS_weighted <- lm(formula, data=data, weights=wts_sd)\n    }\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      init_m <- lm(formula, data=data, weights=1/(data[[sd_col]]^2))\n      rm <- lm(abs(init_m$residuals) ~ init_m$fitted.values)\n      model_types$WLS_weighted <- lm(formula, data=data,\n                                     weights=1/(rm$fitted.values^2))\n    }\n\n    model_types$Bayes <- bayesglm(formula, data=data)\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    model_types$RF <- randomForest(formula, data=data,\n                                   ntree=500, importance=TRUE)\n\n    # PLS LOOCV\n    pls_loo <- plsr(formula, data=data, scale=TRUE, validation=\"LOO\")\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method=\"onesigma\", plot=FALSE)\n    model_types$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n    pls_meta$PLS_LOO <- list(best=best_loo)\n\n    # PLS 10-fold CV\n    pls_cv <- plsr(formula, data=data, scale=TRUE,\n                   validation=\"CV\", segments=10)\n    best_cv <- selectNcomp(pls_cv, method=\"onesigma\", plot=FALSE)\n    model_types$PLS_kfold <- pls_cv\n    pls_meta$PLS_kfold <- list(best=best_cv)\n\n    pdf_pages_element <- list()\n    plot_models <- list()\n\n    # =========================================================\n    # PROCESS MODELS\n    # =========================================================\n    for (model_name in names(model_types)) {\n\n      m <- model_types[[model_name]]\n      is_lm <- model_name %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\")\n      is_bayes <- model_name == \"Bayes\"\n      is_rf <- model_name == \"RF\"\n      is_pls <- model_name %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")\n\n      # ---- Predictions ----\n      if (is_lm || is_bayes) {\n        pred <- predict(m)\n        resid_vals <- residuals(m)\n      } else if (is_rf) {\n        pred <- predict(m)\n        resid_vals <- data[[y_col]] - pred\n      } else if (is_pls) {\n        best <- pls_meta[[model_name]]$best\n        pred <- as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp=best, newdata=data))\n        resid_vals <- data[[y_col]] - pred\n      }\n\n      # ---- Add to summary table ----\n      if (is_lm) {\n\n        model_summary <- bind_rows(\n          model_summary,\n          extract_stats(m, model_name, el)\n        )\n\n      } else if (is_bayes) {\n        # Manual R2, RMSE for Bayes\n        y_obs <- data[[y_col]]\n        R2_b <- cor(y_obs, pred, use=\"pairwise.complete.obs\")^2\n        RMSE_b <- sqrt(mean((y_obs - pred)^2))\n\n        model_summary <- bind_rows(\n          model_summary,\n          tibble(\n            Element=el, Model=\"Bayes\",\n            Intercept=coef(m)[1],\n            Slope=coef(m)[2],\n            R2=R2_b, RMSE=RMSE_b, RMSEP=RMSE_b,\n            AIC=tryCatch(AIC(m), error=function(e) NA),\n            BIC=tryCatch(BIC(m), error=function(e) NA)\n          )\n        )\n\n      } else if (is_rf) {\n\n        y_obs <- data[[y_col]]\n        R2_rf <- cor(y_obs, pred, use=\"pairwise.complete.obs\")^2\n        RMSE_rf <- sqrt(mean((y_obs - pred)^2))\n\n        model_summary <- bind_rows(\n          model_summary,\n          tibble(\n            Element=el, Model=\"RF\",\n            Intercept=NA, Slope=NA,\n            R2=R2_rf, RMSE=RMSE_rf, RMSEP=RMSE_rf,\n            AIC=NA, BIC=NA\n          )\n        )\n\n      } else if (is_pls) {\n\n        y_obs <- data[[y_col]]\n        best <- pls_meta[[model_name]]$best\n\n        R2_pls <- cor(y_obs, pred, use=\"pairwise.complete.obs\")^2\n        RMSE_pls <- sqrt(mean((y_obs - pred)^2))\n\n        RMSEP_cv <- tryCatch(RMSEP(m)$val[1,best+1,1], error=function(e) NA)\n\n        model_summary <- bind_rows(\n          model_summary,\n          tibble(\n            Element=el, Model=model_name,\n            Intercept=NA, Slope=NA,\n            R2=R2_pls, RMSE=RMSE_pls, RMSEP=RMSEP_cv,\n            AIC=NA, BIC=NA\n          )\n        )\n      }\n\n      plot_models[[model_name]] <- pred\n\n      # =====================================================\n      # CHECK_MODEL: SAVE USING pdf() + plot()\n      # =====================================================\n      if (is_lm || is_bayes) {\n\n        diag_plot <- check_model(m)\n\n        diag_file <- file.path(\n          element_dir,\n          paste0(el,\"_\",model_name,\"_diagnostics.pdf\")\n        )\n\n        pdf(diag_file, width=20/2.54, height=20/2.54)\n        plot(diag_plot)\n        dev.off()\n\n        pdf_pages_element[[paste0(model_name,\"_Diag\")]] <-\n          (function(dp=diag_plot){function() plot(dp)})()\n      }\n\n      # =====================================================\n      # Residual distribution\n      # =====================================================\n      p_resid <- ggplot(data.frame(resid=resid_vals), aes(resid)) +\n        geom_histogram(bins=30, fill=\"grey80\") +\n        geom_density(color=\"red\") +\n        theme_bw() +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, model_name, \"Residual Distribution\"))\n\n      ggsave(file.path(element_dir,\n                       paste0(el,\"_\",model_name,\"_Residuals.pdf\")),\n             p_resid, width=20, height=20, units=\"cm\", dpi=600)\n\n      pdf_pages_element[[paste0(model_name,\"_Resid\")]] <- p_resid\n\n      # =====================================================\n      # Predicted vs Observed (JCO palette)\n      # =====================================================\n      df_pred <- tibble(\n        Observed = data[[y_col]],\n        Predicted = pred,\n        Site = data$Site\n      )\n\n      p_pred <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, color=Site)) +\n        geom_point(size=3, alpha=0.8) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco() +\n        geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linewidth=1) +\n        theme_bw() +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, model_name, \"Predicted vs Observed\"))\n\n      ggsave(file.path(element_dir,\n                       paste0(el,\"_\",model_name,\"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n             p_pred, width=20, height=20, units=\"cm\", dpi=600)\n\n      pdf_pages_element[[paste0(model_name,\"_PredObs\")]] <- p_pred\n\n      # =====================================================\n      # PLS validation plot\n      # =====================================================\n      if (is_pls) {\n        pfun <- function() {\n          validationplot(m, val.type=\"RMSEP\",\n                         main=paste(el,model_name,\"RMSEP\"))\n        }\n        p_val <- see::as_ggplot(pfun)\n        ggsave(file.path(element_dir,\n                         paste0(el,\"_\",model_name,\"_Validation_RMSEP.pdf\")),\n               p_val, width=20, height=20, units=\"cm\", dpi=600)\n        pdf_pages_element[[paste0(model_name,\"_RMSEP\")]] <- p_val\n      }\n\n    } # END model loop\n\n    all_pdf_pages[[el]] <- pdf_pages_element\n  }\n\n  # =====================================================\n  # WRITE SUMMARY PDF (no grid.draw used)\n  # =====================================================\n  pdf(file.path(save_dir, summary_pdf), width=12, height=10)\n\n  for (el in names(all_pdf_pages)) {\n    for (pg in names(all_pdf_pages[[el]])) {\n\n      obj <- all_pdf_pages[[el]][[pg]]\n\n      if (inherits(obj, \"ggplot\"))\n        print(obj)\n      else if (is.function(obj))\n        obj()  # runs plot(check_model)\n    }\n  }\n\n  dev.off()\n\n  # SAVE SUMMARY TABLE\n  write.csv(model_summary,\n            file.path(save_dir,summary_csv), row.names=FALSE)\n\n  invisible(model_summary)\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n# u25b6ufe0f Run it\n\n```r\nelements <- c(\"Ti\",\"Ca\",\"Mn\",\"Fe\",\"Sr\",\"Zr\")\n\nsummary_table <- run_full_regressions(\n  elements = elements,\n  data = ACE_dataset\n)\n```\n\n---\n\n# ud83cudf89 This version resolves:\n\n### u2714 bayesglm Ru00b2 error  \n### u2714 RR2 typo  \n### u2714 RMMSE typo  \n### u2714 scale_color_jco  \n### u2714 check_model PDF saving  \n### u2714 grid.draw crashes  \n### u2714 RF, PLS stats correctness  \n\n---\n\nIf you'd like:\n\nud83dudccc Add GAM models  \nud83dudccc Add Ridge / LASSO  \nud83dudccc Add XGBoost  \nud83dudccc Add residual QQ-plots  \nud83dudccc Add full cross-validation framework  \n\nJust tell me u2014 happy to extend the pipeline!"

=========================================================\n    # PROCESS MODELS\n    # =========================================================\n    for (model_name in names(model_types)) {\n\n      m <- model_types[[model_name]]\n      y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n      is_lm <- model_name %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\")\n      is_bayes <- model_name == \"Bayes\"\n      is_rf <- model_name == \"RF\"\n      is_pls <- model_name %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")\n\n      # Predictions ----\n      if (is_lm || is_bayes) {\n        pred <- predict(m)\n      } else if (is_rf) {\n        pred <- predict(m)\n      } else if (is_pls) {\n        best <- pls_meta[[model_name]]$best\n        pred <- as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = best, newdata = data))\n      }\n\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n      # Add summary stats ----\n      if (is_lm) {\n\n        model_summary <- bind_rows(\n          model_summary,\n          extract_stats(m, model_name, el, data, y_col)\n        )\n\n      } else if (is_bayes) {\n\n        R2_b <- cor(y, pred)^2\n        RMSE_b <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\n\n        model_summary <- bind_rows(\n          model_summary,\n          tibble(\n            Element=el, Model=\"Bayes\",\n            Intercept=coef(m)[1], Slope=coef(m)[2],\n            R2=R2_b, RMSE=RMSE_b, RMSEP=RMSE_b,\n            AIC=tryCatch(AIC(m), error=function(e) NA),\n            BIC=tryCatch(BIC(m), error=function(e) NA)\n          )\n        )\n\n      } else if (is_rf) {\n\n        R2_rf <- cor(y, pred)^2\n        RMSE_rf <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\n\n        model_summary <- bind_rows(\n          model_summary,\n          tibble(\n            Element=el, Model=\"RF\",\n            Intercept=NA, Slope=NA,\n            R2=R2_rf, RMSE=RMSE_rf, RMSEP=RMSE_rf,\n            AIC=NA, BIC=NA\n          )\n        )\n\n      } else if (is_pls) {\n\n        best <- pls_meta[[model_name]]$best\n        R2_pls <- cor(y, pred)^2\n        RMSE_pls <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\n        RMSEP_cv <- tryCatch(RMSEP(m)$val[1,best+1,1], error=function(e) NA)\n\n        model_summary <- bind_rows(\n          model_summary,\n          tibble(\n            Element=el, Model=model_name,\n            Intercept=NA, Slope=NA,\n            R2=R2_pls, RMSE=RMSE_pls, RMSEP=RMSEP_cv,\n            AIC=NA, BIC=NA\n          )\n        )\n      }\n\n      # ============= Diagnostics =============\n\n      # check_model() saved as PDF ----\n      if (is_lm || is_bayes) {\n\n        diag_plot <- check_model(m)\n        outfile <- file.path(element_dir, paste0(el,\"_\",model_name,\"_diagnostics.pdf\"))\n\n        pdf(outfile, width=20/2.54, height=20/2.54)\n        plot(diag_plot)\n        dev.off()\n\n        pdf_pages_element[[paste0(model_name,\"_Diag\")]] <-\n          (function(dp=diag_plot){ function() plot(dp) })()\n      }\n\n      # Residual distribution ----\n      p_resid <- ggplot(data.frame(resid=resid_vals), aes(resid)) +\n        geom_histogram(fill=\"grey80\", bins=30) +\n        geom_density(colour=\"red\") +\n        theme_bw() + ggtitle(paste(el, model_name, \"Residual Distribution\"))\n\n      ggsave(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el,\"_\",model_name,\"_Residuals.pdf\")),\n             p_resid, width=20, height=20, units=\"cm\", dpi=600)\n\n      pdf_pages_element[[paste0(model_name,\"_Resid\")]] <- p_resid\n\n      # Pred-vs-Obs ----\n      df_pred <- tibble(\n        Observed=y,\n        Predicted=pred,\n        Site=data$Site\n      )\n\n      p_pred <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, color=Site)) +\n        geom_point(size=3, alpha=.8) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco() +\n        geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0) +\n        theme_bw() + ggtitle(paste(el, model_name, \"Predicted vs Observed\"))\n\n      ggsave(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el,\"_\",model_name,\"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n             p_pred, width=20, height=20, units=\"cm\", dpi=600)\n\n      pdf_pages_element[[paste0(model_name,\"_PredObs\")]] <- p_pred\n\n      # PLS validation ---- (NO as_ggplot)\n      if (is_pls) {\n\n        outfile <- file.path(element_dir,\n                             paste0(el,\"_\",model_name,\"_PLS_RMSEP.pdf\"))\n\n        pdf(outfile, width=20/2.54, height=20/2.54)\n        validationplot(m, val.type=\"RMSEP\",\n                       main=paste(el, model_name, \"RMSEP vs Components\"))\n        dev.off()\n\n        pdf_pages_element[[paste0(model_name,\"_RMSEP\")]] <-\n          (function(mm=m){ function() validationplot(mm, val.type=\"RMSEP\") })()\n      }\n\n    } # end model loop\n\n\n    all_pdf_pages[[el]] <- pdf_pages_element\n\n  } # end element loop\n\n\n  # =========================================================\n  # COMBINED SUMMARY PDF\n  # =========================================================\n  pdf(file.path(save_dir, summary_pdf), width=12, height=10)\n\n  for (el in names(all_pdf_pages)) {\n    for (page in names(all_pdf_pages[[el]])) {\n\n      obj <- all_pdf_pages[[el]][[page]]\n\n      if (inherits(obj, \"ggplot\")) {\n        print(obj)\n      } else if (is.function(obj)) {\n        obj()\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  dev.off()\n\n  # check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, element, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n\n    errors <- c()\n\n    # 1) Required columns exist?\n    for (col in c(y_col, x_col)) {\n      if (!col %in% names(data))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(\"Missing required column:\", col))\n    }\n\n    # Stop early\n    if (length(errors) > 0) return(errors)\n\n    # 2) Columns numeric?\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]]))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(y_col, \"is not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]]))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(x_col, \"is not numeric\"))\n\n    # 3) NA check\n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]])))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(\"NA values detected in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]])))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(\"NA values detected in\", x_col))\n\n    # 4) Zero variance?\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(x_col, \"has zero variance\"))\n\n    # 5) SD and variance columns %in% names(data)) {\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(var_col, \"contains zero or negative values\"))\n    }\n\n    return(errors)\n  }\n\n  # {\n\n    p(message = paste(\"Processing\", el))\n\n    element_log <- paste(\"\\n--- Processing Element:\", el, \"---\\n\")\n\n    y_col <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col <- el\n    var_col <- currently unused\n  summary_pdf = \"AllElements_Summary.pdf\"        # currently unused\n) {\n\n  # PACKAGES ----\n  library(broom)\n  library(performance)\n  library(see)\n  library(ggplot2)\n  library(dplyr)\n  library(purrr)\n  library(boot)\n  library(psych)\n  library(lmtest)\n  library(arm)\n  library(randomForest)\n  library(pls)\n  library(ggpubr)\n  library(ggsci)\n  library(progressr)\n  library(future)\n  library(future.apply)\n\n  # =====================================================\n  # ABSOLUTE PATH + CREATE SAVE DIRECTORY\n  # =====================================================\n  save_dir <- normalizePath(save_dir, mustWork = FALSE)\n\n  if (!dir.exists(save_dir)) {\n    dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)\n  }\n\n  log_file <- file.path(save_dir, \"run_log.txt\")\n  write(\"=== Regression Run Log ===\", file = log_file)\n\n  # =====================================================\n  # ENSURE Site FACTOR (FOR COLOURING)\n  # =====================================================\n  if (\"Site\" %in% names(data)) {\n    data$Site <- factor(\n      data$Site,\n      levels = c(\"BI10\", \"HER42PB\", \"KER1\", \"KER3\", \"PB1\")\n    )\n  } else {\n    stop(\"Dataset must contain a 'Site' column.\")\n  }\n\n  # =====================================================\n  # PARALLEL + PROGRESS SETUP\n  # =====================================================\n  future::plan(multisession, workers = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1))\n  progressr::handlers(global = TRUE)\n\n  # =====================================================\n  # DATASET INTEGRITY CHECK FUNCTION\n  # =====================================================\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n    errors <- c()\n\n    # Required columns\n    for (col in c(y_col, x_col)) {\n      if (!col %in% names(data))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(\"Missing column:\", col))\n    }\n\n    if (length(errors) > 0) return(errors)\n\n    # Numeric type\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errors <- c(errors, paste(y_col, \"must be numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errors <- c(errors, paste(x_col, \"must be numeric\"))\n\n    # NA check\n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]]))) errors <- c(errors, paste(\"NA values in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errors <- c(errors, paste(\"NA values in\", x_col))\n\n    # Zero variance\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(x_col, \"has zero variance\"))\n\n    # Variance & SD columns\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(sd_col, \"contains <= 0 values\"))\n    }\n\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(var_col, \"contains <= 0 values\"))\n    }\n\n    return(errors)\n  }\n\n  # =====================================================\n  # MAIN ELEMENT LOOP (PARALLEL WITH PROGRESS)\n  # =====================================================\n  progressr::with_progress({\n    p <- progressr::progressor(steps = length(elements))\n\n    results <- future_lapply(elements, function(el) {\n\n      p(message = paste(\"Processing\", el))\n\n      element_log <- paste(\"\\n--- Element:\", el, \"---\\n\")\n\n      y_col <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n      x_col <- el\n      var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n      sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n      # Create element directory\n      element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n      dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n      # ---------------- Dataset integrity ----------------\n      errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n\n      if (length(errors) > 0) {\n        element_log <- paste0(\n          element_log,\n          \"Dataset integrity FAILED:\\n\",\n          paste(\"-\", errors, collapse = \"\\n\"),\n          \"\\nElement skipped (folder created).\\n\"\n        )\n        write(element_log, file = log_file, append = TRUE)\n        return(NULL)\n      }\n\n      element_log <- paste0(element_log, \"Dataset integrity OK.\\n\")\n\n      # =====================================================\n      # FIT MODELS\n      # =====================================================\n      fmla <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n      model_list <- list()\n\n      # OLS\n      model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla, data = data)\n\n      # WLS on variance\n      if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n        model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = 1 / data[[var_col]])\n      }\n\n      # Weighted OLS and 2-step WLS using SD\n      if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n        w_sd <- 1 / (data[[sd_col]]^2)\n        model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n        init <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n        rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n        w2   <- 1 / (rm$fitted.values^2)\n        model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w2)\n      }\n\n      # Bayesian\n      model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla, data = data)\n\n      # Random Forest\n      set.seed(42)\n      model_list$RF <- randomForest(fmla, data = data, ntree = 500)\n\n      # PLS (LOO)\n      pls_loo <- plsr(fmla, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n      best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n      attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n      model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n      # PLS (k-fold)\n      pls_k <- plsr(fmla, data = data, scale = TRUE,\n                    validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n      best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n      attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n      model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n      # =====================================================\n      # PROCESS MODELS + DIAGNOSTICS + RANKING\n      # =====================================================\n      ranking_df <- tibble()\n\n      for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n        m <- model_list[[mname]]\n\n        # Predictions (safe)\n        pred <- tryCatch(\n          {\n            if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {  # PLS\n              best <- attr(m, \"best_ncomp\")\n              as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = best, newdata = data))\n            } else {\n              predict(m)\n            }\n          },\n          error = function(e) NA_real_\n        )\n\n        # Skip invalid predictions\n        if (!is.numeric(pred) ||\n            length(pred) != nrow(data) ||\n            any(is.na(pred))) {\n          element_log <- paste0(element_log,\n                                \"Prediction invalid for model: \", mname, \"\\n\")\n          next\n        }\n\n        y <- data[[y_col]]\n        resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n        # ---------------- check_model diagnostics ----------------\n        if (inherits(m, \"lm\") || inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n          diag_plot <- check_model(m)\n\n          pdf(file.path(element_dir,\n                        paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_diagnostics.pdf\")),\n              width = 8, height = 8)\n          plot(diag_plot)\n          dev.off()\n        }\n\n        # PACKAGES ----\n  library(broom)\n  library(performance)\n  library(see)\n  library(ggplot2)\n  library(dplyr)\n  library(purrr)\n  library(boot)\n  library(psych)\n  library(lmtest)\n  library(arm)\n  library(randomForest)\n  library(pls)\n  library(ggpubr)\n  library(ggsci)\n  library(progressr)\n  library(future)\n  library(future.apply)\n\n  # =====================================================\n  # ABSOLUTE PATH + CREATE SAVE DIRECTORY\n  # =====================================================\n  save_dir <- normalizePath(save_dir, mustWork = FALSE)\n\n  if (!dir.exists(save_dir)) {\n    dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)\n  }\n\n  log_file <- file.path(save_dir, \"run_log.txt\")\n  write(\"=== Regression Run Log ===\", file = log_file)\n\n  # =====================================================\n  # DATASET INTEGRITY CHECK FUNCTION\n  # =====================================================\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n    errors <- c()\n\n    # Required columns\n    for (col in c(y_col, x_col)) {\n      if (!col %in% names(data))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(\"Missing column:\", col))\n    }\n\n    if (length(errors) > 0) return(errors)\n\n    # Numeric type\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errors <- c(errors, paste(y_col, \"must be numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errors <- c(errors, paste(x_col, \"must be numeric\"))\n\n    # NA check\n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]]))) errors <- c(errors, paste(\"NA values in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errors <- c(errors, paste(\"NA values in\", x_col))\n\n    # Zero variance\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(x_col, \"has zero variance\"))\n\n    # Variance & SD columns must be positive\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(sd_col, \"contains <= 0 values\"))\n    }\n\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(var_col, \"contains <= 0 values\"))\n    }\n\n    return(errors)\n  }\n\n  # =====================================================\n  # MAIN ELEMENT LOOP (PARALLEL WITH PROGRESS)\n  # =====================================================\n  progressr::with_progress({\n    p <- progressr::progressor(steps = length(elements))\n\n    results <- future_lapply(elements, function(el) {\n\n      p(message = paste(\"Processing\", el))\n\n      element_log <- paste(\"\\n--- Element:\", el, \"---\\n\")\n\n      y_col <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n      x_col <- el\n      var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n      sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n      # Create element directory\n      element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n      dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n      # ---------------- Dataset integrity ----------------\n      errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n\n      if (length(errors) > 0) {\n        element_log <- paste0(\n          element_log,\n          \"Dataset integrity FAILED:\\n\",\n          paste(\"-\", errors, collapse = \"\\n\"),\n          \"\\nElement skipped (folder created).\\n\"\n        )\n        write(element_log, file = log_file, append = TRUE)\n        return(NULL)\n      }\n\n      element_log <- paste0(element_log, \"Dataset integrity OK.\\n\")\n\n      # =====================================================\n      # FIT MODELS\n      # =====================================================\n      fmla <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n      model_list <- list()\n\n      # OLS\n      model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla, data = data)\n\n      # WLS on variance\n      if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n        model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = 1 / data[[var_col]])\n      }\n\n      # Weighted OLS and 2-step WLS using SD\n      if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n        w_sd <- 1 / (data[[sd_col]]^2)\n        model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n        init <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n        rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n        w2   <- 1 / (rm$fitted.values^2)\n        model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w2)\n      }\n\n      # Bayesian\n      model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla, data = data)\n\n      # Random Forest\n      set.seed(42)\n      model_list$RF <- randomForest(fmla, data = data, ntree = 500)\n\n      # PLS (LOO)\n      pls_loo <- plsr(fmla, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n      best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n      attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n      model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n      # PLS (k-fold)\n      pls_k <- plsr(fmla, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n      best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n      attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n      model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n      # =====================================================\n      # PROCESS MODELS + DIAGNOSTICS + RANKING\n      # =====================================================\n      ranking_df <- tibble()\n\n      for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n        m <- model_list[[mname]]\n\n        # Predictions (safe)\n        pred <- tryCatch(\n          {\n            if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {  # PLS\n              best <- attr(m, \"best_ncomp\")\n              as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = best, newdata = data))\n            } else {\n              predict(m)\n            }\n          },\n          error = function(e) NA_real_\n        )\n\n        # Skip invalid predictions\n        if (!is.numeric(pred) ||\n            length(pred) != nrow(data) ||\n            any(is.na(pred))) {\n          element_log <- paste0(element_log,\n                                \"Prediction invalid for model: \", mname, \"\\n\")\n          next\n        }\n\n        y <- data[[y_col]]\n        resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n        # ---------------- check_model diagnostics ----------------\n        if (inherits(m, \"lm\") || inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n          diag_plot <- check_model(m)\n\n          pdf(file.path(element_dir,\n                        paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_diagnostics.pdf\")),\n              width = 8, height = 8)\n          plot(diag_plot)\n          dev.off()\n        }\n\n        # ---------------- Residual distribution ----------------\n        if (is.numeric(resid_vals) &&\n            length(resid_vals) > 1 &&\n            !all(is.na(resid_vals))) {\n\n          res_df <- data.frame(resid = resid_vals)\n\n          p_res <- ggplot(res_df, aes(x = resid)) +\n            geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = \"grey80\") +\n            geom_density(color = \"red\") +\n            theme_bw() +\n            ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"Residual Distribution\"))\n\n          try(\n            ggsave(file.path(element_dir,\n                             paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Residuals.pdf\")),\n                   p_res, width = 8, height = 8),\n            silent = TRUE\n          )\n        } else {\n          element_log <- paste0(element_log,\n                                \"Residual distribution skipped for \", mname, \"\\n\")\n        }\n\n        # ---------------- PLS RMSEP validation ----------------\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n          try({\n            pdf(file.path(element_dir,\n                          paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PLS_RMSEP.pdf\")),\n                width = 8, height = 8)\n            validationplot(m, val.type = \"RMSEP\",\n                           main = paste(el, mname, \"RMSEP vs Components\"))\n            dev.off()\n          }, silent = TRUE)\n        }\n\n        # ---------------- Ranking metrics ----------------\n        R2_val    <- tryCatch(cor(y, pred)^2, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n        RMSE_val  <- sqrt(mean(resid_vals^2))\n        RMSEP_val <- RMSE_val\n\n        ranking_df <- bind_rows(ranking_df, tibble(\n          Model = mname,\n          R2    = R2_val,\n          RMSE  = RMSE_val,\n          RMSEP = RMSEP_val\n        ))\n      } # end model loop\n\n      # =====================================================\n      # MODEL RANKING FOR THIS ELEMENT (SELECT() FIX APPLIED)\n      # =====================================================\n      if (nrow(ranking_df) > 0) {\n\n        ranking_df <- ranking_df %>%\n          mutate(rank_score = RMSE + RMSEP + (1 - R2)) %>%\n          arrange(rank_score) %>%\n          mutate(Rank = dplyr::row_number())\n\n        ranking_df <- dplyr::select(\n          ranking_df,\n          Rank, Model, R2, RMSE, RMSEP\n        )\n\n        ranking_file <- file.path(element_dir,\n                                  paste0(el, \"_Model_Ranking.csv\"))\n        write.csv(ranking_df, ranking_file, row.names = FALSE)\n\n        element_log <- paste0(\n          element_log,\n          \"Model ranking saved: \", ranking_file, \"\\n\"\n        )\n      } else {\n        element_log <- paste0(\n          element_log,\n          \"No valid models to rank for \", el, \".\\n\"\n        )\n      }\n\n      element_log <- paste0(\n        element_log,\n        \"Element outputs saved in: \", element_dir, \"\\n\"\n      )\n\n      write(element_log, file = log_file, append = TRUE)\n\n      return(NULL)\n    }) # end future_lapply\n  }) # end with_progress\n\n  write(\"\\n=== COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY ===\\n\", file = log_file, append = TRUE)\n\n  invisible(NULL)\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n# u25b6ufe0f Run it\n\n```r\nelements <- c(\"Ti\",\"Ca\",\"Mn\",\"Fe\",\"Sr\",\"Zr\")\nrun_full_regressions(elements, ACE_dataset)\n```\n\n---\n\n# ud83cudf89 All of the following are now **fixed**:\nu2714 `select()` masking error  \nu2714 u201cunused argumentsu201d error  \nu2714 Aesthetics errors (`x = resid`)  \nu2714 Missing Predicted column  \nu2714 size=\"\" label warnings  \nu2714 safe parallel execution  \nu2714 robust diagnostics  \n\n---\n\nIf you want next:\n\n- Add **combined master ranking** (best model *overall*)  \n- Add **HTML or PDF automated report**  \n- Add **XGBoost, GAM, LASSO, Ridge, Elastic Net**  \n- Add **cross-validation RMSEP for ALL models**  \n- Add **variable importance plots for RF & PLS**\n\nJust tell me!"

=====================================================\n    # FIT MODELS\n    # =====================================================\n    fmla <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    # OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla, data = data)\n\n    # WLS on variance\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = 1 / data[[var_col]])\n    }\n\n    # Weighted OLS & 2-step WLS on SD\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1 / (data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n      init <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n      w2   <- 1 / (rm$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w2)\n    }\n\n    # Bayesian\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla, data = data)\n\n    # Random forest\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(fmla, data = data, ntree = 500)\n\n    # PLS LOO\n    pls_loo <- plsr(fmla, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    # PLS k-fold\n    pls_k <- plsr(fmla, data = data, scale = TRUE,\n                  validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    # =====================================================\n    # DIAGNOSTICS + RANKING\n    # =====================================================\n    ranking_df <- dplyr::tibble()\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n      message(\"  - Model: \", mname)\n\n      # Safe predictions\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n          ncomp <- attr(m, \"best_ncomp\")\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = ncomp, newdata = data))\n        } else {\n          predict(m)\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) {\n        message(\"    Prediction failed for \", mname, \": \", e$message)\n        NA\n      })\n\n      if (!is.numeric(pred) || length(pred) != nrow(data) || any(is.na(pred))) {\n        element_log <- paste0(element_log,\n                              \"Prediction invalid for \", mname, \" (skipped).\\n\")\n        next\n      }\n\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n      # -------- Residual distribution plot --------\n      if (length(resid_vals) > 1 && !all(is.na(resid_vals))) {\n        res_df <- data.frame(resid = resid_vals)\n        p_res <- ggplot(res_df, aes(x = resid)) +\n          geom_histogram(fill = \"grey80\", bins = 30) +\n          geom_density(color = \"red\") +\n          theme_bw() +\n          ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"Residual Distribution\"))\n\n        ggsave(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Residuals.pdf\")),\n               p_res, width = 8, height = 8)\n      } else {\n        element_log <- paste0(element_log,\n                              \"Residuals invalid for \", mname, \" (plot skipped).\\n\")\n      }\n\n      # -------- Predicted vs Observed --------\n      df_pred <- data.frame(Observed = y, Predicted = pred, Site = data$Site)\n\n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Site)) +\n        geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco() +\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\n        theme_bw() +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"Predicted vs Observed\"))\n\n      ggsave(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n             p_po, width = 8, height = 8)\n\n      # -------- PLS RMSEP validation --------\n      if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PLS_RMSEP.pdf\")),\n            width = 8, height = 8)\n        validationplot(m, val.type = \"RMSEP\",\n                       main = paste(el, mname, \"RMSEP vs Components\"))\n        dev.off()\n      }\n\n      # -------- metrics for ranking --------\n      R2    <- cor(y, pred)^2\n      RMSE  <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\n      RMSEP <- RMSE  # placeholder; could be replaced by CV-based metric\n\n      ranking_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(ranking_df, dplyr::tibble(\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP\n      ))\n    }\n\n    # =====================================================\n    # RANK MODELS\n    # =====================================================\n    if (nrow(ranking_df) > 0) {\n      ranking_df <- ranking_df %>%\n        mutate(score = RMSE + RMSEP + (1 - R2)) %>%\n        arrange(score) %>%\n        mutate(Rank = dplyr::row_number()) %>%\n        dplyr::select(Rank, Model, R2, RMSE, RMSEP)\n\n      ranking_file <- file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_Model_Ranking.csv\"))\n      write.csv(ranking_df, ranking_file, row.names = FALSE)\n\n      element_log <- paste0(\n        element_log,\n        \"Model ranking written to: \", ranking_file, \"\\n\"\n      )\n    } else {\n      element_log <- paste0(element_log, \"No valid models to rank.\\n\")\n    }\n\n    element_log <- paste0(\n      element_log,\n      \"Element outputs saved in: \", element_dir, \"\\n\"\n    )\n    write(element_log, file = log_file, append = TRUE)\n\n  } # end for(elements)\n\n  write(\"\\n=== COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY ===\\n\", file = log_file, append = TRUE)\n  message(\"\\nAll done. Outputs are under: \", save_dir)\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## u25b6ufe0f How to run it\n\n```r\nelements <- c(\"Ti\", \"Ca\", \"Mn\", \"Fe\", \"Sr\", \"Zr\")\n\nrun_full_regressions(\n  elements = elements,\n  data     = ACE_dataset\n)\n```\n\nThen immediately check in Finder:\n\n- `TEST_WRITE.txt` under  \n  `/Users/sjro/Dropbox/BAS/Data/R/Papers_R/2024_DeVleeschouwer/Regression/`\n- Subfolders: `Ti/`, `Ca/`, u2026  \n- Inside each: PDFs + `<Element>_Model_Ranking.csv`  \n- Log file: `run_log.txt` in the root Regression folder  \n\nIf **you do not even see `TEST_WRITE.txt`**, then the issue is not the function but the path itself (macOS now often mounts Dropbox under `~/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/...`).               "Nice catch u2014 that error message is classic **influence()/cooks.distance vs NA/residual length mismatch**:\n\n> `Error in lm.influence(model, do.coef = u2026): non-NA residual length does not match cases used in fitting`\n\nItu2019s coming from this block in the function:\n\n```r\nif (inherits(m, \"lm\") || inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n  cooks   <- cooks.distance(m)\n  leverage <- hatvalues(m)\n  rstd    <- rstandard(m)\n  ...\n}\n```\n\nFor some of your models (likely **weighted fits** or **bayesglm**), the internal residuals used by `influence.lm()` donu2019t line up with the data rows anymore (e.g. due to NA handling, weights, or dropped rows). Then `cooks.distance()` or `rstandard()` blows up with exactly that error.\n\nLetu2019s fix this **safely** by:\n\n1. Only computing influence plots for **plain `lm` models** (skip Bayes, RF, PLS).\n2. Wrapping the influence code in `tryCatch()` so that if anything weird happens, we just **skip the influence plot** for that model instead of crashing the whole pipeline.\n3. Checking that the vectors we get (cooks, leverage, rstd) are all the same length and numeric before plotting.\n\nBelow is the **full updated function**, with only the **influence-plot block changed** check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n    errors <- c()\n\n    needed <- c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (col in needed) {\n      if (!col %in% names(data))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(\"Missing column:\", col))\n    }\n    if (length(errors)) return(errors)\n\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]]))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(y_col, \"is not y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]])))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(\"NA values in\", x_col))\n\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(x_col, \"has =====================================================\n  # HELPER: UNIFIED 10-FOLD CV RMSE FOR DIFFERENT MODEL TYPES\n  # =====================================================\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname,\n    formula,\n    data,\n    y_col,\n    var_col,\n    sd_col,\n    best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(data)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else {\n          stop(\"Unknown model type in CV: \", mname)\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\")) {\n          # PLS\n          if (is.na(best_ncomp)) {\n            best_ncomp_fold <- 1\n          } else {\n            best_ncomp_fold <- best_ncomp\n          }\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp_fold, newdata = test))\n        } else {\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok     <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  # =====================================================\n  # EXPLANATION STRINGS (FOR CSV)\n  # =====================================================\n  expl_shapiro     <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk normality test: p > 0.05 suggests residuals are approximately normally distributed.\"\n  expl_bp          <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan heteroscedasticity test: p < 0.05 suggests non-constant residual variance (heteroscedasticity).\"\n  expl_cv10        <- \"10-fold cross-validation RMSE: estimates prediction error on unseen data; lower values indicate better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_rf_oob      <- \"Random Forest OOB MSE/R2: internal cross-validation using out-of-bag samples; lower MSE and higher R2 indicate better performance.\"\n  expl_pls_rmsep   <- \"PLS RMSEP at best ncomp: RMSEP from PLS cross-validation for the chosen number of components; lower is better.\"\n  expl_AIC         <- \"Akaike Information Criterion (AIC): lower AIC indicates a better balance between model fit and complexity.\"\n  expl_BIC         <- \"Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC): similar to AIC but penalizes model complexity more strongly; lower is better.\"\n\n  # =====================================================\n  # GLOBAL SUMMARY TABLE (ALL ELEMENTS & MODELS)\n  # =====================================================\n  global_summary <- message(\"\\n==========================\")\n    message(\"Processing element: \", el)\n    message(\"==========================\")\n\n    element_log <- paste0(\"\\n--- Element: \", el, \" ---\\n\")\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    # Element-specific directory\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n    message(\"Element directory: \", element_dir)\n\n    # ---- Integrity check ----\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      element_log <- paste0(\n        element_log,\n        \"Dataset integrity FAILED:\\n\",\n fmla <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    # OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla, data = data)\n\n    # WLS on variance\n    if formula,\n    data,\n    y_col,\n    var_col,\n    sd_col,\n    best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <-         w_sd_tr <- 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_sd_tr)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n          w_sd_tr <- 1/(rm_tr$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_tr)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == = \"none\")\n\n        } else {\n          stop(\"Unknown model type in CV: \", mname)\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- SETUP & PACKAGE LOADING\n  ############################################################\n\n  # Core packages\n  library(ggplot2)\n  library(dplyr)\n  library(randomForest)\n  library(pls)\n  library(arm)      # bayesglm\n  library(ggsci)\n  library(lmtest)   # Breuschu2013Pagan\n\n  # --- Create / check save directory ---\n  message(\"Requested save_dir: \", save_dir)\n  save_dir <- normalizePath(save_dir, mustWork = FALSE)\n  message(\"Normalized save_dir: \", save_dir)\n\n  if (!dir.exists(save_dir)) {\n    ok <- dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)\n    if (!ok) stop(\"Could not create directory: \", save_dir)\n    message(\"Created directory: \", save_dir)\n  } else {\n    message(\"Directory already exists: \", save_dir)\n  }\n\n  # Test write to confirm path is valid\n  test_file <- file.path(save_dir, \"TEST_WRITE.txt\")\n  writeLines(\"If you can see this file, the path is correct.\", test_file)\n  message(\"Wrote test file: \", test_file)\n\n  # Log file\n  log_file <- file.path(save_dir, \"run_log.txt\")\n  writeLines(\"=== Regression Run Log ===\", log_file)\n  message(\"Initialized log file: \", log_file)\n\n  # --- Ensure Site factor order ---\n  if (\"Site\" %in% names(data)) {\n    data$Site <- factor(\n      data$Site,\n      levels = c(\"BI10\", \"HER42PB\", \"KER1\", \"KER3\", \"PB1\")\n    )\n  } else {\n    stop(\"Dataset must contain a 'Site' column.\")\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 2. HELPER FUNCTIONS\n  ############################################################\n\n  # ---- 2.1 Dataset integrity check ----\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n    errors <- c()\n\n    # Required columns exist?\n    needed <- c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (col in needed) {\n      if (!col %in% names(data))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(\"Missing column:\", col))\n    }\n    if (length(errors)) return(errors)\n\n    # Numeric checks\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]]))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(y_col, \"is not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]]))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(x_col, \"is not numeric\"))\n\n    # Missing values\n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]])))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(\"NA values in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]])))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(\"NA values in\", x_col))\n\n    # Zero variance\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(x_col, \"has zero variance\"))\n\n    # SD and variance positive\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n    }\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n    }\n\n    errors\n  }\n\n  # ---- 2.2 Unified 10-fold CV RMSE ----\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname,\n    formula,\n    data,\n    y_col,\n    var_col,\n    sd_col,\n    best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n      train_idx <- which(folds != fold)\n      test_idx  <- which(folds == fold)\n\n      train <- data[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[test_idx,  , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(data)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n          w_sd_tr <- 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_sd_tr)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n          w_sd_tr <- 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2)\n          init_tr <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_sd_tr)\n          rm_tr   <- lm(abs(init_tr$residuals) ~ init_tr$fitted.values)\n          w2_tr   <- 1/(rm_tr$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_tr)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\", \"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else {\n          stop(\"Unknown model type in CV: \", mname)\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\")) {\n          if (is.na(best_ncomp)) {\n            best_ncomp_fold <- 1\n          } else {\n            best_ncomp_fold <- best_ncomp\n          }\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp_fold, newdata = test))\n        } else {\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok     <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  # ---- 2.3 Explanation strings for diagnostics CSV ----\n  expl_shapiro     <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk normality test: p > 0.05 suggests residuals are approximately normally distributed.\"\n  expl_bp          <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan heteroscedasticity test: p < 0.05 suggests non-constant residual variance (heteroscedasticity).\"\n  expl_cv10        <- \"10-fold cross-validation RMSE: estimates prediction error on unseen data; lower values indicate better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_rf_oob      <- \"Random Forest OOB MSE/R2: internal cross-validation using out-of-bag samples; lower MSE and higher R2 indicate better performance.\"\n  expl_pls_rmsep   <- \"PLS RMSEP at best ncomp: RMSEP from PLS cross-validation for the chosen number of components; lower is better.\"\n  expl_AIC         <- \"Akaike Information Criterion (AIC): lower AIC indicates a better balance between model fit and complexity.\"\n  expl_BIC         <- \"Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC): similar to AIC but penalizes model complexity more strongly; lower is better.\"\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 3. MAIN LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\n  ############################################################\n\n  # Global summary (all elements & models)\n  global_summary <- dplyr::tibble()\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    message(\"\\n==========================\")\n    message(\"Processing element: \", el)\n    message(\"==========================\")\n\n    element_log <- paste0(\"\\n--- Element: \", el, \" ---\\n\")\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    # Element-specific directory\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n    message(\"Element directory: \", element_dir)\n\n    # --- Integrity check ---\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      element_log <- paste0(\n        element_log,\n        \"Dataset integrity FAILED:\\n\",\n        paste(\" -\", errors, collapse = \"\\n\"),\n        \"\\nSkipping element.\\n\"\n      )\n      write(element_log, file = log_file, append = TRUE)\n      next\n    }\n\n    element_log <- paste0(element_log, \"Dataset integrity OK.\\n\")\n\n    # --- Fit models ---\n    fmla <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    # 3.1 OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla, data = data)\n\n    # 3.2 WLS on variance\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = 1 / data[[var_col]])\n    }\n\n    # 3.3 Weighted OLS & 2-step WLS on SD\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1 / (data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n      init <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n      w2   <- 1 / (rm$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w2)\n    }\n\n    # 3.4 Bayesian GLM\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla, data = data)\n\n    # 3.5 Random forest\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(fmla, data = data, ntree = 500)\n\n    # 3.6 PLS LOO\n    pls_loo <- plsr(fmla, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    # 3.7 PLS k-fold\n    pls_k <- plsr(fmla, data = data, scale = TRUE,\n                  validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    # --- Per-element containers ---\n    ranking_df <- dplyr::tibble()\n    diag_df    <- dplyr::tibble()\n\n    ########################################################\n    # 3.8 PER-MODEL LOOP (diagnostics, CV, metrics, plots)\n    ########################################################\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n      message(\"  - Model: \", mname)\n\n      # Safe predictions\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n          ncomp <- attr(m, \"best_ncomp\")\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = ncomp, newdata = data))\n        } else {\n          predict(m)\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) {\n        message(\"    Prediction failed for \", mname, \": \", e$message)\n        NA\n      })\n\n      if (!is.numeric(pred) || length(pred) != nrow(data) || any(is.na(pred))) {\n        element_log <- paste0(element_log,\n                              \"Prediction invalid for \", mname, \" (skipped).\\n\")\n        next\n      }\n\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n      # --- Residual distribution plot ---\n      if (length(resid_vals) > 1 && !all(is.na(resid_vals))) {\n        res_df <- data.frame(resid = resid_vals)\n        p_res <- ggplot(res_df, aes(x = resid)) +\n          geom_histogram(fill = \"grey80\", bins = 30) +\n          geom_density(color = \"red\") +\n          theme_bw() +\n          ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"Residual Distribution\"))\n\n        ggsave(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Residuals.pdf\")),\n               p_res, width = 8, height = 8)\n      } else {\n        element_log <- paste0(element_log,\n                              \"Residuals invalid for \", mname, \" (plot skipped).\\n\")\n      }\n\n      # --- Predicted vs Observed plot ---\n      df_pred <- data.frame(Observed = y, Predicted = pred, Site = data$Site)\n\n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Site)) +\n        geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco() +\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\n        theme_bw() +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"Predicted vs Observed\"))\n\n      ggsave(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n             p_po, width = 8, height = 8)\n\n      # --- Influence plots (LM only, not Bayes) ---\n      if (inherits(m, \"lm\") && !inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n        inf_ok <- try({\n          cooks    <- cooks.distance(m)\n          leverage <- hatvalues(m)\n          rstd     <- rstandard(m)\n\n          if (length(cooks) == length(leverage) &&\n              length(leverage) == length(rstd) &&\n              is.numeric(cooks) && is.numeric(leverage) && is.numeric(rstd)) {\n\n            inf_df   <- data.frame(\n              obs      = seq_along(cooks),\n              Cook     = cooks,\n              Leverage = leverage,\n              Resid    = rstd\n            )\n\n            p_cook <- ggplot(inf_df, aes(x = obs, y = Cook)) +\n              geom_col() +\n              theme_bw() +\n              ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"Cook's Distance\"))\n\n            p_lev <- ggplot(inf_df, aes(x = Leverage, y = Resid)) +\n              geom_point() +\n              theme_bw() +\n              xlab(\"Leverage\") +\n              ylab(\"Standardized Residuals\") +\n              ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"Residuals vs Leverage\"))\n\n            pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Influence.pdf\")),\n                width = 8, height = 8)\n            print(p_cook)\n            print(p_lev)\n            dev.off()\n          } else {\n            element_log <<- paste0(\n              element_log,\n              \"Influence vectors inconsistent for \", mname, \" (skipped).\\n\"\n            )\n          }\n        }, silent = TRUE)\n\n        if (inherits(inf_ok, \"try-error\")) {\n          element_log <- paste0(\n            element_log,\n            \"Influence computation failed for \", mname, \" (skipped).\\n\"\n          )\n        }\n      }\n\n      # --- PLS RMSEP validation plot & native RMSEP ---\n      native_pls_rmsep <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n        ncomp <- attr(m, \"best_ncomp\")\n        native_pls_rmsep <- tryCatch(RMSEP(m)$val[1, ncomp + 1, 1],\n                                     error = function(e) NA_real_)\n\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PLS_RMSEP.pdf\")),\n            width = 8, height = 8)\n        validationplot(m, val.type = \"RMSEP\",\n                       main = paste(el, mname, \"RMSEP vs Components\"))\n        dev.off()\n      }\n\n      # --- RF native OOB metrics ---\n      native_rf_oob_mse <- NA_real_\n      native_rf_oob_r2  <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, \"randomForest\")) {\n        native_rf_oob_mse <- tryCatch(tail(m$mse, 1), error = function(e) NA_real_)\n        native_rf_oob_r2  <- tryCatch(tail(m$rsq, 1), error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      }\n\n      # --- Normality (Shapirou2013Wilk) ---\n      sh_W <- NA_real_\n      sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals),\n                       error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- unname(sh$statistic)\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      # --- Heteroscedasticity (Breuschu2013Pagan) ---\n      bp_stat <- NA_real_\n      bp_p    <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, \"lm\") || inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(lmtest::bptest(m), error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- unname(bp$statistic)\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      # --- AIC & BIC (LM-type only) ---\n      AIC_val <- NA_real_\n      BIC_val <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\", \"glm\", \"bayesglm\"))) {\n        AIC_val <- tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_)\n        BIC_val <- tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      }\n\n      # --- Diagnostics summary row (per model) ---\n      diag_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(diag_df, dplyr::tibble(\n        Model                   = mname,\n        Shapiro_W               = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p               = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_explanation     = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat       = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p          = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl       = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE               = cv10_rmse,\n        CV10_explanation        = expl_cv10,\n        RF_OOB_MSE              = native_rf_oob_mse,\n        RF_OOB_R2               = native_rf_oob_r2,\n        RF_OOB_explanation      = expl_rf_oob,\n        PLS_RMSEP_best          = native_pls_rmsep,\n        PLS_RMSEP_explanation   = expl_pls_rmsep,\n        AIC                     = AIC_val,\n        BIC                     = BIC_val,\n        AIC_explanation         = expl_AIC,\n        BIC_explanation         = expl_BIC\n      ))\n\n      # y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]])))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(\"NA values in\", x_col))\n\n    # Zero variance\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(x_col, \"has zero variance\"))\n\n    # SD and variance positive\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n    }\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n    }\n\n    errors\n  }\n\n  # ---- 2.2 Unified 10-fold CV RMSE ----\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname,\n    formula,\n    data,\n    y_col,\n    var_col,\n    sd_col,\n    best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n      train_idx <- which(folds != fold)\n      test_idx  <- which(folds == fold)\n\n      train <- data[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[test_idx,  , drop = FALSE)\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(data)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n          w_sd_tr <- 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_sd_tr)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n          w_sd_tr <- 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2)\n          init_tr <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_sd_tr)\n          rm_tr   <- lm(abs(init_tr$residuals) ~ init_tr$fitted.values)\n          w2_tr   <- 1/(rm_tr$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_tr)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\", \"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else {\n          stop(\"Unknown model type in CV: \", mname)\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\")) {\n          if (is.na(best_ncomp)) {\n            best_ncomp_fold <- 1\n          } else {\n            best_ncomp_fold <- best_ncomp\n          }\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp_fold, newdata = test))\n        } else {\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok     <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  # ---- 2.3 Explanation strings for diagnostics CSV ----\n  expl_shapiro     <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk normality test: p > 0.05 suggests residuals are approximately normally distributed.\"\n  expl_bp          <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan heteroscedasticity test: p < 0.05 suggests non-constant residual variance (heteroscedasticity).\"\n  expl_cv10        <- \"10-fold cross-validation RMSE: estimates prediction error on unseen data; lower values indicate better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_rf_oob      <- \"Random Forest OOB MSE/R2: internal cross-validation using out-of-bag samples; lower MSE and higher R2 indicate better performance.\"\n  expl_pls_rmsep   <- \"PLS RMSEP at best ncomp: RMSEP from PLS cross-validation for the chosen number of components; lower is better.\"\n  expl_AIC         <- \"Akaike Information Criterion (AIC): lower AIC indicates a better balance between model fit and complexity.\"\n  expl_BIC         <- \"Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC): similar to AIC but penalizes model complexity more strongly; lower is better.\"\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 3. MAIN LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\n  ############################################################\n\n  # Global summary (all elements & models)\n  global_summary <- dplyr::tibble()\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    message(\"\\n==========================\")\n    message(\"Processing element: \", el)\n    message(\"==========================\")\n\n    element_log <- paste0(\"\\n--- Element: \", el, \" ---\\n\")\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    # Element-specific directory\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n    message(\"Element directory: \", element_dir)\n\n    # --- Integrity check ---\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      element_log <- paste0(\n        element_log,\n        \"Dataset integrity FAILED:\\n\",\n        paste(\" -\", errors, collapse = \"\\n\"),\n        \"\\nSkipping element.\\n\"\n      )\n      write(element_log, file = log_file, append = TRUE)\n      next\n    }\n\n    element_log <- paste0(element_log, \"Dataset integrity OK.\\n\")\n\n    # --- Fit models ---\n    fmla <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    # 3.1 OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla, data = data)\n\n    # 3.2 WLS on variance\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = 1 / data[[var_col]])\n    }\n\n    # 3.3 Weighted OLS & 2-step WLS on SD\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1 / (data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n      init <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n      w2   <- 1 / (rm$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w2)\n    }\n\n    # 3.4 Bayesian GLM\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla, data = data)\n\n    # 3.5 Random forest\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(fmla, data = data, ntree = 500)\n\n    # 3.6 PLS LOO\n    pls_loo <- plsr(fmla, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    # 3.7 PLS k-fold\n    pls_k <- plsr(fmla, data = data, scale = TRUE,\n                  validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    # --- Per-element containers ---\n    ranking_df <- dplyr::tibble()\n    diag_df    <- dplyr::tibble()\n\n    ########################################################\n    # 3.8 PER-MODEL LOOP (diagnostics, CV, metrics, plots)\n    ########################################################\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n      message(\"  - Model: \", mname)\n\n      # Safe predictions\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n          ncomp <- attr(m, \"best_ncomp\")\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = ncomp, newdata = data))\n        } else {\n          predict(m)\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) {\n        message(\"    Prediction failed for \", mname, \": \", e$message)\n        NA\n      })\n\n      if (!is.numeric(pred) || length(pred) != nrow(data) || any(is.na(pred))) {\n        element_log <- paste0(element_log,\n                              \"Prediction invalid for \", mname, \" (skipped).\\n\")\n        next\n      }\n\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n      # --- Residual distribution plot ---\n      if (length(resid_vals) > 1 && !all(is.na(resid_vals))) {\n        res_df <- data.frame(resid = resid_vals)\n        p_res <- ggplot(res_df, aes(x = resid)) +\n          geom_histogram(fill = \"grey80\", bins = 30) +\n          geom_density(color = \"red\") +\n          theme_bw() +\n          ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"Residual Distribution\"))\n\n        ggsave(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Residuals.pdf\")),\n               p_res, width = 8, height = 8)\n      } else {\n        element_log <- paste0(element_log,\n                              \"Residuals invalid for \", mname, \" (plot skipped).\\n\")\n      }\n\n      # --- Predicted vs Observed plot ---\n      df_pred <- data.frame(Observed = y, Predicted = pred, Site = data$Site)\n\n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, color = Site)) +\n        geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco() +\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\n        theme_bw() +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"Predicted vs Observed\"))\n\n      ggsave(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n             p_po, width = 8, height = 8)\n\n      # --- Influence plots (LM only, not Bayes) ---\n      if (inherits(m, \"lm\") && !inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n        inf_ok <- try({\n          cooks    <- cooks.distance(m)\n          leverage <- hatvalues(m)\n          rstd     <- rstandard(m)\n\n          if (length(cooks) == length(leverage) &&\n              length(leverage) == length(rstd) &&\n              is.numeric(cooks) && is.numeric(leverage) && is.numeric(rstd)) {\n\n            inf_df   <- data.frame(\n              obs      = seq_along(cooks),\n              Cook     = cooks,\n              Leverage = leverage,\n              Resid    = rstd\n            )\n\n            p_cook <- ggplot(inf_df, aes(x = obs, y = Cook)) +\n              geom_col() +\n              theme_bw() +\n              ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"Cook's Distance\"))\n\n            p_lev <- ggplot(inf_df, aes(x = Leverage, y = Resid)) +\n              geom_point() +\n              theme_bw() +\n              xlab(\"Leverage\") +\n              ylab(\"Standardized Residuals\") +\n              ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"Residuals vs Leverage\"))\n\n            pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Influence.pdf\")),\n                width = 8, height = 8)\n            print(p_cook)\n            print(p_lev)\n            dev.off()\n          } else {\n            element_log <- paste0(\n              element_log,\n              \"Influence vectors inconsistent for \", mname, \" (skipped).\\n\"\n            )\n          }\n        }, silent = TRUE)\n\n        if (inherits(inf_ok, \"try-error\")) {\n          element_log <- paste0(\n            element_log,\n            \"Influence computation failed for \", mname, \" (skipped).\\n\"\n          )\n        }\n      }\n\n      # --- PLS RMSEP validation plot & native RMSEP ---\n      native_pls_rmsep <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n        ncomp <- attr(m, \"best_ncomp\")\n        native_pls_rmsep <- tryCatch(RMSEP(m)$val[1, ncomp + 1, 1],\n                                     error = function(e) NA_real_)\n\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PLS_RMSEP.pdf\")),\n            width = 8, height = 8)\n        validationplot(m, val.type = \"RMSEP\",\n                       main = paste(el, mname, \"RMSEP vs Components\"))\n        dev.off()\n      }\n\n      # --- RF native OOB metrics ---\n      native_rf_oob_mse <- NA_real_\n      native_rf_oob_r2  <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, \"randomForest\")) {\n        native_rf_oob_mse <- tryCatch(tail(m$mse, 1), error = function(e) NA_real_)\n        native_rf_oob_r2  <- tryCatch(tail(m$rsq, 1), error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      }\n\n      # --- Normality (Shapirou2013Wilk) ---\n      sh_W <- NA_real_\n      sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals),\n                       error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- unname(sh$statistic)\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      # --- Heteroscedasticity (Breuschu2013Pagan) ---\n      bp_stat <- NA_real_\n      bp_p    <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, \"lm\") || inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(lmtest::bptest(m), error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- unname(bp$statistic)\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      # --- Unified 10-fold CV RMSE ---\n      best_ncomp <- if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n      cv10_rmse  <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(mname, fmla, data, y_col, var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n\n      # --- AIC & BIC (LM-type only) ---\n      AIC_val <- NA_real_\n      BIC_val <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\", \"glm\", \"bayesglm\"))) {\n        AIC_val <- tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_)\n        BIC_val <- tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA_real_)\n      }\n\n      # --- Diagnostics summary row (per model) ---\n      diag_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(diag_df, dplyr::tibble(\n        Model                   = mname,\n        Shapiro_W               = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p               = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_explanation     = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat       = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p          = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl       = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE               = cv10_rmse,\n        CV10_explanation        = expl_cv10,\n        RF_OOB_MSE              = native_rf_oob_mse,\n        RF_OOB_R2               = native_rf_oob_r2,\n        RF_OOB_explanation      = expl_rf_oob,\n        PLS_RMSEP_best          = native_pls_rmsep,\n        PLS_RMSEP_explanation   = expl_pls_rmsep,\n        AIC                     = AIC_val,\n        BIC                     = BIC_val,\n        AIC_explanation         = expl_AIC,\n        BIC_explanation         = expl_BIC\n      ))\n\n      # ------------------------------\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col, var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA, k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse/cv_n)\n  }\n\n
