SETUP & PACKAGE LOADING\n  ############################################################\n\n  library(ggplot2)\n  library(dplyr)\n  library(randomForest)\n  library(pls)\n  library(arm)\n  library(ggsci)\n  library(lmtest)\n\n  save_dir <- normalizePath(save_dir, mustWork = FALSE)\n  if (!dir.exists(save_dir)) dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)\n\n  # Ensure write permissions\n  writeLines(\"TEST OK\", file.path(save_dir, \"TEST_WRITE.txt\"))\n\n  # Init log\n  log_file <- file.path(save_dir, \"run_log.txt\")\n  writeLines(\"=== Regression Run Log ===\", log_file)\n\n  # Ensure Site exists\n  if (!\"Site\" %in% names(data))\n    stop(\"Dataset must contain a 'Site' column.\")\n\n  data$Site <- factor(\n    data$Site,\n    levels = c(\"BI10\", \"HER42PB\", \"KER1\", \"KER3\", \"PB1\")\n  )\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 2. HELPER FUNCTIONS\n  ############################################################\n\n  # ------------------------------\n  # 2.1 Dataset integrity check\n  # ------------------------------\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n    errors <- c()\n\n    needed <- c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (col in needed)\n      if (!col %in% names(data))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(\"Missing column:\", col))\n\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]]))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(y_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]]))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n\n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]])))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(\"NA in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]])))\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\n\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errors <- c(errors, paste(x_col, \"has zero variance\"))\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errors <- c(errors, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    errors\n  }\n\n  # ------------------------------\n  # 2.2 Unified 10-fold CV RMSE\n  # ------------------------------\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col, var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA, k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_tr <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_tr   <- lm(abs(init_tr$residuals) ~ init_tr$fitted.values)\n          w2_tr   <- 1/(rm_tr$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_tr)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data=train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data=train, ntree=300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\", \"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE)\n\n        } else stop(\"Unknown model type in CV: \", mname)\n      }, error=function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit,\"mvr\")) {\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        } else predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error=function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse/cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 3. MAIN LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\n  ############################################################\n\n  # Predefine global_summary structure\n  global_summary <- dplyr::tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)\n\n    # Integrity\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      write(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse=\"; \")),\n            file=log_file, append=TRUE)\n      next\n    }\n\n    fmla <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    ########################################################\n    # 3.1 FIT ALL MODELS\n    ########################################################\n\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla, data=data)\n\n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla, data=data, weights=1/data[[var_col]])\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data=data, weights=w_sd)\n\n      init <- lm(fmla, data=data, weights=w_sd)\n      rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n      w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data=data, weights=w2)\n    }\n\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla, data=data)\n\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(fmla, data=data, ntree=500)\n\n    pls_loo <- plsr(fmla, data=data, scale=TRUE, validation=\"LOO\")\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method=\"onesigma\", plot=FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo,\"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    pls_k <- plsr(fmla, data=data, scale=TRUE, validation=\"CV\", segments=10)\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method=\"onesigma\", plot=FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k,\"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    ########################################################\n    # 3.3 MODEL LOOP\n    ########################################################\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m,\"mvr\")) {\n          ncomp <- attr(m,\"best_ncomp\")\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp=ncomp, newdata=data))\n        } else predict(m)\n      }, error=function(e) NA)\n\n      if (any(is.na(pred))) next\n\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n      ### CORRECT Ru00b2 ###\n      SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2)\n      SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)\n      R2     <- 1 - SS_res/SS_tot\n\n      RMSE  <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\n\n      cv10 <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, fmla, data, y_col, var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m,\"mvr\")) attr(m,\"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error=function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      RMSEP_summary <- if (!is.na(cv10)) cv10 else RMSE\n\n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m,c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(AIC(m), error=function(e) NA) else NA\n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m,c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(BIC(m), error=function(e) NA) else NA\n\n      #        plsr(formula, data=train, scale=TRUE)\n        else NULL\n      }, error=function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if 2.2 Cross-validation RMSE (10-fold)\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col, var_col, sd_col,\n    best_ncomp = NA, k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n          w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\", \"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          # best_ncomp = NA, k = 10) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse/cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 5. lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- All other models (WLS, RF, Bayes, OLS_weighted) are ranked **purely by metrics**.  \n5. **AIC/BIC are not used in ranking**, only in output.\n\nBelow is the **full corrected function**, in **3 parts**.  \nPaste Parts 1, 2, and 3 together in order into a single R script.\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd35 PART 1 / 3 u2014 Setup, helpers, CV, explanations\n\n```r\nrun_full_regressions <- function(\n  elements,\n  data,\n  var_suffix      = \"_var\",\n  sd_suffix       = \"_ICP_sd\",\n  save_dir        = \"/Users/sjro/Desktop/Regression\",\n  summary_all_csv = \"AllElements_ModelSummary.csv\",\n  best_models_csv = \"BestModels_PerElement.csv\"\n) {\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 1. LOAD PACKAGES\n  ############################################################\n\n  library(ggplot2)\n  library(dplyr)\n  library(randomForest)\n  library(pls)\n  library(arm)\n  library(ggsci)\n  library(lmtest)\n  library(progress)\n\n  dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 2. DATA PREP\n  ############################################################\n\n  if (!\"Site\" %in% names(data))\n    stop(\"Dataset must contain a 'Site' column.\")\n\n  data$Site <- factor(\n    data$Site,\n    levels = c(\"BI10\",\"HER42PB\",\"KER1\",\"KER3\",\"PB1\")\n  )\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 3. INTEGRITY CHECK\n  ############################################################\n\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n\n    errs <- c()\n\n    req <- c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (v in req)\n      if (!v %in% names(data))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(\"Missing:\", v))\n\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(y_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n\n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\n\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    errs\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 4. CV RMSE (10-fold)\n  ############################################################\n\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(mname, formula, data, y_col,\n                                var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA, k = 10) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n          w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse/cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 5. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  ############################################################\n\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Models are ranked as follows: (1) by R2, with higher values ranked earlier;\",\n    \"(2) for equal R2, by RMSE, with lower values ranked earlier;\",\n    \"(3) for equal R2 and similar RMSE, by RMSEP, with lower values ranked earlier.\",\n    \"AIC and BIC are not used for ranking because not all models provide them.\",\n    \"Within each element and R2 level, PLS models are always ordered above OLS models\",\n    \"to reflect better robustness to heteroscedasticity. All other models (WLS, RF,\",\n    \"Bayesian, OLS_weighted) are ordered purely by the metrics (R2, RMSE, RMSEP).\",\n    sep = \" \"\n  )\n\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 is desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 suggests non-constant variance.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold cross-validation RMSE; lower values indicate better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"R2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot; fraction of variance explained by the model.\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = root mean squared error of calibration; lower values are better.\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = cross-validated RMSE; lower values indicate better predictive performance.\"\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 6. GLOBAL SUMMARY INIT\n  ############################################################\n\n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd35 PART 2 / 3 u2014 Model fitting, diagnostics, plots\n\n```r\n  ############################################################\n  # 7. MAIN LOOP OVER ELEMENTS (with progress bar)\n  ############################################################\n\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    pb_elements$tick()\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n    # Integrity check\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      warning(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n      next\n    }\n\n    fmla <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 7.1 FIT MODELS\n    ############################################################\n\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    # OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla, data = data)\n\n    # WLS using variance column if present\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = 1/data[[var_col]])\n    }\n\n    # Weighted OLS and 2-step WLS using SD if present\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n      init_sd <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n      w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w2_sd)\n    }\n\n    # Bayesian regression (Gaussian)\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla, data = data)\n\n    # Random Forest\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(fmla, data = data, ntree = 500)\n\n    # Unweighted PLS (LOO and k-fold)\n    pls_loo <- plsr(fmla, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    pls_k <- plsr(fmla, data = data, scale = TRUE,\n                  validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 7.2 PER-ELEMENT DATAFRAMES (add_rowu2013safe)\n    ############################################################\n\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n\n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 7.3 MODEL ANALYSIS LOOP (with progress bar)\n    ############################################################\n\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      pb_models$tick()\n\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n\n      # Predictions\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        else\n          predict(m)\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n\n      if (any(is.na(pred))) next\n\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n      # Correct Ru00b2\n      SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2)\n      SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)\n      R2     <- 1 - SS_res/SS_tot\n\n      RMSE <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\n\n      # CV RMSE\n      cv10 <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, fmla, data, y_col, var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n\n      RMSEP_val <- if (!is.na(cv10)) cv10 else RMSE\n\n      # AIC / BIC only for LM/GLM/Bayes\n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\", \"glm\", \"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA) else NA\n\n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\", \"glm\", \"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA) else NA\n\n      ranking_df <- add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname, R2 = R2, RMSE = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val, AIC = AIC_val, BIC = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      global_summary <- add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el, Model = mname, R2 = R2, RMSE = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val, AIC = AIC_val, BIC = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      # Diagnostics\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- sh$statistic\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\", \"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      diag_df <- add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = cv10,\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\n        AIC_expl          = \"AIC is reported for information only and not used in ranking.\",\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\n        BIC_expl          = \"BIC is reported for information only and not used in ranking.\"\n      )\n\n      # Residuals\n      p_res <- ggplot(data.frame(resid = resid_vals), aes(resid)) +\n        geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = \"grey80\") +\n        geom_density(color = \"red\") +\n        theme_bw() +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Residuals\"))\n\n      ggsave(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Residuals.pdf\")),\n             p_res, width = 8, height = 8)\n\n      # Influence plots for classical LM models (not Bayes)\n      if (inherits(m, \"lm\") && !inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n\n        cooks <- cooks.distance(m)\n        h     <- hatvalues(m)\n        rstd  <- rstandard(m)\n\n        inf_df <- data.frame(\n          obs      = seq_along(cooks),\n          Cook     = cooks,\n          Leverage = h,\n          StdResid = rstd\n        )\n\n        p_cook <- ggplot(inf_df, aes(obs, Cook)) +\n          geom_col() +\n          theme_bw() +\n          ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Cook's Distance\"))\n\n        p_lev <- ggplot(inf_df, aes(Leverage, StdResid)) +\n          geom_point() +\n          theme_bw() +\n          ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Leverage Plot\"))\n\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Influence.pdf\")),\n            width = 8, height = 8)\n        print(p_cook)\n        print(p_lev)\n        dev.off()\n      }\n\n      # PLS RMSEP plot\n      if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PLS_RMSEP.pdf\")),\n            width = 8, height = 8)\n        validationplot(m, val.type = \"RMSEP\",\n                       main = paste(el, mname, \"- RMSEP\"))\n        dev.off()\n      }\n\n    } # PACKAGES\n  library(ggplot2)\n  library(dplyr)\n  library(randomForest)\n  library(pls)\n  library(arm)\n  library(ggsci)\n  library(lmtest)\n  library(progress)\n\n  dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n  # 2. INTEGRITY CHECK\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n\n    errs <- c()\n    req <- c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (v in req)\n      if (!v %in% names(data))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(\"Missing:\", v))\n\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(y_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n\n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\n\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    errs\n  }\n\n  # 4. CV RMSE (10-fold)\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(mname, formula, data, y_col,\n                                var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA, k = 10) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col        rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n          w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse/cv_n)\n  }\n\n  # 5. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Models are ranked first by R2 (higher values are better), then by RMSE\",\n    \"(lower is better), then by RMSEP (lower is better). AIC and BIC are not\",\n    \"used for ranking because not all models provide them. Within each element,\",\n    \"if a PLS model and an OLS model share identical R2, RMSE and RMSEP, the\",\n    \"PLS model is ranked above the OLS model to reflect better robustness to\",\n    \"heteroscedasticity. All other models (WLS, RF, Bayesian, OLS_weighted)\",\n    \"are ranked purely by the metric ordering R2u2193, RMSEu2191, RMSEPu2191.\",\n    sep = \" \"\n  )\n\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 is desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 suggests non-constant variance.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold cross-validation RMSE; lower values indicate better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"R2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot; fraction of variance explained by the model.\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = root mean squared error of calibration; lower values are better.\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = cross-validated RMSE; lower values indicate better predictive performance.\"\n\n  # 6. GLOBAL SUMMARY INIT\n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd35 PART 2 / 3 u2014 Model fitting, diagnostics, plots\n\n```r\n  ############################################################\n  # 7. MAIN LOOP OVER ELEMENTS (with progress bar)\n  ############################################################\n\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    pb_elements$tick()\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n    # Integrity check\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      warning(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n      next\n    }\n\n    fmla <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 7.1 FIT MODELS\n    ############################################################\n\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla, data = data)\n\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = 1/data[[var_col]])\n    }\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n      init_sd <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n      w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w2_sd)\n    }\n\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla, data = data)\n\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(fmla, data = data, ntree = 500)\n\n    pls_loo <- plsr(fmla, data = data, scale = TRUE, validation = \"LOO\")\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    pls_k <- plsr(fmla, data = data, scale = TRUE,\n                  validation = \"CV\", segments = 10)\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 7.2 PER-ELEMENT DATAFRAMES\n    ############################################################\n\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n\n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 7.3 MODEL ANALYSIS LOOP\n    ############################################################\n\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        else\n          predict(m)\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n\n      if (any(is.na(pred))) next\n\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n      SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2)\n      SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)\n      R2     <- 1 - SS_res/SS_tot\n      RMSE   <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\n\n      cv10 <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, fmla, data, y_col, var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n\n      RMSEP_val <- if (!is.na(cv10)) cv10 else RMSE\n\n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\", \"glm\", \"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(AIC(m), error = function(e) NA) else NA\n\n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\", \"glm\", \"bayesglm\")))\n        tryCatch(BIC(m), error = function(e) NA) else NA\n\n      ranking_df <- add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname, R2 = R2, RMSE = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val, AIC = AIC_val, BIC = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      global_summary <- add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el, Model = mname, R2 = R2, RMSE = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val, AIC = AIC_val, BIC = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      # Diagnostics\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- sh$statistic\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\", \"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error = function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      diag_df <- add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = cv10,\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\n        AIC_expl          = \"AIC is reported for information only and not used in ranking.\",\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\n        BIC_expl          = \"BIC is reported for information only and not used in ranking.\"\n      )\n\n      # Pred vs Obs plot\n      df_pred <- data.frame(\n        Observed = y,\n        Predicted = pred,\n        Site = data$Site\n      )\n\n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, color = Site)) +\n        geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco() +\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\n        theme_bw() +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Predicted vs Observed\"))\n\n      ggsave(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n             p_po, width = 8, height = 8)\n\n      # Residuals plot\n      p_res <- ggplot(data.frame(resid = resid_vals), aes(resid)) +\n        geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = \"grey80\") +\n        geom_density(color = \"red\") +\n        theme_bw() +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Residuals\"))\n\n      ggsave(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Residuals.pdf\")),\n             p_res, width = 8, height = 8)\n\n      # Influence plots for LM (not Bayes)\n      if (inherits(m, \"lm\") && !inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n\n        cooks <- cooks.distance(m)\n        h     <- hatvalues(m)\n        rstd  <- rstandard(m)\n\n        inf_df <- data.frame(\n          obs      = seq_along(cooks),\n          Cook     = cooks,\n          Leverage = h,\n          StdResid = rstd\n        )\n\n        p_cook <- ggplot(inf_df, aes(obs, Cook)) +\n          geom_col() +\n          theme_bw() +\n          ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Cook's Distance\"))\n\n        p_lev <- ggplot(inf_df, aes(Leverage, StdResid)) +\n          geom_point() +\n          theme_bw() +\n          ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Leverage Plot\"))\n\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Influence.pdf\")),\n            width = 8, height = 8)\n        print(p_cook)\n        print(p_lev)\n        dev.off()\n      }\n\n      # PLS RMSEP plot\n      if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PLS_RMSEP.pdf\")),\n            width = 8, height = 8)\n        validationplot(m, val.type = \"RMSEP\",\n                       main = paste(el, mname, \"- RMSEP\"))\n        dev.off()\n      }\n\n    } # CV RMSE (10-fold)\n  ############################################################\n\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(mname, formula, data, y_col,\n                                var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA, k = 10) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n        init <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm   <- lm(abs(init$residuals) ~ init$fitted.values)\n          w2   <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse/cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 5. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  ############################################################\n\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Models are ranked within each element as follows:\",\n    \"1) By R2, with higher R2 ranked earlier (Rank 1 has the highest R2).\",\n    \"2) For equal R2, by RMSE, with lower RMSE ranked earlier.\",\n    \"3) For equal R2 and similar RMSE, by RMSEP, with lower RMSEP ranked earlier.\",\n    \"AIC and BIC are NOT used for ranking because not all model types provide them.\",\n    \"Within each R2 level, all PLS models are placed above all OLS models,\",\n    \"but PLS models are not given priority over other model types (WLS, RF, Bayesian,\",\n    \"OLS_weighted). CV RMSE (10-fold) u2014 used only for RMSEP, not ranking\n  ############################################################\n\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(mname, formula, data, y_col,\n                                var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA, k = 10) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname    } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse/cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 5. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  ############################################################\n\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Models are ranked strictly by R2, from highest to lowest. Rank 1 always\",\n    \"corresponds to the model with the largest R2 for a given element. RMSE and\",\n    \"RMSEP are reported as secondary performance indicators but are not used to\",\n    \"determine the ranking order. AIC and BIC are also reported but are not used\",\n    \"for ranking because they are not available for all model types.\",\n    sep = \" \"\n  )\n\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 is desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 suggests non-constant variance.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold cross-validation RMSE; lower values indicate better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"R2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot; fraction of variance explained by the model (higher is better).\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = root mean squared error of calibration; lower values indicate better fit.\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = cross-validated RMSE; lower values indicate better predictive performance.\"\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 6. CROSS-VALIDATION RMSE FUNCTION\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      # Fit appropriate model for CV\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2      <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      # Prediction\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 5. EXPLANATION STRINGS\n  ############################################################\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Models are ranked by: (1) Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; (2) RMSEP lowest u2192 highest;\",\n    \"(3) RMSE lowest u2192 highest. RMSEP is emphasised over RMSE because it reflects\",\n    \"predictive performance under cross-validation. AIC/BIC are reported but not\",\n    \"used for ranking.\"\n  )\n\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 suggests non-constant variance.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold cross-validation RMSE; lower values indicate better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot; fraction of variance explained (higher is better).\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE: calibration error (lower is better).\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP: cross-validated predictive error (lowest values preferred).\"\n\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 6. INITIALISE GLOBAL SUMMARY DATAFRAME\n  ############################################################\n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n```\n\n---\n\n# ud83dudd35 **PART 2 / 3 u2014 Model Fitting, Diagnostics, Plots**\n\nud83dudccc *Continuation u2014 paste immediately after PART 1.*\n\n(Will send in the next message due to length.)"

MAIN LOOP OVER ELEMENTS (with progress bar)\n  ############################################################\n\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    pb_elements$tick()\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n    # Integrity check\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      warning(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n      next\n    }\n\n    fmla <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 7.1 FIT ALL MODELS FOR THIS ELEMENT\n    ############################################################\n\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    # OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla, data = data)\n\n    # WLS using variance column if present\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = 1 / data[[var_col]])\n    }\n\n    # Weighted OLS and 2-step WLS using SD if present\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1 / (data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n      init_sd <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n      w2_sd   <- 1 / (rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla, data = data, weights = w2_sd)\n    }\n\n    # Bayesian regression (Gaussian family)\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla, data = data)\n\n    # Random Forest\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(fmla, data = data, ntree = 500)\n\n    # 7.3 PER-MODEL ANALYSIS LOOP\n    ############################################################\n\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n\n      #               "Short answer: **because with a single predictor, all three models are essentially fitting the same straight line**, so their predictions u2013 and therefore Ru00b2 u2013 end up (almost) identical. Itu2019s not a bug in the function; itu2019s a property of the models + your setup.\n\nLet me unpack that in your context.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Youu2019re always using the same formula: `y ~ x`\n\nIn the mega-function we built, for each element we do:\n\n```r\nfmla <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n# example: Ti_ICP ~ Ti\n```\n\nThen we fit:\n\n- `OLS`  u2192 `lm(y ~ x, data=...)`\n- `Bayes` u2192 `bayesglm(y ~ x, data=...)` (Gaussian, identity link)\n- `PLS_LOO`, `PLS_kfold` u2192 `plsr(y ~ x, data=..., ...)` with **one predictor**\n\nSo all of these are trying to learn the *same* simple linear mapping:\n\n> ICP\\_element = a + b u00b7 element\n\nThereu2019s only **one X variable** in play.\n\n---\n\n## 2. With **one predictor**, PLS collapses to OLS\n\nPLS regression is really about handling **multiple, collinear predictors**.  \nBut if you only have one predictor `x`:\n\n- The first PLS component is just a rescaled version of `x`\n- With one component (which is what `selectNcomp()` will choose here), the fitted line is **algebraically equivalent** to the OLS line for `y ~ x`.\n\nSo for `Ti_ICP ~ Ti` with a single `Ti` predictor:\n\n```r\nfit_ols <- lm(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = ACE_dataset)\nfit_pls <- plsr(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = ACE_dataset, validation = \"LOO\")\npred_pls <- as.numeric(predict(fit_pls, ncomp = 1, newdata = ACE_dataset))\nall.equal(fitted(fit_ols), pred_pls)  # often TRUE (up to floating-point noise)\n```\n\nSince the **predicted values are the same**, your:\n\n```r\nR2 = 1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n```\n\ncomes out the same too.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Why Bayes GLM also gives the same Ru00b2\n\nFor `bayesglm` with:\n\n- Gaussian family\n- Identity link\n- Reasonably informative data\n- Same formula `y ~ x`\n\nu2026the posterior mode of the coefficients is extremely close to the OLS solution. So:\n\n```r\nfit_bayes <- bayesglm(y ~ x, data = ACE_dataset)\nfit_ols   <- lm(y ~ x, data = ACE_dataset)\n\nall.equal(predict(fit_ols), predict(fit_bayes))  # usually very close\n```\n\nWhen we then compute:\n\n```r\nSS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2)\nSS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)\nR2     <- 1 - SS_res/SS_tot\n```\n\nthe resulting Ru00b2 for OLS and Bayes will be numerically the same or differ only at the 4thu20135th decimal place. If we round for display (e.g. 3 d.p.), theyu2019ll **print as identical**.\n\n---\n\n## 4. How to check this in your session\n\nIf you want to convince yourself itu2019s not a bug in the mega-function, run for one element (e.g. Ti):\n\n```r\nTi_OLS   <- lm(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = ACE_dataset)\nTi_Bayes <- bayesglm(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = ACE_dataset)\nTi_PLS   <- plsr(Ti_ICP ~ Ti, data = ACE_dataset, validation = \"LOO\")\n\npred_ols   <- predict(Ti_OLS)\npred_bayes <- predict(Ti_Bayes)\npred_pls   <- as.numeric(predict(Ti_PLS, ncomp = 1, newdata = ACE_dataset))\n\nall.equal(pred_ols, pred_pls)      # often TRUE or very small differences\nall.equal(pred_ols, pred_bayes)    # usually extremely close\n```\n\nThen compute Ru00b2 by hand for each and compare:\n\n```r\ny <- ACE_dataset$Ti_ICP\n\nr2_fun <- function(pred, y) {\n  SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2)\n  SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)\n  1 - SS_res/SS_tot\n}\n\nr2_fun(pred_ols,   y)\nr2_fun(pred_bayes, y)\nr2_fun(pred_pls,   y)\n```\n\nYouu2019ll likely see theyu2019re identical or differ only at machine-precision level (and rounding hides that).\n\n---\n\n## 5. When will Ru00b2 actually differ?\n\nYouu2019ll start to see **meaningfully different Ru00b2** across models when:\n\n- You use **multiple predictors** (e.g. `Ti_ICP ~ Ti + Ca + Mn + ...` for PLS, RF, etc.)\n- You let RF or more complex models exploit non-linearity\n- You change the model families (e.g. different link functions, non-Gaussian errors)\n\nRight now, all the u201cfancyu201d models are being forced into solving basically **the same 1D straight line** problem, so they agree.\n\n---\n\nIf youu2019d like, we can next:\n\n- Extend the function so that **OLS and Bayes** still use `y ~ element`, but  \n- **PLS and RF** use **multiple predictors (all elements)** so their Ru00b2 becomes genuinely different and more informative."

              "Perfect u2014 **THIS is the change that will finally make Ru00b2 values differ across models.**  \nRight now, every model is forced to use **only one predictor**:\n\n```\nTi_ICP ~ Ti\nCa_ICP ~ Ca\nMn_ICP ~ Mn\n...\n```\n\nThis makes **OLS, Bayes, PLS, RF all fit the same 1-D regression**, so their Ru00b2 values are nearly identical.\n\nTo fix this, we must allow *multivariate* models:\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **NEW MODELING RULES YOU WANT**\nFor each element **Y** (e.g., Ti_ICP):\n\n| Model Type | Predictors |\n|------------|------------|\n| **OLS / WLS / weighted OLS** | **Single predictor** (same element only) u2192 *keep as is* |\n| **PLS** | **ALL 6 elements as predictors** |\n| **Bayesian regression** | **ALL 6 elements as predictors** |\n| **Random Forest** | **ALL 6 elements as predictors** |\n\nThis is EXACTLY how PLS, Bayes, and RF are meant to outperform linear single-element models.\n\n---\n\n# ud83dudd27 **THE FIX**\n\nBelow is the **patch you must insert** into your mega-function.\n\nWe replace this (old version):\n\n```r\nfmla <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n```\n\nwith:\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **NEW FORMULA LOGIC**\n\n```r\n# 1. \"))\n)\n```\n\nThen update model definitions:\n\n---\n\n# u2728 **1) OLS / WLS u2014 stay single-predictor**\nReplace old uses of `fmla` with `fmla_single`:\n\n```r\nmodel_list$OLS <- lm(fmla_single,               "Excellent u2014 I will now generate the **FULL UPDATED MEGA-FUNCTION**, integrating:\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **Final Model Structure**\n\n### **Single-predictor models (unchanged):**\n- OLS  \n- WLS_var  \n- OLS_weighted  \n- WLS_weighted  \n\n### **Multi-predictor models (updated):**\n- **Bayes u2192 uses ALL 6 elements as predictors**  \n- **PLS_LOO u2192 uses ALL 6 elements as predictors**  \n- **PLS_kfold u2192 uses ALL 6 elements as predictors**  \n- **Random Forest u2192 uses ALL 6 elements as predictors**\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **Ranking Logic**  \nModels ranked by:\n\n1. **Highest Ru00b2** (best explanatory fit)  \n2. **Lowest RMSEP** (best predictive CV performance)  \n3. **Lowest RMSE**\n\nNo PLS priority. LOAD PACKAGES\n  ############################################################\n  suppressPackageStartupMessages({\n    library(ggplot2)\n    library(dplyr)\n    library(randomForest)\n    library(pls)\n    library(arm)\n    library(ggsci)\n    library(progress)\n    library(lmtest)\n  })\n\n  dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 2. SITE FACTOR FIX\n  ############################################################\n  if (!\"Site\" %in% names(data))\n    stop(\"Dataset must contain a 'Site' column.\")\n\n  data$Site <- factor(\n    data$Site,\n    levels = c(\"BI10\",\"HER42PB\",\"KER1\",\"KER3\",\"PB1\")\n  )\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 3. DATA INTEGRITY CHECK\n  ############################################################\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n\n    errs <- c()\n\n    # required cols\n    req <- c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (v in req)\n      if (!v %in% names(data))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(\"Missing:\", v))\n\n    # numeric\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(y_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n\n    # NA check\n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\n\n    # variance check\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\n\n    # SD column\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    # VAR column\n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    errs\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 4. 10-FOLD CV RMSE FUNCTION\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      # Fit appropriate model for CV\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      # Prediction\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 5. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  ############################################################\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\",\n    \"AIC/BIC are reported but not used for ranking.\"\n  )\n\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests normality; p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 indicates heteroscedasticity.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE; lower indicates better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot; fraction of variance explained.\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error.\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = predictive error from 10-fold CV.\"\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 6. GLOBAL SUMMARY INIT\n  ############################################################\n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n```\n\n---\n\n# ud83dudd35 **PART 2 / 3 u2014 Model Fitting, Diagnostics, Plots**\nPaste this below PART 1.\n\n```r\n  ############################################################\n  # 7. LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\n  ############################################################\n\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    pb_elements$tick()\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")    # integrity check\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      warning(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n      next\n    }\n\n    # SINGLE-PREDICTOR formula (OLS, WLS)\n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n\n    # MULTI-PREDICTOR formula (PLS, Bayes, RF)\n    fmla_multi <- as.formula(\n      paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \"))\n    )\n\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 7.1 FIT MODELS\n    ############################################################\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    # --- OLS ---\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n\n    # --- WLS based on variance column ---\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla_single, data = data,\n                               weights = 1/data[[var_col]])\n    }\n\n    # --- Weighted OLS and 2-stage WLS by SD ---\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n      init_sd <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n      w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2_sd)\n    }\n\n    # --- Bayesian regression (multivariate) ---\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data)\n\n    # --- Random Forest (multivariate) ---\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      ntree = 500,\n      importance = TRUE\n    )\n\n    # --- PLS (multivariate) ---\n    pls_loo <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"LOO\"\n    )\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    pls_k <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"CV\",\n      segments = 10\n    )\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 7.2 PER-ELEMENT DATAFRAMES\n    ############################################################\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n\n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 7.3 MODEL ANALYSIS LOOP\n    ############################################################\n\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      pb_models$tick()\n\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n\n      # Predictions for full dataset\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        } else {\n          predict(m)\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n\n      if (any(is.na(pred))) next\n\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n      # Ru00b2\n      SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2)\n      SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)\n      R2     <- 1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n\n      # RMSE\n      RMSE <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\n\n      # RMSEP via 10-fold CV\n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n                      fmla_single else fmla_multi\n\n      cv10 <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n\n      RMSEP_val <- cv10\n\n      # AIC / BIC\n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n                   tryCatch(AIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n\n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n                   tryCatch(BIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n\n      ranking_df <- add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      global_summary <- add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2,\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\n        BIC     = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # Diagnostics\n      ############################################################\n\n      # Shapirou2013Wilk\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- sh$statistic\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      # Breuschu2013Pagan\n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      diag_df <- add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = cv10,\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\n        AIC_expl          = \"AIC not used for ranking.\",\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\n        BIC_expl          = \"BIC not used for ranking.\"\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # PLOTS\n      ############################################################\n\n      # 1) Predicted vs Observed\n      df_pred <- data.frame(\n        Observed  = y,\n        Predicted = pred,\n        Site      = data$Site\n      )\n\n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, color = Site)) +\n        geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco() +\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\n        theme_bw() +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Predicted vs Observed\"))\n\n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n        p_po, width = 8, height = 8\n      )\n\n      # 2) Residual distribution\n      p_res <- ggplot(data.frame(resid = resid_vals), aes(resid)) +\n        geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = \"grey80\") +\n        geom_density(color = \"red\") +\n        theme_bw() +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Residuals\"))\n\n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Residuals.pdf\")),\n        p_res, width = 8, height = 8\n      )\n\n      #
