LOAD PACKAGES\n  ############################################################\n  suppressPackageStartupMessages({\n    library(ggplot2)\n    library(dplyr)\n    library(randomForest)\n    library(pls)\n    library(arm)\n    library(ggsci)\n    library(progress)\n    library(lmtest)\n  })\n\n  dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 2. SITE FACTOR\n  ############################################################\n  if (!\"Site\" %in% names(data))\n    stop(\"Dataset must contain a 'Site' column.\")\n\n  data$Site <- factor(\n    data$Site,\n    levels = c(\"BI10\",\"HER42PB\",\"KER1\",\"KER3\",\"PB1\")\n  )\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 3. DATA INTEGRITY CHECK\n  ############################################################\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n\n    errs <- c()\n\n    req <- c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (v in req)\n      if (!v %in% names(data))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(\"Missing:\", v))\n\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(y_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n\n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\n\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    errs\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 4. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          # Standard WLS based on OLS residuals (Feasible GLS style)\n          ols_fit <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n          f_ols   <- fitted(ols_fit)\n          rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ f_ols)\n          w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_ols)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 5. EXPLANATION STRINGS\n  ############################################################\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Models ranked by: (1) Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest;\",\n    \"(2) RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; (3) RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\",\n    \"AIC/BIC reported for context but not used in ranking.\"\n  )\n\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 indicates non-constant variance.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold cross-validation RMSE; lower = better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot; fraction of variance explained.\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error (lower = better fit).\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = predictive error from 10-fold cross-validation (lower = better).\"\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 6. GLOBAL SUMMARY INIT\n  ############################################################\n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd35 PART 2 / 3 u2014 Model fitting, diagnostics, plots (with annotations)\n\n```r\n  ############################################################\n  # 7. LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\n  ############################################################\n\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    pb_elements$tick()\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")    # response\n    x_col  <- el                    # single predictor\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      warning(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n      next\n    }\n\n    # SINGLE-PREDICTOR formula (OLS & WLS variants)\n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n\n    # MULTI-PREDICTOR formula (PLS, Bayes, RF) using all 6 elements\n    fmla_multi <- as.formula(\n      paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \"))\n    )\n\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 7.1 FIT MODELS\n    ############################################################\n\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    # OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n\n    # Standard WLS based on OLS residuals (Feasible GLS)\n    {\n      ols_fit <- model_list$OLS\n      r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n      f_ols   <- fitted(ols_fit)\n      rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ f_ols)\n      w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_ols)\n    }\n\n    # WLS based on variance column\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla_single, data = data,\n                               weights = 1/data[[var_col]])\n    }\n\n    # Weighted OLS and 2-stage WLS based on sd column\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n      init_sd <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n      w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2_sd)\n    }\n\n    # Bayesian regression (multivariate)\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data)\n\n    # Random Forest (multivariate)\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      ntree = 500,\n      importance = TRUE\n    )\n\n    # PLS (multivariate) LOO\n    pls_loo <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"LOO\"\n    )\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    # PLS (multivariate) k-fold\n    pls_k <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"CV\",\n      segments = 10\n    )\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 7.2 PER-ELEMENT TABLES\n    ############################################################\n\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n\n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 7.3 MODEL ANALYSIS\n    ############################################################\n\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n\n      # Predictions\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        } else {\n          predict(m)\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n\n      if (any(is.na(pred))) next\n\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n      # Ru00b2\n      SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2)\n      SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)\n      R2     <- 1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n\n      # RMSE\n      RMSE <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\n\n      # RMSEP via CV (single- vs multi-predictor distinction)\n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n                      fmla_single else fmla_multi\n\n      cv10 <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n      RMSEP_val <- cv10\n\n      # AIC/BIC\n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n                   tryCatch(AIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n                   tryCatch(BIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n\n      ranking_df <- add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n ##########################################################\n\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- ############################################################\n  # 5. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER FUNCTION\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols_fit <- lm(formula, weights = w_ols)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & cv_n)\n  }\n\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 6. y_col))\r\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\r\n\r\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\r\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\r\n\r\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data))\r\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\r\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\r\n\r\n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\r\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\r\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\r\n\r\n    errs\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  # 5. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER FUNCTION\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\r\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\r\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\r\n    k = 10\r\n  ) {\r\n\r\n    set.seed(123)\r\n    n <- nrow(data)\r\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\r\n\r\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\r\n    cv_sse <- 0\r\n    cv_n   <- 0\r\n\r\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\r\n\r\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\r\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\r\n\r\n      fit <- tryCatch({\r\n\r\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\r\n          lm(formula, data = train)\r\n\r\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\r\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\r\n\r\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\r\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\r\n\r\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\r\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\r\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\r\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\r\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\r\n\r\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\r\n          ols_fit <- lm(formula, data = train)\r\n          r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\r\n          rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\r\n          w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\r\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_ols)\r\n\r\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\r\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\r\n\r\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\r\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\r\n\r\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\r\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\r\n\r\n        } else NULL\r\n\r\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\r\n\r\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\r\n\r\n      pred <- tryCatch({\r\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\r\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\r\n        else\r\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\r\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\r\n\r\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\r\n\r\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\r\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\r\n      if (!any(ok)) next\r\n\r\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\r\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\r\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  # 6. EXPLANATION TEXT\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  expl_rank <- paste(\r\n    \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\",\r\n    \"AIC/BIC reported but not used for ranking.\"\r\n  )\r\n\r\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 desirable.\"\r\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 indicates non-constant variance.\"\r\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE; lower indicates better predictive performance.\"\r\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot.\"\r\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error (lower = better).\"\r\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold CV predictive error.\"\r\n\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  # 7. GLOBAL SUMMARY TABLE\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  global_summary <- tibble(\r\n    Element = character(),\r\n    Model   = character(),\r\n    R2      = numeric(),\r\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\r\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\r\n    AIC     = numeric(),\r\n    BIC     = numeric()\r\n  )\r\n\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  # 8. LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\r\n  ############################################################\r\n\r\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\r\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\r\n    total  = length(elements),\r\n    clear  = FALSE,\r\n    width  = 80\r\n  )\r\n\r\n  for (el in elements) {\r\n\r\n    pb_elements$tick()\r\n\r\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\r\n    x_col  <- el\r\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\r\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\r\n\r\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\r\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\r\n\r\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\r\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\r\n      warning(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\r\n      next\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\r\n    fmla_multi  <- as.formula(\r\n      paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \"))\r\n    )\r\n\r\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\r\n\r\n    ############################################################\r\n    # 8.1 FIT MODELS\r\n    ############################################################\r\n\r\n    model_list <- list()\r\n\r\n    # OLS\r\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\r\n\r\n    # Standard WLS (based on OLS residuals)\r\n    {\r\n      ols_fit <- model_list$OLS\r\n      r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\r\n      rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\r\n      w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\r\n      model_list$WLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_ols)\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    # WLS_var\r\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\r\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla_single, data = data,\r\n                               weights = 1/data[[var_col]])\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    # OLS_weighted & WLS_weighted (SD based)\r\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\r\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\r\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\r\n\r\n      init_sd <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\r\n      rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\r\n      w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\r\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2_sd)\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    # Bayesian (multivariate)\r\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data)\r\n\r\n    # Random Forest (multivariate)\r\n    set.seed(42)\r\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\r\n      fmla_multi,\r\n      data = data,\r\n      ntree = 500,\r\n      importance = TRUE\r\n    )\r\n\r\n    # PLS LOOCV\r\n    pls_loo <- plsr(\r\n      fmla_multi,\r\n      data = data,\r\n      scale = TRUE,\r\n      validation = \"LOO\"\r\n    )\r\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\r\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\r\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\r\n\r\n    # PLS kfold\r\n    pls_k <- plsr(\r\n      fmla_multi,\r\n      data = data,\r\n      scale = TRUE,\r\n      validation = \"CV\",\r\n      segments = 10\r\n    )\r\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\r\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\r\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\r\n\r\n    ############################################################\r\n    # 8.2 RESULT TABLES\r\n    ############################################################\r\n\r\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\r\n      Model = character(),\r\n      R2    = numeric(),\r\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\r\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\r\n      AIC   = numeric(),\r\n      BIC   = numeric()\r\n    )\r\n\r\n    diag_df <- tibble(\r\n      Model             = character(),\r\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\r\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\r\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\r\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\r\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\r\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\r\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\r\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\r\n      AIC               = numeric(),\r\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\r\n      BIC               = numeric(),\r\n      BIC_expl          = character()\r\n    )\r\n\r\n    ############################################################\r\n    # 8.3 MODEL ANALYSIS LOOP\r\n    ############################################################\r\n\r\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\r\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\r\n      total  = length(model_list),\r\n      clear  = FALSE,\r\n      width  = 70\r\n    )\r\n\r\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\r\n\r\n      pb_models$tick()\r\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\r\n\r\n      pred <- tryCatch({\r\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\r\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\r\n        else\r\n          predict(m)\r\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\r\n\r\n      if (any(is.na(pred))) next\r\n\r\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\r\n\r\n      # R2\r\n      SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2)\r\n      SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)\r\n      R2     <- 1 - SS_res / SS_tot\r\n\r\n      # RMSE\r\n      RMSE <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\r\n\r\n      # RMSEP via CV\r\n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\r\n                      fmla_single else fmla_multi\r\n\r\n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\r\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\r\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\r\n          var_col, sd_col,\r\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\r\n        ),\r\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\r\n      )\r\n\r\n      # AIC/BIC\r\n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\r\n                   tryCatch(AIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\r\n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\r\n                   tryCatch(BIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\r\n\r\n      ranking_df <- add_row(\r\n        ranking_df,\r\n        Model = mname,\r\n        R2    = R2,\r\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\r\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\r\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\r\n        BIC   = BIC_val\r\n      )\r\n\r\n      global_summary <- add_row(\r\n        global_summary,\r\n        Element = el,\r\n        Model   = mname,\r\n        R2      = R2,\r\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\r\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\r\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\r\n        BIC     = BIC_val\r\n      )\r\n\r\n      ############################################################\r\n      # Diagnostics\r\n      ############################################################\r\n\r\n      # Shapirou2013Wilk\r\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\r\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\r\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error=function(e) NULL)\r\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\r\n          sh_W <- sh$statistic\r\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      # Breuschu2013Pagan\r\n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\r\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\r\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error=function(e) NULL)\r\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\r\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\r\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      diag_df <- add_row(\r\n        diag_df,\r\n        Model             = mname,\r\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\r\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\r\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\r\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\r\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\r\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\r\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\r\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\r\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\r\n        AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\r\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\r\n        BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\r\n      )\r\n\r\n      ############################################################\r\n      # PLOT LABEL WITH R2/RMSE/RMSEP\r\n      ############################################################\r\n      stats_label <- paste0(\r\n        \"Ru00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\r\n        \"\\nRMSEP = \", signif(RMSEP_val, 3),\r\n        \"\\nRMSE = \", signif(RMSE, 3)\r\n      )\r\n\r\n      ############################################################\r\n      # 8-POINT PLOTS u2014 13u00d79 cm OUTPUT\r\n      ############################################################\r\n\r\n      ### 1) Predicted vs Observed ###\r\n      df_pred <- data.frame(\r\n        Observed  = y,\r\n        Predicted = pred,\r\n        Site      = data$Site\r\n      )\r\n\r\n      x_min_po <- min(df_pred$Observed, na.rm=TRUE)\r\n      y_max_po <- max(df_pred$Predicted, na.rm=TRUE)\r\n\r\n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, color = Site)) +\r\n        geom_point(size = 1.25, alpha = 0.85) +\r\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco() +\r\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\r\n        annotate(\"text\",\r\n                 x = x_min_po,\r\n                 y = y_max_po,\r\n                 hjust = 0,\r\n                 vjust = 1,\r\n                 label = stats_label,\r\n                 size = 2.7) +\r\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\r\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Predicted vs Observed\"))\r\n\r\n      ggsave(\r\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\r\n        p_po, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\r\n      )\r\n\r\n\r\n      ### 2) Residual distribution ###\r\n      res_df <- data.frame(resid = resid_vals)\r\n      hist_obj <- hist(resid_vals, plot = FALSE)\r\n      x_min_res <- min(resid_vals, na.rm=TRUE)\r\n      y_max_res <- max(hist_obj$counts, na.rm=TRUE)\r\n\r\n      p_res <- ggplot(res_df, aes(resid)) +\r\n        geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = \"grey80\") +\r\n        geom_density(color = \"red\") +\r\n        annotate(\"text\",\r\n                 x = x_min_res,\r\n                 y = y_max_res,\r\n                 hjust = 0,\r\n                 vjust = 1,\r\n                 label = stats_label,\r\n                 size = 2.7) +\r\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\r\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Residuals\"))\r\n\r\n      ggsave(\r\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Residuals.pdf\")),\r\n        p_res, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\r\n      )\r\n\r\n\r\n      ### 3) Influence plots ###\r\n      if (inherits(m, \"lm\") && !inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\r\n\r\n        cooks <- cooks.distance(m)\r\n        lev   <- hatvalues(m)\r\n        rstd  <- rstandard(m)\r\n\r\n        inf_df <- data.frame(\r\n          obs      = seq_along(cooks),\r\n          Cook     = cooks,\r\n          Leverage = lev,\r\n          StdResid = rstd\r\n        )\r\n\r\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Influence.pdf\")),\r\n            width = 13/2.54, height = 9/2.54)\r\n\r\n        print(\r\n          ggplot(inf_df, aes(obs, Cook)) +\r\n            geom_col() +\r\n            theme_bw() + theme_small +\r\n            ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Cook's Distance\"))\r\n        )\r\n\r\n        print(\r\n          ggplot(inf_df, aes(Leverage, StdResid)) +\r\n            geom_point(size = 1.25) +\r\n            theme_bw() + theme_small +\r\n            ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Leverage Plot\"))\r\n        )\r\n\r\n        dev.off()\r\n      }\r\n\r\n\r\n      ### 4) PLS RMSEP vs Components ###\r\n      if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\r\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PLS_RMSEP.pdf\")),\r\n            width = 13/2.54, height = 9/2.54)\r\n\r\n        validationplot(\r\n          m,\r\n          val.type = \"RMSEP\",\r\n          main = paste(el, mname, \"- RMSEP vs Components\")\r\n        )\r\n\r\n        dev.off()\r\n      }\r\n\r\n    } # end model loop\r\n\r\n    ############################################################\r\n    # 8.4 RANK MODELS u2014 R2 u2193 u2192 RMSEP u2191 u2192 RMSE u2191\r\n    ############################################################\r\n\r\n    if (nrow(ranking_df) > 0) {\r\n\r\n      ranking_df <- ranking_df %>%\r\n        arrange(\r\n          dplyr::desc(R2),\r\n          RMSEP,\r\n          RMSE\r\n        ) %>%\r\n        mutate(Rank = row_number())\r\n\r\n      ranking_expl_df <- ranking_df %>%\r\n        mutate(\r\n          Rank_explanation  = expl_rank,\r\n          R2_explanation    = expl_r2,\r\n          RMSE_explanation  = expl_rmse,\r\n          RMSEP_explanation = expl_rmsep\r\n        )\r\n\r\n      write.csv(\r\n        ranking_expl_df,\r\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_Model_Ranking.csv\")),\r\n        row.names = FALSE\r\n      )\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    ############################################################\r\n    # 8.5 DIAGNOSTICS SUMMARY\r\n    ############################################################\r\n\r\n    write.csv(\r\n      diag_df,\r\n      file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_Diagnostics_Summary.csv\")),\r\n      row.names = FALSE\r\n    )\r\n\r\n    ############################################################\r\n    # 8.6 README PER ELEMENT\r\n    ############################################################\r\n\r\n    readme_txt <- c(\r\n      paste(\"Element:\", el),\r\n      \"\",\r\n      \"MODELS FITTED:\",\r\n      \"  - OLS (single predictor)\",\r\n      \"  - Standard WLS (Feasible GLS residual-weighted)\",\r\n      \"  - WLS_var (variance-weighted)\",\r\n      \"  - OLS_weighted (sd-weighted)\",\r\n      \"  - WLS_weighted (two-stage sd-weighted)\",\r\n      \"  - Bayes (multivariate)\",\r\n      \"  - Random Forest (multivariate)\",\r\n      \"  - PLS_LOO (multivariate, LOOCV components)\",\r\n      \"  - PLS_kfold (multivariate, 10-fold CV components)\",\r\n      \"\",\r\n      \"RANKING RULES:\",\r\n      \"  1) Highest Ru00b2 ranked best\",\r\n      \"  2) If similar Ru00b2, lower RMSEP ranks higher\",\r\n      \"  3) If still similar, lower RMSE ranks higher\",\r\n      \"  (AIC/BIC reported but not used)\",\r\n      \"\",\r\n      \"FILES GENERATED:\",\r\n      \"  - Predicted vs Observed (8-pt text, 13u00d79 cm)\",\r\n      \"  - Residual distributions (annotated)\",\r\n      \"  - Influence diagnostics (lm only)\",\r\n      \"  - PLS RMSEP curve\",\r\n      \"  - Model Ranking CSV\",\r\n      \"  - Diagnostics Summary CSV\",\r\n      \"  - README.txt\"\r\n    )\r\n\r\n    writeLines(readme_txt, file.path(element_dir, \"README.txt\"))\r\n\r\n  } # end element loop\r\n\r\n\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  # 9. GLOBAL SUMMARY ACROSS ELEMENTS\r\n  ############################################################\r\n\r\n  if (nrow(global_summary) > 0) {\r\n\r\n    global_ranked <- global_summary %>%\r\n      arrange(\r\n        Element,\r\n        dplyr::desc(R2),\r\n        RMSEP,\r\n        RMSE\r\n      ) %>%\r\n      group_by(Element) %>%\r\n      mutate(Rank = row_number()) %>%\r\n      ungroup()\r\n\r\n    write.csv(\r\n      global_ranked,\r\n      file.path(save_dir, summary_all_csv),\r\n      row.names = FALSE\r\n    )\r\n\r\n    best_models <- global_ranked %>%\r\n      filter(Rank == 1)\r\n\r\n    write.csv(\r\n      best_models,\r\n      file.path(save_dir, best_models_csv),\r\n      row.names = FALSE\r\n    )\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  # 10. FINISH\r\n  ############################################################\r\n\r\n  message(\"=== COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY ===\")\r\n  message(\"Output saved to: \", save_dir)\r\n}\r\n''')\r\n\r\npath = \"/mnt/data/run_full_regressions_13x9cm.R\"\r\nwith open(path, \"w\") as f:\r\n    f.write(code)\r\n\r\npath"
            ]
          },
          "status": "finished_successfully",
          "end_turn": false,

c()\r\n\r\n    req <- c(y_col, x_col)\r\n    for (v in req)\r\n      if (!v %in% names(data))\r\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(\"Missing:\", v))\r\n\r\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errs <- y_col))\r\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\r\n\r\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\r\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\r\n\r\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data))\r\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\r\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\r\n\r\n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\r\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\r\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\r\n\r\n    errs\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  # 5. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER FUNCTION\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\r\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\r\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\r\n    k = 10\r\n  ) {\r\n\r\n    set.seed(123)\r\n    n <- nrow(data)\r\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\r\n\r\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\r\n    cv_sse <- 0\r\n    cv_n   <- 0\r\n\r\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\r\n\r\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\r\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\r\n\r\n      fit <- tryCatch({\r\n\r\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\r\n          lm(formula, data = train)\r\n\r\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\r\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\r\n\r\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\r\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\r\n\r\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\r\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\r\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\r\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\r\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\r\n\r\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\r\n          ols_fit <- lm(formula, data = train)\r\n          r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\r\n          rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\r\n          w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\r\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_ols)\r\n\r\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\r\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\r\n\r\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\r\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\r\n\r\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\r\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\r\n\r\n        } else NULL\r\n\r\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\r\n\r\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\r\n\r\n      pred <- tryCatch({\r\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\r\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\r\n        else\r\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\r\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\r\n\r\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\r\n\r\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\r\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\r\n      if (!any(ok)) next\r\n\r\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\r\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\r\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  # 6. EXPLANATION TEXT\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  expl_rank <- paste(\r\n    \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\",\r\n    \"AIC/BIC reported but not used for ranking.\"\r\n  )\r\n\r\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 desirable.\"\r\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 indicates non-constant variance.\"\r\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE; lower indicates better predictive performance.\"\r\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot.\"\r\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error (lower = better).\"\r\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold CV predictive error.\"\r\n\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  # 7. GLOBAL SUMMARY TABLE\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  global_summary <- tibble(\r\n    Element = character(),\r\n    Model   = character(),\r\n    R2      = numeric(),\r\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\r\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\r\n    AIC     = numeric(),\r\n    BIC     = numeric()\r\n  )\r\n\r\n  ############################################################\r\n  # 8. LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\r\n  ############################################################\r\n\r\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\r\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) ############################################################\r\n\r\n    model_list <- list()\r\n\r\n    # OLS\r\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\r\n\r\n    # Standard WLS (based on OLS residuals)\r\n    {\r\n      ols_fit <- model_list$OLS\r\n      r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\r\n      rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\r\n      w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\r\n      model_list$WLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_ols)\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    # WLS_var\r\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\r\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla_single, data = data,\r\n                               weights = 1/data[[var_col]])\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    # OLS_weighted & WLS_weighted (SD based)\r\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\r\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\r\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\r\n\r\n      init_sd <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\r\n      rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\r\n      w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\r\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2_sd)\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    # Bayesian (multivariate)\r\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data)\r\n\r\n    # Random Forest (multivariate)\r\n    set.seed(42)\r\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\r\n      fmla_multi,\r\n      data = data,\r\n      ntree = 500,\r\n      importance = TRUE\r\n    )\r\n\r\n    # PLS LOOCV\r\n    pls_loo <- plsr(\r\n      fmla_multi,\r\n      data = data,\r\n      scale = TRUE,\r\n      validation = \"LOO\"\r\n    )\r\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\r\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\r\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\r\n\r\n    # PLS kfold\r\n    pls_k <- plsr(\r\n      fmla_multi,\r\n      data = data,\r\n      scale = TRUE,\r\n      validation = \"CV\",\r\n      segments = 10\r\n    )\r\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\r\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\r\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\r\n\r\n    ############################################################\r\n    # 8.2 RESULT TABLES\r\n    ############################################################\r\n\r\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\r\n      Model = character(),\r\n      R2    = numeric(),\r\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\r\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\r\n      AIC   = numeric(),\r\n      BIC   = numeric()\r\n    )\r\n\r\n    diag_df <- tibble(\r\n      Model             = character(),\r\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\r\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\r\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\r\n      BreuschPagan_stat =  = numeric(),\r\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\r\n      BIC               = numeric(),\r\n      BIC_expl          = character()\r\n    )\r\n\r\n    ############################################################\r\n    # 8.3 MODEL ANALYSIS LOOP\r\n    ############################################################\r\n\r\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\r\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\r\n      total  = length(model_list),\r\n      clear  = FALSE,\r\n      width  = 70\r\n    )\r\n\r\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\r\n\r\n      pb_models$tick()\r\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\r\n\r\n      pred <- tryCatch({\r\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\r\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\r\n        else\r\n          predict(m)\r\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\r\n\r\n      if (any(is.na(pred)))    RMSE <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\r\n\r\n      # RMSEP via CV\r\n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\r\n                      fmla_single else fmla_multi\r\n\r\n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\r\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\r\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\r\n          var_col, sd_col,\r\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\r\n        ),\r\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\r\n      )\r\n\r\n      # AIC/BIC\r\n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\r\n                   tryCatch(AIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\r\n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\r\n                   tryCatch(BIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\r\n\r\n      ranking_df <- add_row(\r\n        ranking_df,\r\n        Model = mname,\r\n        R2    = R2,\r\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\r\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\r\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\r\n        BIC   = BIC_val\r\n      )\r\n\r\n      global_summary <- add_row(\r\n        global_summary,\r\n        Element = el,\r\n        Model   = mname,\r\n        R2      = R2,\r\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\r\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\r\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\r\n        BIC     = BIC_val\r\n      )\r\n\r\n      ############################################################\r\n      # Diagnostics\r\n      ############################################################\r\n\r\n      # Shapirou2013Wilk\r\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\r\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\r\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error=function(e) NULL)\r\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\r\n          sh_W <- sh$statistic\r\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\r\n        }\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      # Breuschu2013Pagan\r\n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\r\n      if (inherits(m,  }\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      diag_df <- add_row(\r\n        diag_df,\r\n        Model             = mname,\r\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\r\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\r\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\r\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\r\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\r\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\r\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\r\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\r\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\r\n        AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\r\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\r\n        BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\r\n      )\r\n\r\n      ############################################################\r\n      # PLOT LABEL WITH R2/RMSE/RMSEP\r\n      ############################################################\r\n      stats_label <- paste0(\r\n        \"Ru00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\r\n        \"\\nRMSEP = \", signif(RMSEP_val, 3),\r\n        \"\\nRMSE = \", signif(RMSE, 3)\r\n      )\r\n\r\n      ############################################################\r\n      # 8-POINT PLOTS u2014 13u00d79 cm OUTPUT\r\n      ############################################################\r\n\r\n      ### 1) Predicted vs Observed ###\r\n      df_pred <- data.frame(\r\n        Observed  = y,\r\n        Predicted = pred,\r\n        Site      = data$Site\r\n      )\r\n\r\n      x_min_po <- min(df_pred$Observed, na.rm=TRUE)\r\n      y_max_po <- max(df_pred$Predicted, na.rm=TRUE)\r\n\r\n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 6.               "Nice, letu2019s bolt the prediction/export layer on top of the mega-function you already have.\n\nYou asked for:\n\n- Input data are **log-transformed** u2192 predictions must be **back-transformed with exp()** to ppm.  \n- A **new dataset** `XRF_new` with XRF data u2192 make predictions on this.  \n- For **each element and each of the 8 models**, create a CSV like `Ti_preds.csv` containing:\n  - All original columns from `XRF_new`\n  - Plus new columns:\n    - `Model_Element_Pred_ppm`  \n    - `Model_Element_L95_ppm`  \n    - `Model_Element_U95_ppm`  \n- Models: `OLS`, `WLS`, `WLS_var`, `OLS_weighted`, `WLS_weighted`, `Bayes`, `RF`, `PLS_LOO`, `PLS_kfold`.\n\nBelow is the **full updated function**, split into **6 chunks** for copying.\n\n> ud83dudd01 General CI logic:\n> - OLS / WLS-family: use `predict(..., interval=\"prediction\")` on log scale where possible.  \n> - Bayes: approximate normal CI from `se.fit`.  \n> - RF / PLS: use `pred u00b1 1.96 * RMSE` (calibration RMSE on log scale) as an approximate 95% interval.  \n> - All intervals are then **back-transformed**: `ppm = exp(log_value)`.\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 1 OF 6 u2014 Header, packages, theme, integrity, CV helper, explanations, global summary\n\n```r\nrun_full_regressions <- function(\n  elements,\n  data,\n  XRF_new       = NULL,  # <-- new prediction dataset\n  var_suffix    = \"_var\",\n  sd_suffix     = \"_ICP_sd\",\n  save_dir      = \"/Users/sjro/Desktop/Regression_multivariate_6\",\n  summary_all_csv = \"AllElements_ModelSummary.csv\",\n  best_models_csv  = \"BestModels_PerElement.csv\"\n) {\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 1. LOAD PACKAGES\n  ############################################################\n  suppressPackageStartupMessages({\n    library(ggplot2)\n    library(dplyr)\n    library(randomForest)\n    library(pls)\n    library(arm)\n    library(ggsci)\n    library(progress)\n    library(lmtest)\n  })\n\n  dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 2. SITE FACTOR\n  ############################################################\n  if (!\"Site\" %in% names(data))\n    stop(\"Dataset must contain a 'Site' column.\")\n\n  data$Site <- factor(\n    data$Site,\n    levels = c(\"BI10\",\"HER42PB\",\"KER1\",\"KER3\",\"PB1\")\n  )\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 3. UNIVERSAL 8-POINT THEME\n  ############################################################\n  theme_small <- theme(\n    text       = element_text(size = 8),\n    axis.text  = element_text(size = 8),\n    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),\n    legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),\n    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),\n    plot.title   = element_text(size = 8, face = \"bold\")\n  )\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 4. DATA INTEGRITY CHECK\n  ############################################################\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n\n    errs <- c()\n\n    req <- c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (v in req)\n      if (!v %in% names(data))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(\"Missing:\", v))\n\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(y_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n\n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\n\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    errs\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 5. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER FUNCTION\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols_fit <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n          rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n          w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_ols)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 6. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  ############################################################\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\",\n    \"AIC/BIC reported but not used for ranking.\"\n  )\n\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 indicates non-constant variance.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE; lower indicates better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot.\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error (lower = better).\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold cross-validated predictive error (lower = better).\"\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 7. GLOBAL SUMMARY TABLE\n  ############################################################\n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 2 OF 6 u2014 Element loop, formulas, model fitting\n\n```r\n  ############################################################\n  # 8. LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\n  ############################################################\n\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    pb_elements$tick()\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      warning(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n      next\n    }\n\n    # SINGLE-PREDICTOR formula (OLS/WLS family)\n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n\n    # MULTI-PREDICTOR formula (Bayes, RF, PLS) using all elements\n    fmla_multi  <- as.formula(\n      paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \"))\n    )\n\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.1 FIT MODELS\n    ############################################################\n\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    # OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n\n    # Standard WLS (residual-based)\n    {\n      ols_fit <- model_list$OLS\n      r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n      rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n      w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_ols)\n    }\n\n    # WLS_var\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla_single, data = data,\n                               weights = 1/data[[var_col]])\n    }\n\n    # OLS_weighted & WLS_weighted (sd-based)\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n      init_sd <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n      w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2_sd)\n    }\n\n    # Bayesian regression (multivariate)\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data)\n\n    # Random Forest (multivariate)\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      ntree = 500,\n      importance = TRUE\n    )\n\n    # PLS LOOCV (multivariate)\n    pls_loo <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"LOO\"\n    )\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    # PLS k-fold (multivariate)\n    pls_k <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"CV\",\n      segments = 10\n    )\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.2 RESULT TABLES FOR THIS ELEMENT\n    ############################################################\n\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n\n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.3 PREP FOR PREDICTIONS ON XRF_new\n    ############################################################\n\n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    preds_df <- NULL\n\n    if (do_predictions) {\n      needed_single <- x_col\n      needed_multi  <- elements\n      if (!all(needed_single %in% names(XRF_new)) ||\n          !all(needed_multi  %in% names(XRF_new))) {\n        warning(paste(\n          \"XRF_new missing predictors for element\", el,\n          \"- skipping prediction CSV for this element.\"\n        ))\n        do_predictions <- FALSE\n      } else {\n        preds_df <- XRF_new\n      }\n    }\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 3 OF 6 u2014 Model analysis loop, diagnostics, plots, **and predictions on XRF_new**\n\n```r\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.4 MODEL ANALYSIS LOOP\n    ############################################################\n\n    pb_models <- as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        else\n          predict(m)\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n\n      if (any(is.na(pred))) next\n\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n      # Ru00b2\n      SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2)\n      SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)\n      R2     <- 1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n\n      # RMSE\n      RMSE <- sqrt(mean((y - ranking_df <- add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      global_summary <- add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2,\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\n        BIC     = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # Diagnostics\n      ############################################################\n\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      diag_df <- add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n ############################################################\n\n      if (do_predictions) {\n\n        # 1) Base predictions on log scale\n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m,
