LOAD PACKAGES\n  ############################################################\n  suppressPackageStartupMessages({\n    library(ggplot2)\n    library(dplyr)\n    library(randomForest)\n    library(pls)\n    library(arm)\n    library(ggsci)\n    library(progress)\n    library(lmtest)\n  })\n\n  dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 2. SITE FACTOR\n  ############################################################\n  if (!\"Site\" %in% names(data))\n    stop(\"Dataset must contain a 'Site' column.\")\n\n  data$Site <- factor(\n    data$Site,\n    levels = c(\"BI10\",\"HER42PB\",\"KER1\",\"KER3\",\"PB1\")\n  )\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 3. UNIVERSAL 8-POINT THEME\n  ############################################################\n  theme_small <- theme(\n    text       = element_text(size = 8),\n    axis.text  = element_text(size = 8),\n    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),\n    legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),\n    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),\n    plot.title   = element_text(size = 8, face = \"bold\")\n  )\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 4. DATA INTEGRITY CHECK\n  ############################################################\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n\n    errs <- c()\n\n    req <- c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (v in req)\n      if (!v %in% names(data))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(\"Missing:\", v))\n\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(y_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n\n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\n\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    errs\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 5. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER FUNCTION\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols_fit <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n          rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n          w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_ols)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 6. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  ############################################################\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\",\n    \"AIC/BIC reported but not used for ranking.\"\n  )\n\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 indicates non-constant variance.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE; lower indicates better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot.\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error (lower = better).\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold cross-validated predictive error (lower = better).\"\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 7. GLOBAL SUMMARY TABLE\n  ############################################################\n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 2 OF 6 u2014 Element loop, formulas, model fitting, result tables, XRF_new prep\n\n```r\n  ############################################################\n  # 8. LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\n  ############################################################\n\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    pb_elements$tick()\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      warning(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n      next\n    }\n\n    # SINGLE-PREDICTOR formula (OLS/WLS family)\n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n\n    # MULTI-PREDICTOR formula (Bayes, RF, PLS) using all elements\n    fmla_multi  <- as.formula(\n      paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \"))\n    )\n\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.1 FIT MODELS\n    ############################################################\n\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    # OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n\n    # Standard WLS (residual-based)\n    {\n      ols_fit <- model_list$OLS\n      r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n      rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n      w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_ols)\n    }\n\n    # WLS_var\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla_single, data = data,\n                               weights = 1/data[[var_col]])\n    }\n\n    # OLS_weighted & WLS_weighted (sd-based)\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n      init_sd <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n      w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2_sd)\n    }\n\n    # Bayesian regression (multivariate)\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data)\n\n    # Random Forest (multivariate)\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      ntree = 500,\n      importance = TRUE\n    )\n\n    # PLS LOOCV (multivariate)\n    pls_loo <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"LOO\"\n    )\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    # PLS k-fold (multivariate)\n    pls_k <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"CV\",\n      segments = 10\n    )\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.2 RESULT TABLES FOR THIS ELEMENT\n    ############################################################\n\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n\n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.3 PREP FOR PREDICTIONS ON XRF_new\n    ############################################################\n\n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    preds_df <- NULL\n\n    if (do_predictions) {\n      needed_single <- x_col\n      needed_multi  <- elements\n      if (!all(needed_single %in% names(XRF_new)) ||\n          !all(needed_multi  %in% names(XRF_new))) {\n        warning(paste(\n          \"XRF_new missing predictors for element\", el,\n          \"- skipping prediction CSV for this element.\"\n        ))\n        do_predictions <- FALSE\n      } else {\n        preds_df <- XRF_new   # start from original columns\n      }\n    }\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 3 OF 6 u2014 Model loop, diagnostics, plots, **log + ppm predictions**\n\n```r\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.4 MODEL ANALYSIS LOOP\n    ############################################################\n\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n\n      # Predictions on training data (log-space)\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        else\n          predict(m)\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n\n      if (any(is.na(pred))) next\n\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n      # Ru00b2\n      SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2)\n      SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)\n      R2     <- 1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n\n      # RMSE\n      RMSE <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\n\n      # RMSEP via CV\n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n                      fmla_single else fmla_multi\n\n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n\n      # AIC / BIC\n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n                   tryCatch(AIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n                   tryCatch(BIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n\n      ranking_df <- add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      global_summary <- add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2,\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\n        BIC     = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # Diagnostics\n      ############################################################\n\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- sh$statistic\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      diag_df <- add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\n        AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\n        BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # PREDICTIONS ON XRF_new (log-space + ppm)\n      ############################################################\n\n      if (do_predictions) {\n\n        # 1) Base predictions on log scale\n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = XRF_new))\n          else\n            as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = XRF_new))\n        }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new)))\n\n        lower_log <- upper_log <- pred_new_log\n\n        # 2) Approximate 95% intervals in log-space\n        if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\")) {\n\n          pi_obj <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, interval = \"prediction\", level = 0.95),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(pi_obj)) {\n            lower_log <- as.numeric(pi_obj[, \"lwr\"])\n            upper_log <- as.numeric(pi_obj[, \"upr\"])\n          } else {\n            lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n            upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n          }\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n\n          p_bayes <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, se.fit = TRUE, type = \"link\"),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(p_bayes)) {\n            fit <- as.numeric(p_bayes$fit)\n            se  <- as.numeric(p_bayes$se.fit)\n            pred_new_log <- fit\n            lower_log <- fit - 1.96 * se\n            upper_log <- fit + 1.96 * se\n          } else {\n            lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n            upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n          }\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"RF\",\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n\n          # No built-in CI: approximate using RMSE\n          lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n          upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n        }\n\n        # 3) Back-transform log u2192 ppm\n        pred_ppm  <- exp(pred_new_log)\n        lower_ppm <- exp(lower_log)\n        upper_ppm <- exp(upper_log)\n\n        # 4) Column names (log + ppm)\n        base_name <- paste(mname, el, sep = \"_\")\n\n        pred_log_col <- paste0(base_name, \"_Pred_log\")\n        lwr_log_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_L95_log\")\n        upr_log_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_U95_log\")\n\n        pred_ppm_col <- paste0(base_name, \"_Pred_ppm\")\n        lwr_ppm_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_L95_ppm\")\n        upr_ppm_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_U95_ppm\")\n\n        # 5) Attach to preds_df\n        preds_df[[pred_log_col]] <- pred_new_log\n        preds_df[[lwr_log_col]]  <- lower_log\n        preds_df[[upr_log_col]]  <- upper_log\n\n        preds_df[[pred_ppm_col]] <- pred_ppm\n        preds_df[[lwr_ppm_col]]  <- lower_ppm\n        preds_df[[upr_ppm_col]]  <- upper_ppm\n      }\n\n      ############################################################\n      # PLOT LABEL WITH R2 / RMSEP / RMSE\n      ############################################################\n      stats_label <- paste0(\n        \"Ru00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSEP = \", signif(RMSEP_val, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSE = \", signif(RMSE, 3)\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # 8-POINT PLOTS u2014 13 u00d7 9 cm\n      ############################################################\n\n      # 1) Predicted vs Observed\n      df_pred <- data.frame(\n        Observed  = y,\n        Predicted = pred,\n        Site      = data$Site\n      )\n\n      x_min_po <- min(df_pred$Observed,  na.rm = TRUE)\n      y_max_po <- max(df_pred$Predicted, na.rm = TRUE)\n\n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, color = Site)) +\n        geom_point(size = 1.25, alpha = 0.85) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco() +\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\n        annotate(\n          \"text\",\n          x = x_min_po,\n          y = y_max_po,\n          hjust = 0,\n          vjust = 1,\n          label = stats_label,\n          size = 2.7\n        ) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Predicted vs Observed\"))\n\n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n        p_po, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\n      )\n\n      # 2) Residual distribution\n      res_df <- data.frame(resid = resid_vals)\n      hist_obj <- hist(resid_vals, plot = FALSE)\n      x_min_res <- min(resid_vals, na.rm = TRUE)\n      y_max_res <- max(hist_obj$counts, na.rm = TRUE)\n\n      p_res <- ggplot(res_df, aes(resid)) +\n        geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = \"grey80\") +\n        geom_density(color = \"red\") +\n        annotate(\n          \"text\",\n          x = x_min_res,\n          y = y_max_res,\n          hjust = 0,\n          vjust = 1,\n          label = stats_label,\n          size = 2.7\n        ) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Residuals\"))\n\n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Residuals.pdf\")),\n        p_res, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\n      )\n\n      # 3) Influence plots (lm only)\n      if (inherits(m, \"lm\") && !inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n\n        cooks <- cooks.distance(m)\n        lev   <- hatvalues(m)\n        rstd  <- rstandard(m)\n\n        inf_df <- data.frame(\n          obs      = seq_along(cooks),\n          Cook     = cooks,\n          Leverage = lev,\n          StdResid = rstd\n        )\n\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Influence.pdf\")),\n            width = 13/2.54, height = 9/2.54)\n\n        print(\n          ggplot(inf_df, aes(obs, Cook)) +\n            geom_col() +\n            theme_bw() + theme_small +\n            ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Cook's Distance\"))\n        )\n\n        print(\n          ggplot(inf_df, aes(Leverage, StdResid)) +\n            geom_point(size = 1.25) +\n            theme_bw() + theme_small +\n            ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Leverage Plot\"))\n        )\n\n        dev.off()\n      }\n\n      # 4) PLS RMSEP vs Components\n      if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) {\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PLS_RMSEP.pdf\")),\n            width = 13/2.54, height = 9/2.54)\n\n        validationplot(\n          m,\n          val.type = \"RMSEP\",\n          main = paste(el, mname, \"- RMSEP vs Components\")\n        )\n\n        dev.off()\n      }\n\n    } # end model loop\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 4 OF 6 u2014 Ranking per element, diagnostics CSV, preds CSV, README\n\n```r\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.5 RANK MODELS u2014 R2 u2193 u2192 RMSEP u2191 u2192 RMSE u2191\n    ############################################################\n\n    if (nrow(ranking_df) > 0) {\n\n      ranking_df <- ranking_df %>%\n        arrange(\n          dplyr::desc(R2),\n          RMSEP,\n          RMSE\n        ) %>%\n        mutate(Rank = row_number())\n\n      ranking_expl_df <- ranking_df %>%\n        mutate(\n          Rank_explanation  = expl_rank,\n          R2_explanation    = expl_r2,\n          RMSE_explanation  = expl_rmse,\n          RMSEP_explanation = expl_rmsep\n        )\n\n      write.csv(\n        ranking_expl_df,\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_Model_Ranking.csv\")),\n        row.names = FALSE\n      )\n    }\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.6 DIAGNOSTICS SUMMARY\n    ############################################################\n\n    write.csv(\n      diag_df,\n      file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_Diagnostics_Summary.csv\")),\n      row.names = FALSE\n    )\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.7 SAVE PREDICTION CSV (LOG + PPM)\n    ############################################################\n\n    if (do_predictions && !is.null(preds_df)) {\n      preds_path <- file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_preds.csv\"))\n      write.csv(preds_df, preds_path, row.names = FALSE)\n    }\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.8 README PER ELEMENT\n    ############################################################\n\n    readme_txt <- c(\n      paste(\"Element:\", el),\n      \"\",\n      \"DATA NOTE:\",\n      \"  - Calibration responses (e.g., Ti_ICP) are natural-log transformed.\",\n      \"  - Model fitting, residuals, and statistics are computed in log-space.\",\n      \"  - In *_preds.csv files, predictions are provided both in log-space and\",\n      \"    back-transformed to ppm using the inverse natural log (exp).\",\n      \"\",\n      \"PREDICTION COLUMNS IN *_preds.csv:\",\n      \"  - Model_Element_Pred_log : predicted ln(ppm) values.\",\n      \"  - Model_Element_L95_log  : lower 95% CI in ln(ppm).\",\n      \"  - Model_Element_U95_log  : upper 95% CI in ln(ppm).\",\n      \"  - Model_Element_Pred_ppm : exp of log predictions, in ppm.\",\n      \"  - Model_Element_L95_ppm  : lower 95% CI transformed back to ppm.\",\n      \"  - Model_Element_U95_ppm  : upper 95% CI transformed back to ppm.\",\n      \"\",\n      \"RANKING RULES:\",\n      \"  1) Highest Ru00b2 ranked best.\",\n      \"  2) For similar Ru00b2, lower RMSEP ranks higher.\",\n      \"  3) For similar Ru00b2 and RMSEP, lower RMSE ranks higher.\",\n      \"  (AIC/BIC are saved but not used in the ranking itself.)\",\n      \"\",\n      \"MODELS FITTED:\",\n      \"  - OLS, WLS, WLS_var, OLS_weighted, WLS_weighted (single-predictor).\",\n      \"  - Bayes, Random Forest, PLS_LOO, PLS_kfold (multivariate).\",\n      \"\",\n      \"PLOT SETTINGS:\",\n      \"  - All plots: 8-point text, 13 cm wide u00d7 9 cm high.\",\n      \"  - Predicted vs Observed and Residual plots: annotated with Ru00b2, RMSEP, RMSE.\"\n    )\n\n    writeLines(readme_txt, file.path(element_dir, \"README.txt\"))\n\n  } # end element loop\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 5 OF 6 u2014 Global summary across elements\n\n```r\n  ############################################################\n  # 9. GLOBAL SUMMARY ACROSS ALL ELEMENTS\n  ############################################################\n\n  if (nrow(global_summary) > 0) {\n\n    global_ranked <- global_summary %>%\n      arrange(\n        Element,\n        dplyr::desc(R2),\n        RMSEP,\n        RMSE\n      ) %>%\n      group_by(Element) %>%\n      mutate(Rank = row_number()) %>%\n      ungroup()\n\n    write.csv(\n      global_ranked,\n      file.path(save_dir, summary_all_csv),\n      row.names = FALSE\n    )\n\n    best_models <- global_ranked %>%\n      filter(Rank == 1)\n\n    write.csv(\n      best_models,\n      file.path(save_dir, best_models_csv),\n      row.names = FALSE\n    )\n  }\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 6 OF 6 u2014 Finish function\n\n```r\n  ############################################################\n  # 10. ############################################################\n  # 5. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER FUNCTION\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols_fit <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n          rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n          w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_ols)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 6. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  ############################################################\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\",\n    \"AIC/BIC reported but not used for ranking.\"\n  )\n\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 indicates non-constant variance.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE; lower indicates better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot.\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold cross-validated predictive error (log-space).\"\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 7. Bayesian regression (multivariate)\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data)\n\n    # Random Forest (multivariate)\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      ntree = 500,\n      importance = TRUE\n    )\n\n    # PLS k-fold (multivariate)\n    pls_k <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"CV\",\n      segments = 10\n    )\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.2 RESULT TABLES FOR THIS ELEMENT\n    ############################################################\n\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),   # log-space\n      RMSEP = numeric(),   # log-space\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n\n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.3 PREP FOR PREDICTIONS ON XRF_new\n    ############################################################\n\n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    preds_df <- NULL\n\n    if (do_predictions) {\n      needed_single <- x_col\n      needed_multi  <- elements\n      if (!all(needed_single %in% names(XRF_new)) ||\n          !all(needed_multi  %in% names(XRF_new))) {\n        warning(paste(\n          \"XRF_new missing predictors for element\", el,\n          \"- skipping prediction CSV for this element.\"\n        ))\n        do_predictions <- FALSE\n      } else {\n        preds_df <- XRF_new   # start from original columns\n      }\n    }\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 3 OF 6 u2014 Model loop, diagnostics, plots, log + ppm predictions\n\n```r\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.4 MODEL ANALYSIS LOOP\n    ############################################################\n\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n\n      # Predictions on training data (log-space)\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        else\n          predict(m)\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n\n      if (any(is.na(pred))) next\n\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n      # Ru00b2\n      SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2)\n      SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)\n      R2     <- 1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n\n      # RMSE (log-space)\n      RMSE <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\n\n      # RMSEP via CV (log-space)\n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n                      fmla_single else fmla_multi\n\n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n\n      # AIC / BIC\n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n                   tryCatch(AIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n                   tryCatch(BIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n\n      ranking_df <- add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      global_summary <- add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2,\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\n        BIC     = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # Diagnostics\n      ############################################################\n\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- sh$statistic\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      diag_df <- add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\n        AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\n        BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # PREDICTIONS ON XRF_new (log-space + ppm)\n      ############################################################\n\n      if (do_predictions) {\n\n        # 1) Base predictions on log scale\n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = XRF_new))\n          else\n            as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = XRF_new))\n        }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new)))\n\n        lower_log <- upper_log <- pred_new_log\n\n        # 2) Approximate 95% intervals in log-space\n        if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\")) {\n\n          pi_obj <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, interval = \"prediction\", level = 0.95),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(pi_obj)) {\n            lower_log <- as.numeric(pi_obj[, \"lwr\"])\n            upper_log <- as.numeric(pi_obj[, \"upr\"])\n          } else {\n            lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n            upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n          }\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n\n          p_bayes <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, se.fit = TRUE, type = \"link\"),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(p_bayes)) {\n            fit <- as.numeric(p_bayes$fit)\n            se  <- as.numeric(p_bayes$se.fit)\n            pred_new_log <- fit\n            lower_log <- fit - 1.96 * se\n            upper_log <- fit + 1.96 * se\n          } else {\n            lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n            upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n          }\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"RF\",\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n\n          lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n          upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n        }\n\n        # 3) Back-transform log u2192 ppm\n        pred_ppm  <- exp(pred_new_log)\n        lower_ppm <- exp(lower_log)\n        upper_ppm <- exp(upper_log)\n\n        # 4) Column names (log + ppm)\n        base_name <- paste(mname, el, sep = \"_\")\n\n        pred_log_col <- paste0(base_name, \"_Pred_log\")\n        lwr_log_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_L95_log\")\n        upr_log_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_U95_log\")\n\n        pred_ppm_col <- paste0(base_name, \"_Pred_ppm\")\n        lwr_ppm_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_L95_ppm\")\n        upr_ppm_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_U95_ppm\")\n\n        preds_df[[pred_log_col]] <- pred_new_log\n        preds_df[[lwr_log_col]]  <- lower_log\n        preds_df[[upr_log_col]]  <- upper_log\n\n        preds_df[[pred_ppm_col]] <- pred_ppm\n        preds_df[[lwr_ppm_col]]  <- lower_ppm\n        preds_df[[upr_ppm_col]]  <- upper_ppm\n      }\n\n      ############################################################\n      # PLOT LABEL WITH R2 / RMSEP / RMSE\n      ############################################################\n      stats_label <- paste0(\n        \"Ru00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSEP = \", signif(RMSEP_val, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSE = \", signif(RMSE, 3)\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # 8-POINT PLOTS u2014 13 u00d7 9 cm\n      ############################################################\n\n      # 1) Predicted vs Observed\n      df_pred <- data.frame(\n        Observed  = y,\n        Predicted = pred,\n        Site      = data$Site\n      )\n\n      x_min_po <- min(df_pred$Observed,  na.rm = TRUE)\n      y_max_po <- max(df_pred$Predicted, na.rm = TRUE)\n\n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, color = Site)) +\n        geom_point(size = 1.25, alpha = 0.85) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco() +\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\n        annotate(\n          \"text\",\n          x = x_min_po,\n          y = y_max_po,\n          hjust = 0,\n          vjust = 1,\n          label = stats_label,\n          size = 2.7\n        ) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Predicted vs Observed\"))\n\n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n        p_po, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\n      )\n\n      # (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    errs\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 5. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER FUNCTION (log-space)\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols_fit <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n          rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n          w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_ols)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 6. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  ############################################################\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\",\n    \"AIC/BIC reported but not used for ranking.\"\n  )\n\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 indicates non-constant variance.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE (log-space); lower indicates better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error in log-space.\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold cross-validated error in log-space.\"\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 7. GLOBAL SUMMARY TABLE (log-space)\n  ############################################################\n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),   # log-space\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),   # log-space\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 2 OF 6 u2014 Element loop, formulas, model fitting, prediction prep\n\n```r\n  ############################################################\n  # 8. LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\n  ############################################################\n\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    pb_elements$tick()\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      warning(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n      next\n    }\n\n    # WLS_var\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla_single, data = data,\n                               weights = 1/data[[var_col]])\n    }\n\n    # OLS_weighted & WLS_weighted (sd-based)\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n      init_sd <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n      w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2_sd)\n    }\n\n    # Bayesian regression (multivariate)\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data)\n\n    # Random Forest (multivariate)\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      ntree = 500,\n      importance = TRUE\n    )\n\n    # PLS LOOCV (multivariate)\n    pls_loo <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"LOO\"\n    )\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    # 8.2 RESULT TABLES FOR THIS ELEMENT\n    ############################################################\n\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n\n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.4 MODEL ANALYSIS LOOP\n    ############################################################\n\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n\n      # Diagnostics\n      ############################################################\n\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- sh$statistic\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      diag_df <- add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\n        AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\n        BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # 2) Approximate 95% intervals in log-space\n        if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\")) {\n\n          pi_obj <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, interval = \"prediction\", level = 0.95),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(pi_obj)) {\n            lower_log <- as.numeric(pi_obj[, \"lwr\"])\n            upper_log <- as.numeric(pi_obj[, \"upr\"])\n          } else {\n            lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n            upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n          }\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n\n          p_bayes <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, se.fit = TRUE, type = \"link\"),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(p_bayes)) {\n            fit <- as.numeric(p_bayes$fit)\n            se  <- as.numeric(p_bayes$se.fit)\n            pred_new_log <- fit\n            lower_log <- fit - 1.96 * se\n            upper_log <- fit + 1.96 * se\n          } else {\n            lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n            upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n          }\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"RF\",\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n\n          # No native CI: approximate with RMSE\n          lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n          upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n        }\n\n        # 3) Back-transform log u2192 ppm\n        pred_ppm  <- exp(pred_new_log)\n        lower_ppm <- exp(lower_log)\n        upper_ppm <- exp(upper_log)\n\n        # 4) Column names, e.g. PLS_LOO_Ti_Pred_ppm\n        base_name <- paste(mname, el, sep = \"_\")\n\n        pred_ppm_col <- paste0(base_name, \"_Pred_ppm\")\n        lwr_ppm_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_L95_ppm\")\n        upr_ppm_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_U95_ppm\")\n\n        # 5) Attach to preds_df (only ppm, as requested)\n        preds_df[[pred_ppm_col]] <- pred_ppm\n        preds_df[[lwr_ppm_col]]  <- lower_ppm\n        preds_df[[upr_ppm_col]]  <- upper_ppm\n      }\n\n      ############################################################\n      # PLOT LABEL WITH R2 / RMSEP / RMSE (log-space)\n      ############################################################\n      stats_label <- paste0(\n        \"Ru00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSEP = \", signif(RMSEP_val, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSE = \", signif(RMSE, 3)\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # 8-POINT PLOTS u2014 13 u00d7 9 cm\n      ############################################################\n\n      # 1) Predicted vs Observed\n      df_pred <- data.frame(\n        Observed  = y,\n        Predicted = pred,\n        Site      = data$Site\n      )\n\n      x_min_po <- min(df_pred$Observed,  na.rm = TRUE)\n      y_max_po <- max(df_pred$Predicted, na.rm = TRUE)\n\n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, color = Site)) +\n        geom_point(size = 1.25, alpha = 0.85) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco() +\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\n        annotate(\n          \"text\",\n          x = x_min_po,\n          y = y_max_po,\n          hjust = 0,\n          vjust = 1,\n          label = stats_label,\n          size = 2.7\n        ) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Predicted vs Observed\"))\n\n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n        p_po, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\n      )\n\n      #               "Thanks for showing `str(XRF_new)` u2014 that helps a lot.\n\nYour `XRF_new` clearly *does* have all the predictor columns (`Ti, Ca, Mn, Fe, Sr, Zr`), so the reason you werenu2019t seeing `*_preds.csv` files is almost certainly the extra guard Iu2019d added that could short-circuit prediction.\n\nBelow is a **cleaned-up full function** that:\n\n- **Always** writes per-element prediction CSVs when `XRF_new` is provided.  \n- For each element (e.g. `Ti`) creates:  \n  `Ti/Ti_preds.csv` containing:\n  - All original columns from `XRF_new`  \n  - For **each model** (`OLS`, `WLS`, `WLS_var`, `OLS_weighted`, `WLS_weighted`, `Bayes`, `RF`, `PLS_LOO`, `PLS_kfold`):  \n    - `Model_Element_Pred_ppm`  \n    - `Model_Element_L95_ppm`  \n    - `Model_Element_U95_ppm`  \n    e.g. `PLS_LOO_Ti_Pred_ppm`, `PLS_LOO_Ti_L95_ppm`, `PLS_LOO_Ti_U95_ppm`\n- Assumes the response in `data` is **natural-log transformed**, and uses `exp()` to back-transform predictions to ppm.\n\nEverything else (plots, diagnostics, rankings) is left as before.\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 1 OF 6 u2014 Header, packages, theme, integrity, CV helper, explanations, global summary\n\n```r\nrun_full_regressions <- function(\n  elements,\n  data,\n  XRF_new       = NULL,  # new prediction dataset (XRF, likely log-transformed as in calibration)\n  var_suffix    = \"_var\",\n  sd_suffix     = \"_ICP_sd\",\n  save_dir      = \"/Users/sjro/Desktop/Regression_multivariate_6\",\n  summary_all_csv = \"AllElements_ModelSummary.csv\",\n  best_models_csv  = \"BestModels_PerElement.csv\"\n) {\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 1. LOAD PACKAGES\n  ############################################################\n  suppressPackageStartupMessages({\n    library(ggplot2)\n    library(dplyr)\n    library(randomForest)\n    library(pls)\n    library(arm)\n    library(ggsci)\n    library(progress)\n    library(lmtest)\n  })\n\n  dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 2. SITE FACTOR\n  ############################################################\n  if (!\"Site\" %in% names(data))\n    stop(\"Dataset must contain a 'Site' column.\")\n\n  data$Site <- factor(\n    data$Site,\n    levels = c(\"BI10\",\"HER42PB\",\"KER1\",\"KER3\",\"PB1\")\n  )\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 3. UNIVERSAL 8-POINT THEME\n  ############################################################\n  theme_small <- theme(\n    text       = element_text(size = 8),\n    axis.text  = element_text(size = 8),\n    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),\n    legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),\n    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),\n    plot.title   = element_text(size = 8, face = \"bold\")\n  )\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 4. DATA INTEGRITY CHECK\n  ############################################################\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n\n    errs <- c()\n\n    req <- c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (v in req)\n      if (!v %in% names(data))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(\"Missing:\", v))\n\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(y_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n\n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\n\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    errs\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 5. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER FUNCTION (log-space)\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols_fit <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n          rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n          w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_ols)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 6. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  ############################################################\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\",\n    \"AIC/BIC reported but not used for ranking.\"\n  )\n\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 indicates non-constant variance.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE (log-space); lower indicates better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error in log-space.\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold cross-validated error in log-space.\"\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 7. GLOBAL SUMMARY TABLE (log-space)\n  ############################################################\n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),   # log-space\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),   # log-space\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 2 OF 6 u2014 Element loop, formulas, model fitting, per-element tables, XRF_new prep\n\n```r\n  ############################################################\n  # 8. LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\n  ############################################################\n\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    pb_elements$tick()\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      warning(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n      next\n    }\n\n    # SINGLE-PREDICTOR FORMULA (OLS/WLS)\n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n\n    # MULTI-PREDICTOR FORMULA (Bayes, RF, PLS) using all elements\n    fmla_multi  <- as.formula(\n      paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \"))\n    )\n\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.1 FIT MODELS\n    ############################################################\n\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    # OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n\n    # Standard WLS (residual-based)\n    {\n      ols_fit <- model_list$OLS\n      r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n      rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n      w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_ols)\n    }\n\n    # WLS_var\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla_single, data = data,\n                               weights = 1/data[[var_col]])\n    }\n\n    # OLS_weighted & WLS_weighted (sd-based)\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n      init_sd <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n      w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2_sd)\n    }\n\n    # Bayesian regression (multivariate)\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data)\n\n    # Random Forest (multivariate)\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      ntree = 500,\n      importance = TRUE\n    )\n\n    # PLS LOOCV (multivariate)\n    pls_loo <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"LOO\"\n    )\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    # PLS k-fold (multivariate)\n    pls_k <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"CV\",\n      segments = 10\n    )\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.2 RESULT TABLES FOR THIS ELEMENT\n    ############################################################\n\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n\n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.3 PREDICTION DATAFRAME STARTS AS XRF_new\n    ############################################################\n\n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    preds_df <- NULL\n\n    if (do_predictions) {\n      preds_df <- XRF_new   # retain all original columns\n    }\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 3 OF 6 u2014 Model loop, diagnostics, **ppm predictions**, plots\n\n```r\n    ############################################################\n    # 8.4 MODEL ANALYSIS LOOP\n    ############################################################\n\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n\n      # Predictions on calibration data (log-space)\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        else\n          predict(m)\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n\n      if (any(is.na(pred))) next\n\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n      # Ru00b2\n      SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2)\n      SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)\n      R2     <- 1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n\n      # RMSE (log-space)\n      RMSE <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\n\n      # RMSEP (log-space)\n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n                      fmla_single else fmla_multi\n\n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n\n      # AIC / BIC\n      AIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n                   tryCatch(AIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n      BIC_val <- if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"glm\",\"bayesglm\")))\n                   tryCatch(BIC(m), error=function(e) NA_real_) else NA_real_\n\n      # Store in per-element ranking table\n      ranking_df <- add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      # Store in global summary\n      global_summary <- add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2,\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\n        BIC     = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # Diagnostics\n      ############################################################\n\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- sh$statistic\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      diag_df <- add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\n        AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\n        BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # PREDICTIONS ON XRF_new (log-space u2192 ppm)\n      ############################################################\n\n      if (do_predictions) {\n\n        # 1) Base predictions on log scale\n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = XRF_new))\n          else\n            as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = XRF_new))\n        }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new)))\n\n        lower_log <- upper_log <- pred_new_log\n\n        # 2) Approximate 95% intervals in log-space\n        if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\")) {\n\n          pi_obj <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, interval = \"prediction\", level = 0.95),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(pi_obj)) {\n            lower_log <- as.numeric(pi_obj[, \"lwr\"])\n            upper_log <- as.numeric(pi_obj[, \"upr\"])\n          } else {\n            lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n            upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n          }\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n\n          p_bayes <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, se.fit = TRUE, type = \"link\"),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(p_bayes)) {\n            fit <- as.numeric(p_bayes$fit)\n            se  <- as.numeric(p_bayes$se.fit)\n            pred_new_log <- fit\n            lower_log <- fit - 1.96 * se\n            upper_log <- fit + 1.96 * se\n          } else {\n            lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n            upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n          }\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"RF\",\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n\n          # No native CI: approximate with RMSE\n          lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n          upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n        }\n\n        # 3) Back-transform log u2192 ppm\n        pred_ppm  <- exp(pred_new_log)\n        lower_ppm <- exp(lower_log)\n        upper_ppm <- exp(upper_log)\n\n        # 4) Column names, e.g. PLS_LOO_Ti_Pred_ppm\n        base_name <- paste(mname, el, sep = \"_\")\n\n        pred_ppm_col <- paste0(base_name, \"_Pred_ppm\")\n        lwr_ppm_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_L95_ppm\")\n        upr_ppm_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_U95_ppm\")\n\n        # 5) Attach to preds_df (ppm-only)\n        preds_df[[pred_ppm_col]] <- pred_ppm\n        preds_df[[lwr_ppm_col]]  <- lower_ppm\n        preds_df[[upr_ppm_col]]  <- upper_ppm\n      }\n\n      ############################################################\n      # PLOT LABEL WITH R2 / RMSEP / RMSE\n      ############################################################\n      stats_label <- paste0(\n        \"Ru00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSEP = \", signif(RMSEP_val, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSE = \", signif(RMSE, 3)\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # 8-POINT PLOTS u2014 13 u00d7 9 cm\n      ############################################################\n\n      # 1) Predicted vs Observed\n      df_pred <- data.frame(\n        Observed  = y,\n        Predicted = pred,\n        Site      = data$Site\n      )\n\n      x_min_po <- min(df_pred$Observed,  na.rm = TRUE)\n      y_max_po <- max(df_pred$Predicted, na.rm = TRUE)\n\n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, color = Site)) +\n        geom_point(size = 1.25, alpha = 0.85) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco() +\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\n        annotate(\n          \"text\",\n          x = x_min_po,\n          y = y_max_po,\n          hjust = 0,\n          vjust = 1,\n          label = stats_label,\n          size = 2.7\n        ) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Predicted vs Observed\"))\n\n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n        p_po, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\n      )\n\n      # 2) Residual distribution\n      res_df <- data.frame(resid = resid_vals)\n      hist_obj <- hist(resid_vals, plot = FALSE)\n      x_min_res <- min(resid_vals, na.rm = TRUE)\n      y_max_res <- max(hist_obj$counts, na.rm = TRUE)\n\n      p_res <- ggplot(res_df, aes(resid)) +\n        geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = \"grey80\") +\n        geom_density(color = \"red\") +\n        annotate(\n          \"text\",\n          x = x_min_res,\n          y = y_max_res,\n          hjust = 0,\n          vjust = 1,\n          label = stats_label,\n          size = 2.7\n        ) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Residuals\"))\n\n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Residuals.pdf\")),\n        p_res, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\n      )\n\n      # 3) Influence plots (lm only)\n      if (inherits(m, \"lm\") && !inherits(m, \"bayesglm\")) {\n\n        cooks <- cooks.distance(m)\n        lev   <- hatvalues(m)\n        rstd  <- rstandard(m)\n\n        inf_df <- data.frame(\n          obs      = seq_along(cooks),\n          Cook     = cooks,\n          Leverage = lev,\n          StdResid = rstd\n        )\n\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Influence.pdf\")),\n            width = 13/2.54, height = 9/2.54)\n\n        print(\n          ggplot(inf_df, aes(obs, Cook)) +\n            geom_col() +\n            theme_bw() + theme_small +\n            ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Cook's Distance\"))\n        )\n\n        print(\n          ggplot(inf_df, aes(Leverage, StdResid)) +\n            geom_point(size = 1.25) +\n            theme_bw() + theme_small +\n            ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Leverage Plot\"))\n        )\n\n        dev.off()\n      }\n\n      #               "Great question u2014 **and an important one**, because the answer determines whether the function will actually generate the `*_preds.csv` prediction files.\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **Short Answer**\n**NO u2014 you should NOT set `XRF_new = XRF_new` inside the function definition.**\n\nIn R, default arguments **cannot** reference objects that exist outside the function.  \nSo writing this:\n\n```r\nrun_full_regressions <- function(XRF_new = XRF_new) { u2026 }\n```\n\nwill **always fail**, because `XRF_new` is *not defined yet inside the function environment*.\n\nR will throw:\n\n```\nError: object 'XRF_new' not found\n```\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **Correct Pattern**\nLeave the function header as:\n\n```r\nXRF_new = NULL\n```\n\nThen **supply the dataset explicitly** when you call the function:\n\n```r\nrun_full_regressions(\n  elements = c(\"Ti\",\"Ca\",\"Mn\",\"Fe\",\"Sr\",\"Zr\"),\n  data     = ACE_dataset,\n  XRF_new  = XRF_new     # <-- THIS is where you pass it!\n)\n```\n\nThis is the correct and reliable way in R.\n\n---\n\n# ud83eudde0 Why?\nBecause:\n\n1. Functions create their own environment.\n2. Default arguments are evaluated **inside that environment**, **not** in the global environment.\n3.
