c(y_col, x_col)\n    for (v in req)\n      if (!v %in% names(data))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(\"Missing:\", v))\n\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(y_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n\n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\n\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(sd_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"contains non-positive values\"))\n\n    errs\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 5. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER FUNCTION (log-space)\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols_fit <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n          rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n          w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_ols)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 6. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  ############################################################\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\",\n    \"AIC/BIC reported but not used for ranking.\"\n  )\n\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 indicates non-constant variance.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE (log-space); lower indicates better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error in log-space.\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold cross-validated error in log-space.\"\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 7. GLOBAL SUMMARY TABLE (log-space)\n  ############################################################\n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),   # log-space\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),   # log-space\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 8. STORE PER-ELEMENT PREDICTION DATA FOR SITE PLOTS\n  ############################################################\n  preds_store <- list()\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 2 OF 6 u2014 Element loop, formulas, model fitting, per-element tables, prediction DF prep\n\n```r\n  ############################################################\n  # 9. LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\n  ############################################################\n\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    pb_elements$tick()\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")\n    x_col  <- el\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    element_dir <- file.path(save_dir, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n    errors <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errors) > 0) {\n      warning(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errors, collapse = \"; \")))\n      next\n    }\n\n    # SINGLE-PREDICTOR FORMULA (OLS/WLS)\n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n\n    # MULTI-PREDICTOR FORMULA (Bayes, RF, PLS) using all elements\n    fmla_multi  <- as.formula(\n      paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \"))\n    )\n\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 9.1 FIT MODELS\n    ############################################################\n\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    # OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n\n    # Standard WLS (residual-based)\n    {\n      ols_fit <- model_list$OLS\n      r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n      rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n      w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_ols)\n    }\n\n    # WLS_var\n    if (var_col %in% names(data)) {\n      model_list$WLS_var <- lm(fmla_single, data = data,\n                               weights = 1/data[[var_col]])\n    }\n\n    # OLS_weighted & WLS_weighted (sd-based)\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n      init_sd <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n      w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2_sd)\n    }\n\n    # Bayesian regression (multivariate)\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data)\n\n    # Random Forest (multivariate)\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      ntree = 500,\n      importance = TRUE\n    )\n\n    # PLS LOOCV (multivariate)\n    pls_loo <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"LOO\"\n    )\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    # PLS k-fold (multivariate)\n    pls_k <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"CV\",\n      segments = 10\n    )\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 9.2 RESULT TABLES FOR THIS ELEMENT\n    ############################################################\n\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n\n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n\n    ############################################################\n    # 9.3 PREDICTION DATAFRAME STARTS AS XRF_new\n    ############################################################\n\n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    preds_df <- NULL\n\n    if (do_predictions) {\n      preds_df <- XRF_new   # retain all original columns (Site, depth, SH20_age, etc.)\n    }\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 3 OF 6 u2014 Model loop, diagnostics, **ppm predictions**, per-model plots\n\n```r\n    ############################################################\n    # 9.4 MODEL ANALYSIS LOOP\n    ############################################################\n\n    pb_models <- progress_bar$new(\n      format = paste0(\"  Models for \", el, \" [:bar] :current/:total (:percent)\"),\n      total  = length(model_list),\n      clear  = FALSE,\n      width  = 70\n    )\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      pb_models$tick()\n      m <- model_list[[mname]]\n\n      # Predictions on calibration data (log-space)\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = data))\n        else\n          predict(m)\n      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)\n\n      if (any(is.na(pred))) next\n\n      resid_vals <- y - pred\n\n      # Ru00b2\n      SS_res <- sum((y - pred)^2)\n      SS_tot <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)\n      R2     <- 1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n\n      # RMSE (log-space)\n      RMSE <- sqrt(mean((y - pred)^2))\n\n      # RMSEP (log-space)\n      cv_formula <- if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n                      fmla_single else fmla_multi\n\n      RMSEP_val <- tryCatch(\n        cv_rmse_for_model(\n          mname, cv_formula, data, y_col,\n          var_col, sd_col,\n          best_ncomp = if (inherits(m, \"mvr\")) attr(m, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n        ),\n        error = function(e) NA_real_\n      )\n\n      # Store in per-element ranking table\n      ranking_df <- add_row(\n        ranking_df,\n        Model = mname,\n        R2    = R2,\n        RMSE  = RMSE,\n        RMSEP = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC   = AIC_val,\n        BIC   = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      # Store in global summary\n      global_summary <- add_row(\n        global_summary,\n        Element = el,\n        Model   = mname,\n        R2      = R2,\n        RMSE    = RMSE,\n        RMSEP   = RMSEP_val,\n        AIC     = AIC_val,\n        BIC     = BIC_val\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # Diagnostics\n      ############################################################\n\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- sh$statistic\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      diag_df <- add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\n        AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\n        BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # No native CI: approximate with RMSE\n          lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n          upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n        }\n\n        # 3) Back-transform log u2192 ppm\n        pred_ppm  <- exp(pred_new_log)\n        lower_ppm <- exp(lower_log)\n        upper_ppm <- exp(upper_log)\n\n        # 4) Column names, e.g. PLS_LOO_Ti_Pred_ppm\n        base_name <- paste(mname, el, sep = \"_\")\n\n        pred_ppm_col <- paste0(base_name, \"_Pred_ppm\")\n        lwr_ppm_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_L95_ppm\")\n        upr_ppm_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_U95_ppm\")\n\n        # 5) Attach to preds_df (ppm-only)\n        preds_df[[pred_ppm_col]] <- pred_ppm\n        preds_df[[lwr_ppm_col]]  <- lower_ppm\n        preds_df[[upr_ppm_col]]  <- upper_ppm\n      }\n\n      ############################################################\n      # 8-POINT PLOTS u2014 13 u00d7 9 cm\n      ############################################################\n\n      # 1) Predicted vs Observed\n      df_pred <- data.frame(\n        Observed  = y,\n        Predicted = pred,\n        Site      = data$Site\n      )\n\n      x_min_po <- min(df_pred$Observed,  na.rm = TRUE)\n      y_max_po <- max(df_pred$Predicted, na.rm = TRUE)\n\n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, color = Site)) +\n        geom_point(size = 1.25, alpha = 0.85) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_jco() +\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\n        annotate(\n          \"text\",\n          x = x_min_po,\n          y = y_max_po,\n          hjust = 0,\n          vjust = 1,\n          label = stats_label,\n          size = 2.7\n        ) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Predicted vs Observed\"))\n\n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n        p_po, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\n      )\n\n      # 2) Residual distribution\n      res_df <- data.frame(resid = resid_vals)\n      hist_obj <- hist(resid_vals, plot = FALSE)\n      x_min_res <- min(resid_vals, na.rm = TRUE)\n      y_max_res <- max(hist_obj$counts, na.rm = TRUE)\n\n      p_res <- ggplot(res_df, aes(resid)) +\n        geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = \"grey80\") +\n        geom_density(color = \"red\") +\n        annotate(\n          \"text\",\n          x = x_min_res,\n          y = y_max_res,\n          hjust = 0,\n          vjust = 1,\n          label = stats_label,\n          size = 2.7\n        ) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Residuals\"))\n\n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_Residuals.pdf\")),\n        p_res, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\n      )\n\n      # ############################################################\n  # 5. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER FUNCTION (log-space)\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_var\" && var_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/train[[var_col]])\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols_fit <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n          rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n          w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_ols)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 6. EXPLANATION TEXT\n  ############################################################\n  expl_rank <- paste(\n    \"Ranking: Ru00b2 highest u2192 lowest; RMSEP lowest u2192 highest; RMSE lowest u2192 highest.\",\n    \"AIC/BIC reported but not used for ranking.\"\n  )\n\n  expl_shapiro <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk tests residual normality; p > 0.05 desirable.\"\n  expl_bp      <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan tests heteroscedasticity; p < 0.05 indicates non-constant variance.\"\n  expl_cv10    <- \"10-fold CV RMSE (log-space); lower indicates better predictive performance.\"\n  expl_r2      <- \"Ru00b2 = 1 u2212 SS_res/SS_tot (log-space).\"\n  expl_rmse    <- \"RMSE = calibration error in log-space.\"\n  expl_rmsep   <- \"RMSEP = 10-fold cross-validated error in log-space.\"\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 7. Diagnostics\n      ############################################################\n\n      sh_W <- sh_p <- NA_real_\n      if (length(resid_vals) >= 3 && length(resid_vals) <= 5000) {\n        sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(resid_vals), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(sh)) {\n          sh_W <- sh$statistic\n          sh_p <- sh$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      bp_stat <- bp_p <- NA_real_\n      if (inherits(m, c(\"lm\",\"bayesglm\"))) {\n        bp <- tryCatch(bptest(m), error=function(e) NULL)\n        if (!is.null(bp)) {\n          bp_stat <- bp$statistic\n          bp_p    <- bp$p.value\n        }\n      }\n\n      diag_df <- add_row(\n        diag_df,\n        Model             = mname,\n        Shapiro_W         = sh_W,\n        Shapiro_p         = sh_p,\n        Shapiro_expl      = expl_shapiro,\n        BreuschPagan_stat = bp_stat,\n        BreuschPagan_p    = bp_p,\n        BreuschPagan_expl = expl_bp,\n        CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP_val,\n        CV10_expl         = expl_cv10,\n        AIC               = AIC_val,\n        AIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\",\n        BIC               = BIC_val,\n        BIC_expl          = \"Not used for ranking.\"\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # PREDICTIONS ON XRF_new (log-space u2192 ppm)\n      ############################################################\n\n      if (do_predictions) {\n\n        # 1) Base predictions on log scale\n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(m, \"mvr\"))\n            as.numeric(predict(m, ncomp = attr(m, \"best_ncomp\"), newdata = XRF_new))\n          else\n            as.numeric(predict(m, newdata = XRF_new))\n        }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new)))\n\n        lower_log <- upper_log <- pred_new_log\n\n        # 2) Approximate 95% intervals in log-space\n        if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"WLS_var\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\")) {\n\n          pi_obj <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, interval = \"prediction\", level = 0.95),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(pi_obj)) {\n            lower_log <- as.numeric(pi_obj[, \"lwr\"])\n            upper_log <- as.numeric(pi_obj[, \"upr\"])\n          } else {\n            lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n            upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n          }\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n\n          p_bayes <- tryCatch(\n            predict(m, newdata = XRF_new, se.fit = TRUE, type = \"link\"),\n            error = function(e) NULL\n          )\n          if (!is.null(p_bayes)) {\n            fit <- as.numeric(p_bayes$fit)\n            se  <- as.numeric(p_bayes$se.fit)\n            pred_new_log <- fit\n            lower_log <- fit - 1.96 * se\n            upper_log <- fit + 1.96 * se\n          } else {\n            lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n            upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n          }\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"RF\",\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n\n          # No native CI: approximate with RMSE\n          lower_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n          upper_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n        }\n\n        # 3) Back-transform log u2192 ppm\n        pred_ppm  <- exp(pred_new_log)\n        lower_ppm <- exp(lower_log)\n        upper_ppm <- exp(upper_log)\n\n        # 4) Column names, e.g. PLS_LOO_Ti_Pred_ppm\n        base_name <- paste(mname, el, sep = \"_\")\n\n        pred_ppm_col <- paste0(base_name, \"_Pred_ppm\")\n        lwr_ppm_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_L95_ppm\")\n        upr_ppm_col  <- paste0(base_name, \"_U95_ppm\")\n\n        # 5) Attach to preds_df (ppm-only)\n        preds_df[[pred_ppm_col]] <- pred_ppm\n        preds_df[[lwr_ppm_col]]  <- lower_ppm\n        preds_df[[upr_ppm_col]]  <- upper_ppm\n      }\n\n      ############################################################\n      # PLOT LABEL WITH R2 / RMSEP / RMSE\n      ############################################################\n      stats_label <- paste0(\n        \"Ru00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSEP = \", signif(RMSEP_val, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSE = \", signif(RMSE, 3)\n      )\n\n      ############################################################\n      # 8-POINT PLOTS u2014 13 u00d7 9 cm\n      ############################################################\n\n      # 1) Predicted vs Observed\n      df_pred <- data.frame(\n        Observed  = y,\n        Predicted = pred,\n        Site      = data$Site\n      )\n\n      x_min_po <- min(df_pred$Observed,  na.rm = TRUE)\n      y_max_po <- max(df_pred$Predicted, na.rm = TRUE)\n\n      p_po <- ggplot(df_pred, aes(Observed, Predicted, color = Site)) +\n        geom_point(size = 1.25, alpha = 0.85) +\n        ggsci::scale_color_npg() +\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\n        annotate(\n          \"text\",\n          x = x_min_po,\n          y = y_max_po,\n          hjust = 0,\n          vjust = 1,\n          label = stats_label,\n          size = 2.7\n        ) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, mname, \"- Predicted vs Observed\"))\n\n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", mname, \"_PredVsObs.pdf\")),\n        p_po, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\n      )\n\n      # end model loop\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 4 OF 6 u2014 Ranking, diagnostics, write `<el>_preds.csv`, store preds, per-element README\n\n```r\n    ############################################################\n    # ############################################################\n  # 6. 10-FOLD CV RMSE HELPER FUNCTION (log-space)\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 7. if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\n\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(y_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n      if FUNCTION (log-space)\n  ############################################################\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols_fit <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n          rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n          w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_ols)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          predict(fit, newdata = test)\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ############################################################\n  # 7.   model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data)\n\n    # Random Forest (multivariate)\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      ntree  ############################################################\n    # 10.3 PREDICTION DATAFRAME STARTS AS XRF_new\n    ############################################################\n\n    do_predictions Models and colours ----\n  model_levels <- c(\n    \"OLS\",\"WLS\",\n    \"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\",\n    \"Bayes\",\"RF\",\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\"\n  )\n\n  model_labels <- c(\n    \"OLS\",\"WLS\",\n    \"OLS(wt)\",\"WLS(wt)\",\n    \"Bayes\",\"RF\",\"PLS(LOO)\",\"PLS(k)\"\n  )\n\n  cols_models <- ggsci::pal_npg(\"nrc\")(length(model_labels))\n  names(cols_models) <- model_labels\n\n  # PLS(k) is salmon3\n  cols_models[\"PLS(k)\"] <- \"salmon3\"\n\n  # Add ICP-MS (Observed) in blue\n  cols_all <- c(cols_models, \"ICP-MS (Observed)\" = \"blue\")\n\n  ## 6. Integrity check ----\n  check_dataset_integrity <- function(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col) {\n    errs <- c()\n    req <- c(y_col, x_col)\n\n    for (v in req)\n      if (!v %in% names(data)) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"Missing:\", v))\n\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[y_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(y_col, \"not numeric\"))\n    if (!is.numeric(data[[x_col]])) errs <- c(errs, paste(x_col, \"not numeric\"))\n\n    if (any(is.na(data[[y_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", y_col))\n    if (any(is.na(data[[x_col]]))) errs <- c(errs, paste(\"NA in\", x_col))\n\n    if (var(data[[x_col]], na.rm = TRUE) == 0)\n      errs <- c(errs, \"Predictor has zero variance\")\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[sd_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(sd_col, \"has non-positive values\"))\n\n    if (var_col %in% names(data))\n      if (any(data[[var_col]] <= 0, na.rm = TRUE))\n        errs <- c(errs, paste(var_col, \"has non-positive values\"))\n\n    errs\n  }\n\n  ## 7. 10-fold CV RMSE helper ----\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA,\n    k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    cv_sse <- 0\n    cv_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          init_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2))\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w2_sd)\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          ols_fit <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          r_ols <- residuals(ols_fit)\n          rm_ols <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n          w_ols <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_ols)\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data = train)\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data = train, ntree = 300)\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE, validation = \"none\")\n        } else NULL\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = test))\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      cv_sse <- cv_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      cv_n   <- cv_n + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (cv_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(cv_sse / cv_n)\n  }\n\n  ## 8. Global summary table (log-space) ----\n  global_summary <- tibble(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric()\n  )\n\n  ## 9. Storage for per-element prediction data ----\n  preds_store <- list()\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 2/4 u2014 Element loop: fit models, diagnostics, predictions, per-element outputs\n\n```r\n  ############################################################\n  # 10. LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\n  ############################################################\n\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing Elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    pb_elements$tick()\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")         # ln(mg kg^-1)\n    x_col  <- el                         # predictor (ln XRF)\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    element_dir <- file.path(all_base, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n    errs <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errs) > 0) {\n      warning(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errs, collapse = \"; \")))\n      next\n    }\n\n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    fmla_multi  <- as.formula(\n      paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse = \" + \"))\n    )\n\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    ## 10.1 Fit models ----\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data)\n\n    {\n      ols_fit <- model_list$OLS\n      r_ols   <- residuals(ols_fit)\n      rm_ols  <- lm(abs(r_ols) ~ fitted(ols_fit))\n      w_ols   <- 1/(rm_ols$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_ols)\n    }\n\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n\n      init_sd <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w_sd)\n      rm_sd   <- lm(abs(init_sd$residuals) ~ init_sd$fitted.values)\n      w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data = data, weights = w2_sd)\n    }\n\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data)\n\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      ntree = 500,\n      importance = TRUE\n    )\n\n    pls_loo <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"LOO\"\n    )\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    pls_k <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      scale = TRUE,\n      validation = \"CV\",\n      segments = 10\n    )\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method = \"onesigma\", plot = FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    ## 10.2 Tables for this element ----\n    ranking_df <- tibble(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric()\n    )\n\n    diag_df <- tibble(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character()\n    )\n\n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    preds_df <- if (do_predictions) XRF_new else NULL\n\n    ## 10.3 Model evaluation loop ----\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      fit <- model_list[[mname]]\n      if (is.null(fit)) next\n\n      pred_fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\")) {\n          ncomp <- attr(fit, \"best_ncomp\")\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = ncomp, newdata = data))\n        } else {\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = data))\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n\n      ok <- !is.na(pred_fit) & !is.na(y)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      SS_res <- sum((y[ok] - pred_fit[ok])^2)\n      SS_tot <- sum((y[ok] - mean(y[ok]))^2)\n      R2     <- 1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n      RMSE   <- sqrt(mean((y[ok] - pred_fit[ok])^2))\n\n      best_ncomp <- if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\")) attr(fit,\"best_ncomp\") else NA\n      RMSEP10 <- cv_rmse_for_model(\n        mname     = mname,\n        formula   = if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n                      fmla_single else fmla_multi,\n        data      = data,\n        y_col     = y_col,\n        var_col   = var_col,\n        sd_col    = sd_col,\n        best_ncomp= best_ncomp,\n        k         = 10\n      )\n\n      if (mname %in% c(\"RF\",\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n        AICv <- NA_real_; BICv <- NA_real_\n      } else {\n        AICv <- tryCatch(AIC(fit), error=function(e) NA_real_)\n        BICv <- tryCatch(BIC(fit), error=function(e) NA_real_)\n      }\n\n      sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(residuals(fit)), error=function(e) NULL)\n      if (is.null(sh)) {\n        ShW <- NA_real_; Shp <- NA_real_\n        Shexpl <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk not applicable.\"\n      } else {\n        ShW <- unname(sh$statistic); Shp <- sh$p.value\n        Shexpl <- if (Shp < 0.05) \"Residuals deviate from normality.\"\n                  else \"Residuals approx. normal.\"\n      }\n\n      bp <- tryCatch(bptest(fit), error=function(e) NULL)\n      if (is.null(bp)) {\n        BPstat <- NA_real_; BPp <- NA_real_\n        BPexpl <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan not applicable.\"\n      } else {\n        BPstat <- unname(bp$statistic); BPp <- bp$p.value\n        BPexpl <- if (BPp < 0.05) \"Heteroscedastic residuals.\"\n                  else \"No strong evidence of heteroscedasticity.\"\n      }\n\n      CVexpl  <- if (is.na(RMSEP10)) \"10-fold CV RMSE not available.\"\n                 else \"10-fold CV RMSE computed.\"\n      AICexpl <- if (is.na(AICv)) \"AIC not available for this model.\"\n                 else \"AIC computed.\"\n      BICexpl <- if (is.na(BICv)) \"BIC not available for this model.\"\n                 else \"BIC computed.\"\n\n      diag_df <- diag_df %>%\n        add_row(\n          Model             = mname,\n          Shapiro_W         = ShW,\n          Shapiro_p         = Shp,\n          Shapiro_expl      = Shexpl,\n          BreuschPagan_stat = BPstat,\n          BreuschPagan_p    = BPp,\n          BreuschPagan_expl = BPexpl,\n          CV10_RMSE         = BICexpl\n        )\n\n      runlab <- dplyr::recode(\n        mname,\n        OLS         = \"OLS\",\n        WLS         = \"WLS\",\n        OLS_weighted= \"OLS(wt)\",\n        WLS_weighted= \"WLS(wt)\",\n        Bayes       = \"Bayes\",\n        RF          = \"RF\",\n        PLS_LOO     = \"PLS(LOO)\",\n        PLS_kfold   = \"PLS(k)\"\n      )\n\n      ranking_df <- ranking_df %>%\n        add_row(\n          Model = runlab,\n          R2    = R2,\n          RMSE  = RMSE,\n          RMSEP = RMSEP10,\n          AIC   = AICv,\n          BIC   = BICv\n        )\n\n      ## 10.4 Predictions for XRF_new (ppm) ----\n      if (do_predictions) {\n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(fit,\"mvr\")) {\n            ncomp <- attr(fit, \"best_ncomp\")\n            as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = ncomp, newdata = XRF_new))\n          } else {\n            as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = XRF_new))\n          }\n        }, error=function(e) rep(NA_real_, upr_ppm  <- exp(upr_log)\n\n        cname_pred <- paste0(runlab, \"_\", el, \"_Pred_ppm\")\n        cname_lwr  <- paste0(runlab, \"_\", el, \"_L95_ppm\")\n        cname_upr  <- paste0(runlab, \"_\",   p_res <- ggplot(res_df, aes(resid)) +\n        geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = \"grey80\") +\n        geom_density(colour = \"blue\") +\n        annotate(\n          \"text\",\n          x = Bayesian GLM (multivariate)\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data = data)\n\n    # Random Forest (multivariate)\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\n      fmla_multi,\n      data = data,\n      ntree = 500,\n      importance = TRUE\n    )\n\n    # 11.2 PER-ELEMENT TABLES\n    ##########################################################\n\n    ranking_df <- data.frame(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric(),\n      stringsAsFactors = FALSE\n    )\n\n    diag_df <- data.frame(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character(),\n      stringsAsFactors  = FALSE\n    )\n\n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    if (do_predictions) {\n      preds_df <- XRF_new   # retains original columns\n    } else {\n      preds_df <- NULL\n    }\n\n    ##########################################################\n    # 11.3 MODEL LOOP\n    ##########################################################\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      fit <- model_list[[mname]]\n      if (is.null(fit)) next\n\n      # predictions in log-space on calibration data\n      pred_log <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\")) {\n          ncomp <- attr(fit, \"best_ncomp\")\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = ncomp, newdata = data))\n        } else {\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = data))\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n\n      ok <- !is.na(pred_log) & !is.na(y)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      SS_res <- sum((y[ok] - pred_log[ok])^2)\n      SS_tot <- sum((y[ok] - mean(y[ok]))^2)\n      R2     <- 1 - SS_res / SS_tot\n      RMSE   <- sqrt(mean((y[ok] - pred_log[ok])^2))\n\n      best_ncomp <- if (inherits(fit,\"mvr\")) attr(fit, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n\n      RMSEP10 <- cv_rmse_for_model(\n        mname      = mname,\n        formula    = if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n                       fmla_single else fmla_multi,\n        data       = data,\n        y_col      = y_col,\n        var_col    = var_col,\n        sd_col     = sd_col,\n        best_ncomp = best_ncomp,\n        k          = 10\n      )\n\n      # Shapirou2013Wilk\n      sh <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(residuals(fit)), error=function(e) NULL)\n      if (is.null(sh)) {\n        ShW <- NA_real_; Shp <- NA_real_\n        Sh_expl <- \"Shapirou2013Wilk not applicable.\"\n      } else {\n        ShW <- as.numeric(sh$statistic); Shp <- sh$p.value\n        Sh_expl <- if (Shp < 0.05) \"Residuals deviate from normality.\"\n                   else \"Residuals approx. normal.\"\n      }\n\n      # Breuschu2013Pagan\n      bp <- tryCatch(bptest(fit), error=function(e) NULL)\n      if (is.null(bp)) {\n        BPstat <- NA_real_; BPp <- NA_real_\n        BP_expl <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan not applicable.\"\n      } else {\n        BPstat <- as.numeric(bp$statistic); BPp <- bp$p.value\n        BP_expl <- if (BPp < 0.05) \"Heteroscedastic residuals.\"\n                   else \"No strong evidence of heteroscedasticity.\"\n      }\n\n      CV_expl  <- if (is.na(RMSEP10)) \"10-fold CV RMSE not available.\"\n                  else \"10-fold CV RMSE computed.\"\n\n      AIC_expl <- if (is.na(AICv)) \"AIC not available for this model.\"\n                  else \"AIC computed.\"\n      BIC_expl <- if (is.na(BICv)) \"BIC not available for this model.\"\n                  else \"BIC computed.\"\n\n      diag_df <- rbind(\n        diag_df,\n        data.frame(\n          Model             = mname,\n          Shapiro_W         = ShW,\n          Shapiro_p         = Shp,\n          Shapiro_expl      = Sh_expl,\n          BreuschPagan_stat = BPstat,\n          BreuschPagan_p    = BPp,\n          BreuschPagan_expl = BP_expl,\n          CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP10,\n          CV10_expl         = CV_expl,\n          AIC               = AICv,\n          AIC_expl          = AIC_expl,\n          BIC               = BICv,\n          BIC_expl          = BIC_expl,\n          stringsAsFactors  = FALSE\n        )\n      )\n\n      # 11.4 PREDICTIONS FOR XRF_new IN ppm\n      ########################################################\n\n      if (do_predictions) {\n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(fit,\"mvr\")) {\n            ncomp <- attr(fit, \"best_ncomp\")\n            as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = ncomp, newdata = XRF_new))\n          } else {\n            as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = XRF_new))\n          }\n        }, error=function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(XRF_new)))\n\n        lwr_log <- pred_new_log - 1.96 * RMSE\n        upr_log <- pred_new_log + 1.96 * RMSE\n\n        pred_ppm <- exp(pred_new_log)\n        lwr_ppm  <- exp(lwr_log)\n        upr_ppm  <- exp(upr_log)\n\n        cname_pred <- paste0(runlab, \"_\", el, \"_Pred_ppm\")\n        cname_lwr  <- paste0(runlab, \"_\", el, \"_L95_ppm\")\n        cname_upr  <- paste0(runlab, \"_\", el, \"_U95_ppm\")\n\n        preds_df[[cname_pred]] <- pred_ppm\n        preds_df[[cname_lwr]]  <- lwr_ppm\n        preds_df[[cname_upr]]  <- upr_ppm\n      }\n\n      ########################################################\n      # 11.5 BASIC MODEL PLOTS (log-space)\n      ########################################################\n\n      stats_label <- paste0(\n        \"Ru00b2 = \", signif(R2, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSEP = \", signif(RMSEP10, 3),\n        \"\\nRMSE = \", signif(RMSE, 3)\n      )\n\n      # Predicted vs observed (log-log)\n      df_po <- data.frame(Observed = y, Predicted = pred_log)\n      x_min_po <- min(df_po$Observed,  na.rm = TRUE)\n      y_max_po <- max(df_po$Predicted, na.rm = TRUE)\n\n      p_po <- ggplot(df_po, aes(Observed, Predicted)) +\n        geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.85) +\n        geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +\n        annotate(\n          \"text\",\n          x = x_min_po, y = y_max_po,\n          hjust = 0, vjust = 1,\n          label = stats_label,\n          size = 2.7\n        ) +\n        theme_bw() + theme_small +\n        ggtitle(paste(el, \"-\", runlab, \"Predicted vs Observed (log-space)\"))\n\n      ggsave(\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", runlab, \"_PredVsObs_log.pdf\")),\n        p_po, width = 13, height = 9, units = \"cm\"\n      )\n\n      # Residual\"))\n\n        pdf(file.path(infl_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", runlab, \"_Influence.pdf\")),\n            width = 13/2.54, height = 9/2.54)\n        print(p_cook)\n        print(p_lev)\n        dev.off()\n      }\n\n      # PLS RMSEP vs components\n      if (inherits(fit,\"mvr\")) {\n        pdf(file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_\", runlab, \"_PLS_RMSEP.pdf\")),\n            width = 13/2.54, height = 9/2.54)\n        validationplot(\n          fit,\n          val.type = \"RMSEP\",\n          main = paste(el, \"-\", runlab, \"RMSEP vs components\")\n        )\n        dev.off()\n      }\n\n    } # end model loop\n```\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd39 CHUNK 3 / 6 u2014 Ranking per element, diagnostics CSV, ppm conversion, global summary update\n\n```r\n    ##########################################################\n    # 11.6 RANK MODELS (per element) & SAVE SUMMARY\n    ##########################################################\n\n    if (nrow(ranking_df) > 0) {\n      # Rank: R2 descending, RMSE ascending, RMSEP ascending\n      ranking_df <- ranking_df[order(-ranking_df$R2,\n                                     ranking_df$RMSE,\n                                     ranking_df$RMSEP), ]\n      ranking_df$Rank <- seq_len(nrow(ranking_df))\n\n      write.csv(\n        ranking_df,\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_Model_Ranking.csv\")),\n        row.names = FALSE\n      )\n\n      # 11.7 SAVE DIAGNOSTICS SUMMARY\n    ##########################################################\n\n    if (nrow(diag_df) > 0) {\n      write.csv(\n        diag_df,\n        file.path(element_dir, paste0(el, \"_Diagnostics_Summary.csv\")),\n        row.names = FALSE\n      )\n    }\n\n    ##########################################################\n    #     } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data=train, scale=TRUE)\n\n        } else NULL\n      }, error=function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit))               "Here is **CHUNK 2 of 6** u2014 this block handles:\n\n### u2705 Element loop  \n### u2705 Fitting all 8 models (OLS, WLS, weighted variants, Bayes, RF, PLS-LOO, PLS-kfold)  \n### u2705 Calculating Ru00b2, RMSE, RMSEP (10-fold CV)  \n### u2705 AIC/BIC where applicable  \n### u2705 Shapirou2013Wilk & Breuschu2013Pagan diagnostics  \n### u2705 Predictions for XRF_new (back-transformed to ppm)  \n### u2705 Per-model residual + predicted-vs-observed plots  \n### u2705 Influence plots for lm-type models  \n\n---\n\n# ud83dudd39 **CHUNK 2 of 6 u2014 Model fitting, diagnostics, predictions, influence plots**\n\n```r\n  ############################################################\n  ## 11. LOOP OVER ELEMENTS\n  ############################################################\n\n  pb_elements <- progress_bar$new(\n    format = \"Processing elements [:bar] :current/:total (:percent) eta::eta\",\n    total  = length(elements),\n    clear  = FALSE,\n    width  = 80\n  )\n\n  for (el in elements) {\n\n    pb_elements$tick()\n\n    y_col  <- paste0(el, \"_ICP\")       # ln(mg/kg) ICP-MS\n    x_col  <- el                       # ln(XRF)\n    var_col <- paste0(el, var_suffix)\n    sd_col  <- paste0(el, sd_suffix)\n\n    element_dir <- file.path(all_base, el)\n    dir.create(element_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)\n\n    ## Check dataset integrity\n    errs <- check_dataset_integrity(data, el, y_col, x_col, var_col, sd_col)\n    if (length(errs) > 0) {\n      warning(paste(\"Skipping\", el, \":\", paste(errs, collapse=\"; \")))\n      next\n    }\n\n    ## Model formulae\n    fmla_single <- as.formula(paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", x_col))\n    fmla_multi  <- as.formula(\n      paste0(y_col, \" ~ \", paste(elements, collapse=\" + \"))\n    )\n\n    y <- data[[y_col]]\n\n    ############################################################\n    ## 11.1 FIT ALL MODELS\n    ############################################################\n\n    model_list <- list()\n\n    ## OLS\n    model_list$OLS <- lm(fmla_single, data=data)\n\n    ## WLS (residual-model-based)\n    {\n      base <- model_list$OLS\n      r    <- residuals(base)\n      rm   <- lm(abs(r) ~ fitted(base))\n      w    <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS <- lm(fmla_single, data=data, weights=w)\n    }\n\n    ## Weighted OLS and WLS if sd column exists\n    if (sd_col %in% names(data)) {\n\n      w_sd <- 1/(data[[sd_col]]^2)\n\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data=data, weights=w_sd)\n\n      base_sd <- lm(fmla_single, data=data, weights=w_sd)\n      rm_sd   <- lm(abs(base_sd$residuals) ~ base_sd$fitted.values)\n      w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- lm(fmla_single, data=data, weights=w2_sd)\n\n    } else {\n      model_list$OLS_weighted <- NULL\n      model_list$WLS_weighted <- NULL\n    }\n\n    ## Bayesian (multivariate)\n    model_list$Bayes <- bayesglm(fmla_multi, data=data)\n\n    ## Random Forest (multivariate)\n    set.seed(42)\n    model_list$RF <- randomForest(\n      fmla_multi, data=data,\n      ntree=500, importance=TRUE\n    )\n\n    ## PLS with LOOCV\n    pls_loo <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi, data=data,\n      scale=TRUE, validation=\"LOO\"\n    )\n    best_loo <- selectNcomp(pls_loo, method=\"onesigma\", plot=FALSE)\n    attr(pls_loo, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_loo\n    model_list$PLS_LOO <- pls_loo\n\n    ## PLS with 10-fold CV\n    pls_k <- plsr(\n      fmla_multi, data=data,\n      scale=TRUE,\n      validation=\"CV\", segments=10\n    )\n    best_k <- selectNcomp(pls_k, method=\"onesigma\", plot=FALSE)\n    attr(pls_k, \"best_ncomp\") <- best_k\n    model_list$PLS_kfold <- pls_k\n\n    ############################################################\n    ## 11.2 ELEMENT-LEVEL TABLE INITIALISATION\n    ############################################################\n\n    ranking_df <- data.frame(\n      Model = character(),\n      R2    = numeric(),\n      RMSE  = numeric(),\n      RMSEP = numeric(),\n      AIC   = numeric(),\n      BIC   = numeric(),\n      stringsAsFactors = FALSE\n    )\n\n    diag_df <- data.frame(\n      Model             = character(),\n      Shapiro_W         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_p         = numeric(),\n      Shapiro_expl      = character(),\n      BreuschPagan_stat = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_p    = numeric(),\n      BreuschPagan_expl = character(),\n      CV10_RMSE         = numeric(),\n      CV10_expl         = character(),\n      AIC               = numeric(),\n      AIC_expl          = character(),\n      BIC               = numeric(),\n      BIC_expl          = character(),\n      stringsAsFactors  = FALSE\n    )\n\n    do_predictions <- !is.null(XRF_new)\n    if (do_predictions) {\n      preds_df <- XRF_new\n    } else {\n      preds_df <- NULL\n    }\n\n    ############################################################\n    ## 11.3 MODEL LOOP u2014 METRICS + DIAGNOSTICS + PREDICTIONS\n    ############################################################\n\n    for (mname in names(model_list)) {\n\n      fit <- model_list[[mname]]\n      if (is.null(fit)) next\n\n      ## Predictions in log-space\n      pred_log <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\")) {\n          ncomp <- attr(fit, \"best_ncomp\")\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp=ncomp, newdata=data))\n        } else {\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata=data))\n        }\n      }, error=function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n\n      ok <- !is.na(pred_log) & !is.na(y)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      ## MODEL METRICS\n      SS_res <- sum((y[ok] - pred_log[ok])^2)\n      SS_tot <- sum((y[ok] - mean(y[ok]))^2)\n      R2     <- 1 - SS_res/SS_tot\n      RMSE   <- sqrt(mean((y[ok] - pred_log[ok])^2))\n\n      best_ncomp <- if (inherits(fit,\"mvr\")) attr(fit, \"best_ncomp\") else NA\n\n      RMSEP10 <- cv_rmse_for_model(\n        mname      = mname,\n        formula    = if (mname %in% c(\"OLS\",\"WLS\",\"OLS_weighted\",\"WLS_weighted\"))\n                        fmla_single else fmla_multi,\n        data       = data,\n        y_col      = y_col,\n        var_col    = var_col,\n        sd_col     = sd_col,\n        best_ncomp = best_ncomp,\n        k          = 10\n      )\n\n      ## Add to diagnostic table\n      diag_df <- rbind(\n        diag_df,\n        data.frame(\n          Model             = mname,\n          Shapiro_W         = ShW,\n          Shapiro_p         = Shp,\n          Shapiro_expl      = Sh_expl,\n          BreuschPagan_stat = BPstat,\n          BreuschPagan_p    = BPp,\n          BreuschPagan_expl = BP_expl,\n          CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP10,\n          CV10_expl         = CV_expl,\n          AIC               = AICv,\n          AIC_expl          = AIC_expl,\n          BIC               = BICv,\n          BIC_expl          = BIC_expl,\n          stringsAsFactors  = FALSE\n        )\n      )\n\n      ## ============================================================\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA, k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out=n))\n    total_sse <- 0\n    total_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data=train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          base <- lm(formula, data=train)\n          r    <- residuals(base)\n          rm   <- lm(abs(r) ~ fitted(base))\n          w    <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data=train, weights=w)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          w_sd <- 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2)\n          lm(formula, data=train, weights=w_sd)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          w_sd <- 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2)\n          base_sd <- lm(formula, data=train, weights=w_sd)\n          rm_sd   <- lm(abs(base_sd$residuals) ~ base_sd$fitted.values)\n          w2_sd   <- 1/(rm_sd$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data=train, weights=w2_sd)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"Bayes\") {\n          bayesglm(formula, data=train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"RF\") {\n          randomForest(formula, data=train, ntree=300)\n\n        } else if (mname %in% c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data=train, scale=TRUE)\n\n        } else NULL\n\n      }, error=function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit,\"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp=best_ncomp, newdata=test))\n        else\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata=test))\n      }, error=function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      total_sse <-  }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      total_sse <- total_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      total_n   <- total_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (total_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(total_sse / total_n)\n  }\n\n  # 8. 10-fold CV RMSE helper ----\n  cv_rmse_for_model <- function(\n    mname, formula, data, y_col,\n    var_col, sd_col, best_ncomp = NA, k = 10\n  ) {\n\n    set.seed(123)\n    n <- nrow(data)\n    if (n < k) return(NA_real_)\n\n    folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))\n    total_sse <- 0\n    total_n   <- 0\n\n    for (fold in 1:k) {\n\n      train <- data[folds != fold, , drop = FALSE]\n      test  <- data[folds == fold, , drop = FALSE]\n\n      fit <- tryCatch({\n        if (mname == \"OLS\") {\n          lm(formula, data = train)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS\") {\n          base <- lm(formula, data = train)\n          r    <- residuals(base)\n          rm   <- lm(abs(r) ~ fitted(base))\n          w    <- 1/(rm$fitted.values^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"OLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          w_sd <- 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2)\n          lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_sd)\n\n        } else if (mname == \"WLS_weighted\" && sd_col %in% names(train)) {\n          w_sd <- 1/(train[[sd_col]]^2)\n          base_sd <- lm(formula, data = train, weights = w_sd)\n          rm_sd   <- c(\"PLS_LOO\",\"PLS_kfold\")) {\n          plsr(formula, data = train, scale = TRUE)\n\n        } else NULL\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      pred <- tryCatch({\n        if (inherits(fit, \"mvr\"))\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = best_ncomp, newdata = test))\n        else\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = test))\n      }, error = function(e) NULL)\n\n      if (is.null(pred)) return(NA_real_)\n\n      y_test <- test[[y_col]]\n      ok <- !is.na(y_test) & !is.na(pred)\n      if (!any(ok)) next\n\n      total_sse <- total_sse + sum((y_test[ok] - pred[ok])^2)\n      total_n   <- total_n   + sum(ok)\n    }\n\n    if (total_n == 0) return(NA_real_)\n    sqrt(total_sse / total_n)\n  }\n\n  ## 9. Global summary (log-space) ----\n  global_summary <- data.frame(\n    Element = character(),\n    Model   = character(),\n    R2      = numeric(),\n    RMSE    = numeric(),\n    RMSEP   = numeric(),\n    AIC     = numeric(),\n    BIC     = numeric(),\n    stringsAsFactors = FALSE\n  )\n\n  preds_store <- list()\n\n  ## 10. as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = ncomp, newdata = data))\n        } else {\n          as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = data))\n        }\n      }, error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))\n\n    }\n\n      CV_expl  <- if (is.na(RMSEP10)) \"10-fold CV not available.\" else \"10-fold CV computed.\"\n      AIC_expl <- if (is.na(AICv))    \"AIC not available.\"       else \"AIC computed.\"\n      BIC_expl <- if (is.na(BICv))    \"BIC not available.\"       else \"BIC computed.\"\n\n      diag_df <- rbind(\n        diag_df,\n        data.frame(\n          Model             = mname,\n function(e) NULL)\n      if (is.null(bp)) {\n        BPstat <- NA_real_; BPp <- NA_real_\n        BP_expl <- \"Breuschu2013Pagan not applicable.\"\n      } else {\n        BPstat <- as.numeric(bp$statistic)\n        BPp    <- bp$p.value\n        BP_expl <- if (BPp < 0.05)\n          \"Heteroscedastic residuals.\"\n        else\n          \"No evidence of heteroscedasticity.\"\n      }\n\n      CV_expl  <- if (is.na(RMSEP10)) \"10-fold CV not available.\" else \"10-fold CV computed.\"\n      AIC_expl <- if (is.na(AICv))    \"AIC not available.\"       else \"AIC computed.\"\n      BIC_expl <- if (is.na(BICv))    \"BIC not available.\"       else \"BIC computed.\"\n\n      diag_df <- rbind(\n        diag_df,\n        data.frame(\n          Model             = mname,\n          Shapiro_W         = ShW,\n          Shapiro_p         = Shp,\n          Shapiro_expl      = Sh_expl,\n          BreuschPagan_stat = BPstat,\n          BreuschPagan_p    = BPp,\n          BreuschPagan_expl = BP_expl,\n          CV10_RMSE         = RMSEP10,\n          CV10_expl         = CV_expl,\n          AIC               = AICv,\n          AIC_expl          = AIC_expl,\n          BIC               = BICv,\n          BIC_expl          = BIC_expl,\n          stringsAsFactors  = FALSE\n        )\n      )\n\n      runlab <- dplyr::recode(\n        mname,\n        OLS         = (do_predictions) {\n        pred_new_log <- tryCatch({\n          if (inherits(fit,\"mvr\")) {\n            ncomp <- attr(fit,\"best_ncomp\")\n            as.numeric(predict(fit, ncomp = ncomp,               "In **ggplot2**, to get **circles with a blue outline *and* a filled interior**, you need a point shape that supports both `colour` (outline) and `fill`. Those are **shapes 21u201325**.\n\n### u2705 Correct approach: use `shape = 21`\n\nHereu2019s your modified `geom_point()`:\n\n```r\ngeom_point(\n  data = ace_overlay,\n  aes(x = ICP_ppm, y = depth),\n  shape = 21,                # circle with outline + fill\n  size = 1.5,\n  colour = \"blue\",           # outline color\n  fill = \"blue\",             # fill color\n  inherit.aes = FALSE\n)\n```\n\n### If you still want it tied to the legend label\nIf `\"ICP-MS (Observed)\"` is part of a color legend, do this instead:\n\n```r\ngeom_point(\n  data = ace_overlay,\n  aes(x = ICP_ppm, y = depth, colour = \"ICP-MS (Observed)\", fill = \"ICP-MS (Observed)\"),\n  shape = 21,\n  size = 1.5,\n  inherit.aes = FALSE\n)\n```\n\nAnd make sure your scales match:\n\n```r\nscale_colour_manual(\n  values = c(\"ICP-MS (Observed)\" = \"blue\")\n) +\nscale_fill_manual(\n  values = c(\"ICP-MS (Observed)\" = \"blue\")\n)\n```\n\n### u2139ufe0f Why this works\n- Shapes like **16** ignore `fill`\n- **Shape 21** allows:\n  - `colour` u2192 outline\n  - `fill` u2192 interior\n\nIf you want **blue outline with white fill** (often clearer for dense plots), just change:\n\n```r\nfill = \"white\"\n```\n\nIf you want, tell me whether this plot is depth-inverted (typical for cores) and I can tweak it further."

              "There are a few issues with your expression that commonly break this type of zero-replacement pattern in **dplyr**. Hereu2019s whatu2019s likely going wrong and how to fix it.\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **The Core Problem**\nThis part is problematic:\n\n```r\n(. == 0) * min(.[. != 0])/2 + .\n```\n\n### Why?\n\n1. **`. == 0` returns a logical vector**, but multiplying logicals and numerics inside `mutate_at()` *does* worku2014but **only if `min(.[. != 0])` returns a single numeric value**.\n\n2. **If an entire column is zero**, then  \n   ```r\n   min(.[. != 0])\n   ```  \n   tries to compute `min(numeric(0))`, which gives **Inf**, causing unexpected behavior or errors.\n\n3. **`mutate_at()` is deprecated**, and it sometimes behaves unpredictably with `all_of()` and complex expressions.\n\n4. The expression mixes logical and numeric vectors in a way that can become unclear.\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **Correct and Safe Replacement Pattern**\nUse `if_else()` + `min()` inside `across()` so each column is handled independently and safely:\n\n```r\nPB1_Subsample_xrf_matched <- PB1_Subsample_xrf_matched0 %>%\n  mutate(across(\n    all_of(c(acf_icp_Elements_min, acf_icp_Elements_min_sd)),\n    ~ if_else(. == 0,\n              min(.[. != 0], na.rm = TRUE) / 2,\n              .\n    )\n  ))\n```\n\n---\n\n# u2705 **This fixes:**\n### u2714 Columns with zeros  \n### u2714 Columns where *all* values are zero  \nu2192 those will simply remain zero (since no positive minimum exists)\n\n### u2714 Cleaner and modern syntax  \n`across()` replaces `mutate_at()`.\n\n---\n\n# u2757 If you want columns with *all zeros* to get a fixed replacement (e.g., NA), use:\n\n```r\n~ if (all(. == 0)) NA_real_ else if_else(. == 0, min(.[. != 0])/2, .)\n```\n\n---\n\nIf you want, tell me what error message you're seeing and I can pinpoint the exact cause."

              "In **base R**, if you want to **stop console output from appearing on screen**, there are a few ways to suppress or redirect output depending on what you're trying to achieve:\n\n---\n\n### ud83dudd07 **1. Suppress output entirely**\nIf you just want to **suppress output** (i.e., stop it from printing to the console):\n\n```r\ninvisible(some_function())\n```\n\nOr simply:\n\n```r\nsome_function(); invisible()\n```\n\nIf the function returns a value and you don't want to see it:\n\n```r\ninvisible(capture.output(some_function()))\n```\n\n---\n\n### ud83dudcc1 **2. Redirect output to a file**\nTo prevent output from printing to the screen and instead send it somewhere else:\n\n```r\nsink(\"output.txt\")      # Start redirecting output to file\nsome_function()         # Output will go to output.txt\nsink()                  # Stop redirecting\n```\n\nThis redirects all `stdout` (standard output) from the R console to a file.\n\nTo also capture **messages and warnings**:\n\n```r\nsink(\"output.txt\", type = \"output\")\nsink(\"messages.txt\", type = \"message\")\n```\n\nRemember to always call `sink()` again to stop the redirection.\n\n---\n\n### ud83eudd2b **3. Suppress specific types of output**\n- **Suppress messages**:\n  ```r\n  suppressMessages(library(packageName))\n  ```\n\n- **Suppress warnings**:\n  ```r\n  suppressWarnings(function_that_warns())\n  ```\n\n- **Suppress both**:\n  ```r\n  suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(function_that_warns_and_messages()))\n  ```\n\n---\n\n### ud83dudccc Summary\n\n| Goal                            | Solution                                      |\n|---------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|\n| Suppress return values          | `invisible(...)`                              |\n| Redirect output to file         | `sink(\"file.txt\")` ... `sink()`               |\n| Suppress messages               | `suppressMessages(...)`                       |\n| Suppress warnings               | `suppressWarnings(...)`                       |\n| Suppress both                   | `suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(...))`     |\n\nLet me know if you want to suppress **graphics**, **plots**, or **errors** too u2014 different methods apply."

Alternatively, you can **manipulate the internals** of the model, but the cleanest approach is to handle it manually.\n\n---\n\n### ud83dudd27 Manual Approach (No Centering or Scaling Anywhere)\n\n```r\nlibrary(pls)\n\n# Simulate data\nset.seed(123)\nX <- matrix(rnorm(100 * 10), ncol = 10)\ny <- rnorm(100)\n\n# Fit model with raw X and raw y\n# Use scale = FALSE to prevent X centering/scaling\nmodel <- plsr(y ~ X, ncomp = 5, scale = FALSE)\n\n# Override response mean manually\n# Add mean back to predictions if needed\ny_mean <- mean(y)\n\n# Predict without centering response\npred <- predict(model, newdata = data.frame(X = X)) + y_mean\n\n# View prediction\nhead(pred)\n```\n\n---\n\n### ud83eudde0 Advanced (Hacky) Option: Modify Internals\n\nIf you're comfortable hacking the object, you could technically adjust the `model$Ymeans` to zero:\n\n```r\nmodel$Ymeans <- 0\n```\n\nBut this is not officially supported and can lead to inconsistencies in downstream functions (like plotting or validation).\n\n---\n\n### ud83dudd0d Summary\n\n| Task                          | Done? | How                                      |\n|------------------------------|-------|-------------------------------------------|\n| Prevent X centering/scaling  | u2705    | `scale = FALSE`                           |\n| Prevent y centering          | u2705    | Manual pre-processing / adjust predictions|\n\nLet me know if you'd like to wrap this into a reusable function u2014 it's very possible to encapsulate the \"no centering anywhere\" PLS."

              "Absolutely! Here's a clean, **reusable PLS regression function in R** that:\n\n- u274c **Does not center or scale** the predictors (`X`)\n- u274c **Does not center** the response (`y`)\n- u2705 **Includes an intercept** (i.e. does not force regression through (0,0))\n- u2705 Allows prediction with corrected output (response mean preserved)\n\n---\n\n### u2705 Reusable Function: `pls_raw()`\n\n```r\nlibrary(pls)\n\npls_raw <- function(X, y, ncomp = 2, validation = NULL) {\n  if (!is.matrix(X)) X <- as.matrix(X)\n\n  # Store response mean to preserve intercept manually\n  y_mean <- mean(y)\n\n  # Fit PLS model without scaling or centering\n  model <- plsr(y ~ X, ncomp = ncomp, scale = FALSE, validation = validation)\n\n  # Store response mean inside model for later use in prediction\n  model$raw_response_mean <- y_mean\n\n  return(model)\n}\n\n# Prediction function that restores original response scale\npredict_pls_raw <- function(model, newdata) {\n  if (!is.matrix(newdata)) newdata <- as.matrix(newdata)\n\n  preds <- predict(model, newdata = data.frame(X = newdata), ncomp = model$ncomp)\n  \n  # Add back original response mean (undo response centering)\n  preds <- preds + model$raw_response_mean\n\n  return(preds)\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n### ud83euddea Example Usage\n\n```r\n# Simulate data\nset.seed(42)\nX <- matrix(rnorm(100 * 5), ncol = 5)\ny <- rnorm(100)\n\n# Fit model without centering/scaling\nmodel <- pls_raw(X, y, ncomp = 3)\n\n# Predict on training data\npreds <- predict_pls_raw(model, X)\n\n# Compare with original y\nhead(cbind(preds = preds[, , 1], actual = y))\n```\n\n---\n\n### ud83dudd04 Benefits\n\n- Works just like `plsr()` but respects *no centering or scaling* anywhere\n- Restores intercept behavior by manually controlling response mean\n- Compatible with matrix or data.frame inputs for `X` and `newdata`\n\n---\n\nLet me know if you want this extended to handle formulas, plotting, or cross-validation results."

Model frame\n  mf <- model.frame(formula, data)\n\n  # Extract response and predictors\n  y <- model.response(mf)\n  X <- model.matrix(attr(mf, \"terms\"), data = mf)[, -1, drop = FALSE]\n\n  # Preserve response mean manually\n  y_mean <- mean(y)\n\n  # Fit model without scaling or centering\n  model <- plsr(y ~ X, ncomp = ncomp, scale = FALSE, validation = validation)\n\n  # Store original info for predict method\n  model$raw_response_mean <- y_mean\n  model$raw_formula <- formula\n  model$raw_data <- data\n  model$raw_X <- X\n  model$raw_y <- y\n  model$raw_ncomp <- ncomp\n\n  class(model) <- c(\"pls_raw\", class(model))  #               "To **reverse the scaling and centering applied by `plsr()`** in R and **transform the predicted outputs back to the original scale**, you need to manually **undo the preprocessing** that `plsr()` typically performs **internally** u2014 even if youu2019ve set `scale = TRUE`.\n\n---\n\n### ud83dudd0d What `plsr()` does when `scale = TRUE`\n\n- **Centers** each predictor (`X`) and response (`Y`) by subtracting the mean.\n- **Scales** each predictor (and optionally response) by dividing by the standard deviation.\n- Stores `Xmeans`, `Xscale`, `Ymeans`, `Yscale` internally for reversing.\n\n---\n\n### u2705 To Reverse the Scaling/Centering of Predictions:\n\nUse this transformation:\n\n```r\nY_original = Y_pred_scaled * Yscale + Ymeans\n```\n\n---\n\n### ud83dudee0ufe0f Reusable Function to Reverse Scaling of Predictions\n\n```r\n#' Reverse scaling and centering from a plsr model\n#'\n#' @param model A fitted plsr model (from the `pls` package)\n#' @param Y_scaled Predicted values on the scaled (PLS) scale\n#' @return Predictions on the original response scale\n#' @export\nreverse_plsr_scaling <- function(model, Y_scaled) {\n  # Extract scaling parameters from model\n  Ymean <- model$Ymeans\n  Yscale <- if (!is.null(model$Yscale)) model$Yscale else 1\n  \n  # Apply reverse transformation\n  Y_original <- sweep(Y_scaled, 2, Yscale, `*`)\n  Y_original <- sweep(Y_original, 2, Ymean, `+`)\n  \n  return(Y_original)\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n### ud83euddea Example Usage\n\n```r\nlibrary(pls)\n\n# Simulate data\nset.seed(123)\nX <- matrix(rnorm(100 * 5), ncol = 5)\ny <- 3 * X[,1] - 2 * X[,2] + rnorm(100)\n\n# Fit PLSR with centering/scaling\nmodel <- plsr(y ~ X, scale = TRUE, ncomp = 2)\n\n# Predict on new data (returns scaled predictions)\npred_scaled <- predict(model, newdata = data.frame(X = X), ncomp = 2)\n\n# Reverse scaling\npred_original <- reverse_plsr_scaling(model, pred_scaled)\n\n# Compare to actual\nhead(data.frame(pred = pred_original[, , 1], actual = y))\n```\n\n---\n\n### ud83dudccc Notes\n\n- Works for **univariate** and **multivariate** responses.\n- If `scale = FALSE` during fitting, no need to reverse.\n- Automatically reads `Yscale` and `Ymeans` from model.\n\n---\n\nWould you like this behavior integrated into your earlier `pls_raw()` package so that it reverses scaling when used with normal `plsr()` calls?"

              "Great question! In **Partial Least Squares Regression (PLSR)**, the `scale` and `center` steps are crucial preprocessing operations that affect both how the algorithm computes components and how it interprets the data.\n\nLetu2019s break it down:\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd27 `center` (default = `TRUE` in `plsr()`)\n\n- **What it does**: Subtracts the **mean** of each variable (predictors and response) so that they are centered at zero.\n- **Why it matters**:\n  - PLS works with covariances and projections; centering ensures components are aligned with the variation **around the mean**, not absolute levels.\n  - Without centering, variables with non-zero means might dominate the model improperly.\n- **Effect**:\n  - Shifts variables, but doesnu2019t change their spread (variance).\n\n### Example:\n| Variable | Raw Values | Centered |\n|----------|------------|----------|\n| X1       | 3, 5, 7    | -2, 0, 2 |\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudd27 `scale = TRUE` (default in `plsr()`)\n\n- **What it does**: Divides each variable by its **standard deviation** after centering u2192 each variable ends up with unit variance.\n- **Why it's used**:\n  - Ensures that **all variables contribute equally**, regardless of their units or variance.\n  - Without scaling, variables with large variance (e.g., revenue in millions) dominate variables with small variance (e.g., age in years).\n- **Effect**:\n  - All variables are on the same scale (mean 0, SD 1).\n  - Helps especially when units differ.\n\n---\n\n## ud83eudde0 Why These Matter for PLS\n\nPLS constructs **latent components** by projecting predictors and responses onto directions that explain **maximum covariance** between them.\n\n- If variables are **not centered**, these projections can be **misleading**, because raw means will distort the covariance structure.\n- If variables are **not scaled**, predictors with high variance will dominate the first components, even if theyu2019re not more relevant.\n\n---\n\n## ud83dudccc In `plsr()` from the `pls` package\n\n| Argument      | Behavior                  |\n|---------------|---------------------------|\n| `center = TRUE` | Center predictors and response |\n| `scale = TRUE`  | Scale predictors and response to unit variance |\n| `scale = FALSE` | No scaling (only centering applies) |\n\nIf you want to **avoid all preprocessing** (i.e., raw PLS):\n```r\nplsr(y ~ X, scale = FALSE, center = FALSE)\n```\n\nBut this is **rarely recommended**, unless you have a specific reason (e.g., variables are already standardized, or you want to model with raw magnitudes).\n\n---\n\n## u2705 Summary\n\n| Step    | What it Does             | Why It Matters                    |\n|---------|--------------------------|-----------------------------------|\n| Center  | Subtract mean            | Aligns data for component analysis |\n| Scale   | Divide by standard deviation | Equalizes variable influence      |\n\n---\n\nLet me know if you want a plot-based illustration or an example with raw vs scaled PLS!"
